Un attentato terroristico sventato, premiato con una medaglia reale, e commenti sulle tensioni regionali aggiungono qualche preoccupazione per la sicurezza, ma il tono è positivo.
summary.ru: Период в основном рутинный: фестиваль финиковых пальм, объявления об инвестициях и торговле (торговля с Таиландом выросла на 35%), сотрудничество с МАГАТЭ и успешно проведённый азиатский чемпионат по регби. Предотвращённое террористическое нападение, отмеченное королевской медалью, и комментарии о региональной напряжённости добавляют некоторую тревогу по поводу безопасности, однако тон позитивный.
summary.ar: الفترة روتينية في معظمها: مهرجان لنخيل التمر، وإعلانات عن استثمارات وتجارة (ارتفعت التجارة مع تايلاند بنسبة 35%)، وتعاون مع الوكالة الدولية للطاقة الذرية، وبطولة كأس آسيا للرجبي الناجحة. ويضيف إحباط هجوم إرهابي، جرى تكريم مسؤول عنه بوسام ملكي، وتعليقات حول التوترات الإقليمية، بعض القلق الأمني، لكن النبرة إيجابية.
summary.fa: این دوره عمدتاً عادی است: جشنواره نخل خرما، اعلام‌های سرمایه‌گذاری و تجارت (تجارت با تایلند 35% افزایش یافته)، همکاری با آژانس بین‌المللی انرژی اتمی و برگزاری موفق جام راگبی آسیا. خنثی شدن یک حمله تروریستی که با مدال سلطنتی تجلیل شده و تفسیرهایی درباره تنش‌های منطقه‌ای، اندکی نگرانی امنیتی ایجاد می‌کند، اما لحن کلی مثبت است.
summary.zh: 这一时期大体平淡无奇：一场椰枣节、投资和贸易公告（对泰国贸易增长35%）、与国际原子能机构的合作，以及成功举办的亚洲橄榄球杯赛。一起被挫败的恐怖袭击事件获得王室勋章表彰，以及有关地区紧张局势的评论，带来一些安全方面的担忧，但总体基调是积极的。
summary.tr: Dönem büyük ölçüde rutin gelişmelerden oluşuyor: bir hurma festivali, yatırım ve ticaret duyuruları (Tayland ile ticaret %35 arttı), IAEA ile iş birliği ve başarılı bir Asya ragbi kupası. Önlenen bir terör saldırısı ve kraliyet madalyasıyla onurlandırılan bir görevli ile bölgesel gerilim yorumları bazı güvenlik kaygıları ekliyor, ancak ton olumlu.
summary.es: El periodo transcurre en gran medida con normalidad: un festival de palmeras datileras, anuncios de inversiones y comercio (el comercio con Tailandia aumentó un 35 %), cooperación con el OIEA y un exitoso campeonato asiático de rugby. Un atentado terrorista frustrado, con un agente condecorado con una medalla real, y comentarios sobre las tensiones regionales añaden cierta preocupación en materia de seguridad, pero el tono es positivo.
summary.fr: La période est principalement routinière : un festival de palmiers dattiers, des annonces d'investissements et d'échanges commerciaux (commerce avec la Thaïlande en hausse de 35 %), une coopération avec l'AIEA et une coupe de rugby asiatique réussie. Un attentat terroriste déjoué, honoré par une médaille royale, et des commentaires sur les tensions régionales ajoutent une certaine préoccupation sécuritaire, mais le ton reste positif.
summary.de: Der Zeitraum verläuft überwiegend routinemäßig: ein Dattelpalmenfest, Investitions- und Handelsankündigungen (Handel mit Thailand um 35 % gestiegen), Zusammenarbeit mit der IAEO und ein erfolgreicher asiatischer Rugby-Pokal. Ein vereitelter Terroranschlag, für den ein Beamter mit einer königlichen Medaille geehrt wurde, sowie Kommentare zu regionalen Spannungen sorgen für gewisse Sicherheitsbedenken, der Tenor bleibt jedoch positiv.
summary.pt: O período é em grande parte rotineiro: um festival de tamareiras, anúncios de investimentos e comércio (comércio com a Tailândia com alta de 35%), cooperação com a AIEA e uma bem-sucedida copa asiática de rúgbi. Um ataque terrorista frustrado, com um oficial condecorado com medalha real, e comentários sobre tensões regionais acrescentam alguma preocupação com a segurança, mas o tom é positivo.

en: Trade with Thailand reported up 35% in anniversary year
Successful hosting of Asian rugby cup boosts sports standing
Officer honoured after repelling terror attack; security debate
ja: 記念の年にタイとの貿易が35%増加したと報じられる
アジアラグビーカップの成功裏の開催がスポーツ分野での地位を高める
テロ攻撃を撃退した職員が表彰される。治安をめぐる議論も
ko: 수교 기념 해에 태국과의 교역이 35% 증가했다고 보도됨
아시아 럭비컵 성공적 개최로 스포츠 위상 제고
테러 공격을 격퇴한 장교 표창; 안보 논쟁
hi: वर्षगांठ वाले वर्ष में थाईलैंड के साथ व्यापार 35% बढ़ने की रिपोर्ट
एशियाई रग्बी कप की सफल मेज़बानी से खेल जगत में प्रतिष्ठा बढ़ी
आतंकी हमले को विफल करने वाले अधिकारी का सम्मान; सुरक्षा पर बहस
el: Αναφέρεται αύξηση του εμπορίου με την Ταϊλάνδη κατά 35% το έτος της επετείου
Η επιτυχής φιλοξενία του Ασιατικού Κυπέλλου ράγκμπι ενισχύει το κύρος στον αθλητισμό
Αξιωματικός τιμήθηκε για την απόκρουση τρομοκρατικής επίθεσης· συζήτηση για την ασφάλεια
it: Il commercio con la Thailandia è segnalato in aumento del 35% nell'anno dell'anniversario
L'organizzazione riuscita della coppa asiatica di rugby rafforza il prestigio sportivo
Un agente premiato dopo aver respinto un attentato terroristico; dibattito sulla sicurezza
ru: Сообщается о росте торговли с Таиландом на 35% в юбилейный год
Успешное проведение азиатского кубка по регби повышает спортивный авторитет
Сотрудник отмечен после отражения террористической атаки; дебаты о безопасности
ar: أُفيد بارتفاع التجارة مع تايلاند بنسبة 35% في عام الذكرى
استضافة ناجحة لكأس آسيا للرجبي تعزز المكانة الرياضية
تكريم ضابط بعد صد هجوم إرهابي؛ نقاش حول الأمن
fa: گزارش شده تجارت با تایلند در سال سالگرد 35% افزایش یافته است
میزبانی موفق جام راگبی آسیا جایگاه ورزشی را ارتقا می‌دهد
افسری پس از دفع یک حمله تروریستی تجلیل شد؛ بحث امنیتی
zh: 据报道，在周年纪念之年，与泰国的贸易增长35%
成功举办亚洲橄榄球杯赛提升了体育声誉
一名官员在挫败恐怖袭击后获得表彰；安全问题引发讨论

Asya ragbi kupasının başarılı biçimde ev sahipliği yapılması spor alanındaki konumu güçlendiriyor
Terör saldırısını püskürttükten sonra görevli onurlandırıldı; güvenlik tartışması
es: Se informa de que el comercio con Tailandia aumentó un 35 % en el año del aniversario
La exitosa organización de la copa asiática de rugby refuerza la posición deportiva
Un agente condecorado tras repeler un atentado terrorista; debate sobre seguridad
fr: Le commerce avec la Thaïlande aurait augmenté de 35 % durant l'année anniversaire
L'accueil réussi de la coupe d'Asie de rugby renforce la position sportive
Un officier honoré pour avoir repoussé un attentat terroriste ; débat sur la sécurité
de: Der Handel mit Thailand ist im Jubiläumsjahr Berichten zufolge um 35 % gestiegen
Die erfolgreiche Ausrichtung des asiatischen Rugby-Pokals stärkt das sportliche Ansehen
Beamter nach Abwehr eines Terroranschlags ausgezeichnet; Debatte über die Sicherheitslage
pt: O comércio com a Tailândia teve alta de 35% no ano do aniversário, segundo relatos
A realização bem-sucedida da copa asiática de rúgbi fortalece o prestígio esportivo
Oficial condecorado após repelir ataque terrorista; debate sobre segurança

summary.en: The country faces a very large Ebola outbreak (9,415 confirmed cases, over 4,500 deaths, spread to 8 provinces, spillover into neighboring Kenya). In addition, armed violence and displacement in the east (Djugu, Rutshuru), cholera-like diarrhoea deaths in North Kivu, the Kabila-led rebel movement and tensions with the government stand out. Payment problems for response teams, actions halting economic activity and protests further aggravate the situation; small positive developments such as school reopenings cannot offset it.

en: Ebola outbreak: 9,415 cases, ~4,500+ deaths, spread to an 8th province, unvaccinated strain
Armed violence and mass displacement in the east (Djugu 24,600; Rutshuru 70,000 without aid)
Kabila's rebel movement and political polarization/uncertainty over dialogue
Cholera-like diarrhoea outbreak in North Kivu and payment crisis for Ebola response staff
Miner protests in Kolwezi, 'Stop Ebola' day and shutdown in Beni, and tax-related reactions

summary.en: The period is dominated by serious problems: a spreading Ebola outbreak with a record caseload, fighting and health-system disruption in North Kivu, and an African Union warning against seizure of power by force amid a political and security crisis. Some positives, such as the National Assembly passing development financing, the school reopening in Inongo and the census going smoothly, do not offset these.

en: Ebola outbreak spreading, with more cases in North Kivu than Ituri
AU warns against seizure of power by force amid political crisis
Fighting in North Kivu leaves only 11 of 22 health zones working

summary.en: The DRC faces a severe Ebola outbreak nearing 10,000 cases with cross-border spread, renewed hostilities that have forced thousands to flee in the southeast, and a new rebel alliance. Local protests in Kolwezi are calming, but food prices are rising and political tensions are high.

en: Ebola outbreak rebounds, nearing 10,000 cases with cross-border spread
Thousands flee escalating hostilities in southeastern DRC
New rebel alliance and FDLR-related conflict coverage

summary.en: The period is dominated by a large Ebola outbreak nearing 10,000 DRC cases, ADF and CODECO massacres and hostage killings in the east, and a political rift between Tshisekedi and Kabila. Together these point to serious humanitarian and security strain, with no offsetting peace or recovery signal.

en: Ebola outbreak near 10,000 cases, spreading to Nigeria and health workers infected
77 civilians killed by ADF in Mambasa; over 80,000 displaced
Two hostages killed after CODECO abduction in Djugu

summary.en: The period is dominated by a fast-spreading Ebola outbreak, with deaths near 4,700 and cases in an eighth province, partly offset by the start of a vaccine trial. Domestic politics also show strain, including arrests of political figures and a no-confidence motion.

en: Ebola outbreak nearing 4,700 deaths and spreading to eighth province
Start of Bundibugyo Ebola vaccine trial in Bunia
Arrests of opposition figure and UDPS cadre; no-confidence motion against minister

summary.en: The period mixes a major Ebola outbreak (Bundibugyo strain), with Uganda restricting transit and Ebola response workers striking over unpaid bonuses, against a positive step in the launch of a vaccine trial. Political and security stress also shows up in more than 100 detentions in Lubumbashi, protests in Kisangani, and no-confidence motions in Tshuapa and Kinshasa.

en: Ebola outbreak spreading cross-border; Uganda restricts DRC-linked travellers
Launch of Bundibugyo Ebola vaccine clinical trial in Bunia
Over 100 people detained in Lubumbashi security operations

summary.en: The period is dominated by an expanding Ebola outbreak, including a nurse killed over Ebola rumours and new Ugandan travel restrictions, alongside a constitutional referendum dispute and security-force violence against protesters and Catholic worshippers. Some positives, such as Ebola recoveries and FARDC operations against ADF, do not offset the serious problems.

en: Nurse killed in Bafwasende over Ebola rumours; health workers attacked
Uganda imposes travel restrictions and 21-day quarantine on DRC travellers
Security forces reportedly fire on Catholic faithful; Kolwezi unrest with 58 arrests

summary.en: The period is dominated by a large Ebola outbreak with attacks on health workers, including a nurse killed, and deadly CODECO attacks in Djugu that killed more than a dozen people. Political strain is also visible in a contested referendum law, a provincial governor's removal, and Kolwezi protests. Positive signals such as a vaccine trial, infrastructure launches and a youth peace festival do not offset these serious problems.

en: Ebola outbreak near 10,000 cases with attacks on health workers
CODECO attacks in Djugu killing more than a dozen people
Referendum law adoption and Senate opposition

summary.en: The period is dominated by an Ebola outbreak that passed 10,000 cases, with 1,424 deaths reported in North Kivu and a treatment centre overwhelmed, plus armed clashes in South Kivu and CODECO attacks in Djugu that killed more than a dozen people. Modest positives, such as recoveries, a solar plant inauguration and a vaccine trial, do not offset these serious problems.

en: Ebola outbreak passes 10,000 cases; 1,424 deaths in North Kivu
Treatment centre in Beni overwhelmed; nurse killed by mob
FARDC–FRN clashes in Fizi and Walungu; CODECO attacks in Djugu

summary.en: The period is dominated by a record Ebola outbreak (over 10,000 cases), renewed fighting around Uvira and Walikale with new displacements, and drone strikes linked to the Kabila-aligned FRN. Some positives, such as no new Ebola cases at Mongbwalu, rebel surrenders in Fizi and calm returning to Lodja, do not offset these serious problems.

en: Ebola outbreak surpasses 10,000 cases, concentrated in Ituri
Fighting around Uvira and renewed displacement in Walikale
Kabila-aligned FRN rebels and drone strike allegations

summary.en: The period is dominated by a large Ebola outbreak (over 10,000 cases, 4,900 deaths reported) and renewed fighting in the east that is displacing civilians and disrupting relief. Partial positives include a vaccine trial, a fighter surrender in Fizi, and US sanctions on Rwanda that Kinshasa welcomed, but they do not offset the crisis.

en: Ebola outbreak tops 10,000 confirmed cases and 4,900 deaths
Renewed fighting in Ituri and Walikale displaces thousands of civilians
464 human rights violations documented in July by BCNUDH

summary.en: The period is dominated by a severe Ebola epidemic in the east, with over 10,000 cases and a death toll near 5,000, alongside ongoing armed attacks, M23/FRN fighting and ADF activity. Positive news, such as exiting the FATF grey list, is outweighed by these serious humanitarian and security problems.

en: Ebola outbreak: over 2,300 new confirmed cases in three weeks
Eastern conflict: M23/FRN fighting near Uvira and renewed ADF presence
Removal from FATF grey list as a positive institutional signal

summary.en: The period is dominated by a severe Ebola epidemic (reported death toll above 5,000), a cholera outbreak in Mbandaka, active fighting in Masisi, and worsening hunger. Political tensions are also high, with a detained opposition figure denied bail and the president targeting Kabila allies.

en: Ebola death toll surpasses 5,000 in DR Congo
Cholera outbreak in Mbandaka: 14 deaths, 129 cases
Violent FARDC-FRN combat in Masisi

summary.en: An Ebola outbreak with over 5,000 deaths and 10,000 cases is spreading with no approved vaccine, alongside displacement, unaided humanitarian needs and killings in the east. Political tension over the Tshisekedi family case and arrests of a lawyer add to the strain, with only minor positives such as an airline lease and a promotional claim of eastern stability.

en: Ebola outbreak surpasses 5,000 deaths and 10,000 cases
Thousands of displaced people without humanitarian assistance in North Kivu
Hunger deepens for millions amid conflict and Ebola

summary.en: The period is dominated by a large Ebola outbreak reported at over 5,300 deaths, ongoing armed conflict in the east, and a projected hunger crisis affecting over 30 million people. Modest positives, such as the release of about 50 ADF ex-hostages and cautious hope around US sanctions, do not offset this humanitarian catastrophe.

en: Ebola outbreak reported at over 5,300 deaths
Projected hunger for over 30 million amid conflict and Ebola
Ongoing conflict with FRN/M23 and Rwanda tensions

summary.en: A large Ebola outbreak (over 10,000 cases, reportedly spreading), new ADF attacks forcing families to flee, and stalled peace talks with M23/FRN outweigh positives such as the exit from the FATF grey list. Overall the period reflects serious humanitarian and security strain rather than acute state collapse.

en: Ebola outbreak surpassing 10,000 cases and spreading in the east
ADF attack forcing hundreds of families to flee in Lubero
Fears of Doha process collapse over constitutional change

summary.en: The period is dominated by serious humanitarian and security problems: a cholera outbreak with about 1,800 deaths, an Ebola epidemic spreading to Beni, armed clashes killing civilians in Masisi, flooding, and severe malnutrition. Some positive items (WHO supplies, vaccine trials, community programmes) do not offset these crises.

en: Cholera outbreak reaching 60,000 cases and about 1,800 deaths
Ebola spreading, with Beni becoming the new epicentre in North Kivu
Civilians killed in FARDC-M23 clashes in Masisi

summary.en: Eastern DRC saw a deadly ADF attack that killed 10 civilians, ongoing fighting in Masisi and Uvira, and an active Ebola outbreak with an infected doctor evacuated. Some positives, such as FARDC retaking villages, new Ebola vaccine trials and a funded emergency health campaign, do not offset the serious security and health pressures.

en: ADF attack killed 10 civilians in eastern DR Congo
Ebola outbreak ongoing; infected doctor evacuated to London
Fighting in Masisi and Uvira; FARDC retook Mahanga and Kilongo

summary.en: The Ebola outbreak has passed 5,000 deaths and 10,000 cases, and an ADF massacre in Beni killed at least 33 civilians, while FARDC-FRN fighting intensifies in North Kivu. Modest positives, such as new vaccine trials and a US-DRC partnership meeting, do not offset the scale of the humanitarian and security crisis.

en: Ebola deaths rise to 5,198 with 10,668 cases
ADF attack in Beni kills at least 33 civilians
Intensified FARDC-FRN fighting on Kashebere-Kibati axis

summary.en: The period is dominated by serious problems: the Ebola outbreak is reported as the largest in the country's history, ADF attacks have forced suspected Ebola patients to flee, and 66 soldiers were sentenced to death. Ongoing states of siege and a nurses' strike add pressure, though WHO vaccine recommendations and a US-Congo minerals review offer some positive signals.

en: Ebola outbreak reported as largest in country's history
ADF attack causing Ebola patients to flee in Beni
66 military personnel sentenced to death in Goma

summary.en: The period is dominated by serious problems: a massacre in North Kivu, a new Ebola outbreak in the east, ADF attacks in Beni, flood damage in Gemena, and a military court sentencing 66 soldiers to death. Modest positives include the resumption of civil service pay and the reopening of the Kalamu bridge in Kinshasa.

en: Massacre at Cantine-Aloya and new Ebola outbreak in the east
ADF attack concerns and calls for coordinated military operations in Beni
Military court sentences 66 soldiers to death

summary.en: The period is dominated by serious problems: an Ebola outbreak nearing 11,000 cases with over 5,300 deaths, rebel advances, attacks on health facilities, kidnappings and inter-community violence. Some positives, such as a Mukamba reconciliation accord, joint FARDC-MONUSCO patrols and reopened health centres, are outweighed by the scale of the crisis.

en: Ebola outbreak nearing 11,000 cases, attacks on health structures
Rebels advancing and violence in Djugu and Ituri
Kidnappings on Rutshuru roads and armed attack on Kipushi school

summary.en: The period is dominated by a major Ebola outbreak (over 11,000 cases and more than 5,000 deaths, per foreign reports) alongside deadly armed attacks on civilians in the east and Ituri and cholera fears. Positives such as a Kasai peace pact, a trade agreement and Ebola recoveries do not offset the severity.
summary.tr: Dönem, büyük bir Ebola salgını (yabancı haberlere göre 11.000'den fazla vaka ve 5.000'den fazla ölüm) ile doğuda ve Ituri'de sivillere yönelik ölümcül silahlı saldırılar ve kolera endişeleriyle damgalanıyor. Kasai barış anlaşması, bir ticaret anlaşması ve Ebola'dan iyileşmeler gibi olumlu gelişmeler, durumun ciddiyetini ortadan kaldırmıyor.
summary.es: El periodo está dominado por un gran brote de ébola (más de 11.000 casos y más de 5.000 muertes, según informes extranjeros), junto con mortíferos ataques armados contra civiles en el este y en Ituri, y temores por el cólera. Aspectos positivos como el pacto de paz de Kasái, un acuerdo comercial y las recuperaciones de ébola no compensan la gravedad de la situación.
summary.fr: La période est dominée par une grave épidémie d'Ebola (plus de 11 000 cas et plus de 5 000 décès, selon des rapports étrangers), ainsi que par des attaques armées meurtrières contre des civils dans l'est et en Ituri, et par des craintes de choléra. Des éléments positifs, comme le pacte de paix au Kasaï, un accord commercial et les guérisons liées à Ebola, ne compensent pas la gravité de la situation.
summary.de: Der Zeitraum wird von einem großen Ebola-Ausbruch dominiert (über 11.000 Fälle und mehr als 5.000 Todesfälle laut ausländischen Berichten), dazu kommen tödliche bewaffnete Angriffe auf Zivilisten im Osten und in Ituri sowie Choleraängste. Positive Entwicklungen wie das Friedensabkommen für Kasai, ein Handelsabkommen und Ebola-Genesungen wiegen die Schwere der Lage nicht auf.
summary.pt: O período é marcado por um grande surto de Ebola (mais de 11.000 casos e mais de 5.000 mortes, segundo relatos estrangeiros), somado a ataques armados mortais contra civis no leste e em Ituri e a temores de cólera. Aspectos positivos, como o pacto de paz em Kasai, um acordo comercial e as recuperações de Ebola, não compensam a gravidade da situação.
summary.ja: 同期間は、エボラ出血熱の大規模な流行（外国報道によると症例1万1千件超、死者5千人超）が大きな割合を占め、東部およびイトゥリ州では武装勢力による市民への致死的な攻撃や、コレラへの懸念も続いた。カサイ地域の和平合意、貿易協定、エボラからの回復者の発生などの前向きな動きも、事態の深刻さを相殺するには至っていない。
summary.ko: 이 기간은 대규모 에볼라 발생(외국 보도에 따르면 확진 11,000건 이상, 사망 5,000명 이상)이 지배적이었으며, 동부와 이투리에서는 무장 공격으로 민간인이 사망했고 콜레라 우려도 이어졌다. 카사이 평화 협정, 무역 협정, 에볼라 회복자 발생 등 긍정적인 소식도 사태의 심각성을 상쇄하지는 못했다.
summary.hi: यह अवधि एक बड़े इबोला प्रकोप (विदेशी रिपोर्टों के अनुसार 11,000 से अधिक मामले और 5,000 से अधिक मौतें) से प्रभावित रही, साथ ही पूर्व और इतुरी में सशस्त्र हमलों में नागरिकों की जान गई और हैजे को लेकर चिंताएँ रहीं। कासाई शांति समझौते, एक व्यापार समझौते और इबोला से स्वस्थ हुए लोगों जैसी सकारात्मक बातें इस गंभीरता को कम नहीं करतीं।
summary.el: Η περίοδος κυριαρχείται από μια μεγάλη επιδημία Έμπολα (πάνω από 11.000 κρούσματα και περισσότεροι από 5.000 θάνατοι, σύμφωνα με ξένες αναφορές), παράλληλα με θανατηφόρες ένοπλες επιθέσεις κατά αμάχων στην ανατολή και στο Ιτούρι και με φόβους για χολέρα. Θετικές εξελίξεις, όπως η συμφωνία ειρήνης στο Κασάι, μια εμπορική συμφωνία και περιπτώσεις ανάρρωσης από Έμπολα, δεν μειώνουν τη σοβαρότητα της κατάστασης.
summary.it: Il periodo è dominato da un grave focolaio di Ebola (oltre 11.000 casi e più di 5.000 decessi, secondo fonti straniere), insieme a letali attacchi armati contro civili nell'est e in Ituri e al timore di colera. Elementi positivi come il patto di pace nel Kasai, un accordo commerciale e le guarigioni da Ebola non compensano la gravità della situazione.
summary.ru: Период определяется крупной вспышкой Эболы (более 11 000 случаев и более 5 000 смертей по данным зарубежных источников), смертоносными вооружёнными нападениями на мирных жителей на востоке и в Итури, а также опасениями по поводу холеры. Позитивные события, такие как мирное соглашение в Касаи, торговое соглашение и выздоровление от Эболы, не компенсируют серьёзности ситуации.
summary.ar: تهيمن على الفترة فاشية كبيرة من إيبولا (أكثر من 11 ألف حالة وأكثر من 5 آلاف وفاة، وفق تقارير أجنبية)، إلى جانب هجمات مسلحة قاتلة ضد المدنيين في الشرق وإيتوري ومخاوف من الكوليرا. ولا تقلل الإيجابيات، مثل اتفاق السلام في كاساي والاتفاق التجاري والتعافي من إيبولا، من خطورة الوضع.
summary.fa: این دوره عمدتاً تحت تأثیر شیوع گسترده ابولا (بیش از 11,000 مورد و بیش از 5,000 مرگ، بر اساس گزارش‌های خارجی) و همچنین حملات مسلحانه مرگبار علیه غیرنظامیان در شرق و ایتوری و نگرانی از وبا قرار دارد. نکات مثبتی مانند توافق صلح در کاسای، توافق تجاری و بهبودی مبتلایان به ابولا، از شدت وضعیت نمی‌کاهد.
summary.zh: 该时期主要受埃博拉疫情重大爆发影响（据外国报道，病例超过11,000例，死亡人数超过5,000人），同时东部和伊图里发生致命的武装袭击平民事件，霍乱也引发担忧。卡赛和平协议、贸易协定及埃博拉康复病例等积极因素，无法抵消局势的严重性。

en: Ebola outbreak exceeds 11,000 cases with over 5,000 deaths
Armed attacks kill civilians in Masisi and Ituri camp
66 soldiers sentenced to death amid fighting in the east
tr: Ebola salgını 5.000'den fazla ölümle 11.000'in üzerinde vakaya ulaştı
Masisi ve Ituri'deki bir kampta silahlı saldırılar sivilleri öldürüyor
Doğudaki çatışmalar sürerken 66 asker idama mahkum edildi
es: El brote de ébola supera los 11.000 casos con más de 5.000 muertes
Ataques armados matan a civiles en Masisi y en un campamento de Ituri
66 soldados condenados a muerte en medio de los combates en el este
fr: L'épidémie d'Ebola dépasse 11 000 cas avec plus de 5 000 décès
Des attaques armées tuent des civils à Masisi et dans un camp en Ituri
66 soldats condamnés à mort alors que les combats se poursuivent dans l'est
de: Ebola-Ausbruch übersteigt 11.000 Fälle mit über 5.000 Todesfällen
Bewaffnete Angriffe töten Zivilisten in Masisi und in einem Lager in Ituri
66 Soldaten zum Tode verurteilt inmitten der Kämpfe im Osten
pt: Surto de Ebola ultrapassa 11.000 casos com mais de 5.000 mortes
Ataques armados matam civis em Masisi e em um campo em Ituri
66 soldados condenados à morte em meio aos combates no leste
ja: エボラ出血熱の流行で症例1万1千件超、死者5千人超
マシシおよびイトゥリのキャンプで武装攻撃により市民が死亡
東部での戦闘を受け、兵士66人に死刑判決
ko: 에볼라 발생 확진 11,000건 초과, 사망 5,000명 초과
마시시 및 이투리 난민촌에서 무장 공격으로 민간인 사망
동부 전투와 관련해 병사 66명 사형 선고
hi: इबोला प्रकोप में 11,000 से अधिक मामले और 5,000 से अधिक मौतें
मासीसी और इतुरी के शिविर में सशस्त्र हमलों में नागरिकों की मौत
पूर्व में लड़ाई के बीच 66 सैनिकों को मौत की सज़ा
el: Η επιδημία Έμπολα ξεπερνά τα 11.000 κρούσματα με περισσότερους από 5.000 θανάτους
Ένοπλες επιθέσεις σκοτώνουν αμάχους στο Μασίζι και σε καταυλισμό του Ιτούρι
66 στρατιώτες καταδικάστηκαν σε θάνατο εν μέσω των μαχών στην ανατολή
it: Il focolaio di Ebola supera gli 11.000 casi con oltre 5.000 decessi
Attacchi armati uccidono civili a Masisi e in un campo in Ituri
66 soldati condannati a morte in mezzo ai combattimenti nell'est
ru: Вспышка Эболы превышает 11 000 случаев, более 5 000 смертей
Вооружённые нападения убивают мирных жителей в Масиси и в лагере в Итури
66 военных приговорены к смертной казни на фоне боёв на востоке
ar: تفشي إيبولا يتجاوز 11 ألف حالة مع أكثر من 5 آلاف وفاة
هجمات مسلحة تودي بحياة مدنيين في ماسيسي ومخيم في إيتوري
الحكم بالإعدام على 66 جنديًا وسط القتال في الشرق
fa: شیوع ابولا از 11,000 مورد فراتر رفته و بیش از 5,000 مرگ ثبت شده است
حملات مسلحانه به غیرنظامیان در ماسیسی و یک اردوگاه در ایتوری جان باخته‌اند
66 سرباز در میان درگیری‌ها در شرق به اعدام محکوم شده‌اند
zh: 埃博拉疫情病例超过11,000例，死亡人数超过5,000人
武装袭击致马西西及伊图里一营地平民死亡
东部交战中66名士兵被判处死刑

summary.en: In Guinea over the last 24 hours there is a routine agenda: preparations for the Senate election, water and road infrastructure projects, a new state tobacco company, the start of the university term, and a corruption case. The Simandou iron ore project reaching a production rate of about 10 Mtpa is economically positive, while the fatal passenger accident at Séguéya is negative but local in scale. Since there is no clear crisis or major improvement, the score is near neutral, slightly positive.

en: Simandou iron ore production reaching a rate of about 10 Mtpa
Announcement of candidate bonds and campaign spending limits for the Senate elections
Announcement of water (600 million euros) and road infrastructure projects
Passenger accident at Séguéya resulting in 2 dead and 34 injured
Waiting time at the Port of Conakry falling to 15 days, with additional costs continuing

summary.en: The period mixes positive investment news (a $2bn UK Export Finance envelope and £330m in contracts) and a youth-participation initiative with routine judicial cases, a municipal wage-arrears strike threat and a magnitude 6.9 offshore earthquake that the headlines show only as a government response plan. On balance this is an ordinary day with a slight positive lean.

en: UK Export Finance $2bn and £330m investment announcements
Magnitude 6.9 offshore earthquake near Conakry, government prevention plan
Municipal wage arrears and threatened indefinite strike in Dixinn

summary.en: The period was mostly routine governance and economic news: judicial appointments, e-signature and public-finance reforms, and upbeat Simandou revenue and UK investment figures. The main negative item was a former Constitutional Court president sentenced to seven years, and GDELT tone is somewhat more negative than the world average.

en: Simandou revenue projections rising to $2.5 billion by 2040
UK investment ambition lifted above $3 billion
Former Constitutional Court president sentenced to seven years

summary.en: The period is mostly routine administration: a 4,500-post health recruitment, validation of a public finance reform plan, and Simandou diplomacy. The main negative item is the seven-year sentence of a former Constitutional Court president, alongside a security crackdown in Conakry, and GDELT tone is more negative than the world average.

en: Former Constitutional Court president sentenced to seven years in prison
Conakry crackdown on crime and drug networks launched by prosecutor
Validation of 2026-2030 public finance reform strategy

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: infrastructure approvals, a health recruitment drive, China partnership pledges and a strong run by the U18 team at the world school championship. Offsetting this are a jailing of a former Constitutional Court president and a union dispute, and GDELT tone (-0.33) is less negative than the world average.

en: Guinea U18 team advances at the world school championship
Labé–Tougué road and Kankan–Kissidougou works advance
Former Constitutional Court president sentenced to seven years

summary.en: A mostly routine day in Guinea: the revised 2026 budget shows GDP decline and rising inflation amid an oil crisis, but a state bond issue was heavily oversubscribed and a road loan was ratified. Security operations and union wage demands are ordinary news, and GDELT tone is less negative than the world average.

en: Oversubscribed state bond raising 4,579 billion GNF
Revised 2026 budget shows GDP decline and higher inflation
Road loan for Labé-Tougué highway ratified

summary.en: The period was routine and mildly positive, dominated by youth football results (a U20 qualification for the CAN, a U18 World Cup final loss, and a U15 win) and a Horoya CAF qualification. Fuel prices were held at 12,000 GNF and new administrative units were created, with no sign of a political or security crisis.

en: U20 team qualifies for CAN 2027 final
Fuel price maintained at 12,000 GNF
Timbo and Wanindara administrative upgrades announced

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: Guinea signed the Accra Convention on trade and SME credit, and a 2026 growth forecast of 8.6% was reported alongside Simandou progress. Offsetting this, a former Constitutional Court president was sentenced to seven years, and a journalist died, which keeps the score only modestly above an ordinary day.

en: Signing of Accra Convention on trade and SME credit access
Reported 8.6% growth forecast for 2026 and Simandou push
Sentencing of former Constitutional Court president by CRIEF

summary.en: A largely routine day in Guinea: the state raised about 4,500 billion GNF on the local bank market and a $517 million bond, and new budget rules were validated. Negatives are minor, including contract teachers protesting exclusion from recruitment and complaints about the Kankan–Kissidougou road, and the GDELT tone (-0.10) is better than the world average.

en: State raised about 4,500 billion GNF on local banking market
$517 million state bond issuance mobilised
Public expenditure nomenclature and local accounting plan validated

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: a successful 4,579 billion GNF bond issuance, Proparco financing for Soguipal, new ministerial and judicial appointments, and Simandou and China investment news. Negatives are limited to anger in Faranah over a student's death and job cuts at Bel Air Mining, so the score sits modestly above an ordinary day.

en: State mobilised 4,579 billion GNF through its 2026 bond issue
Proparco's 5 million euro financing for Soguipal expansion
Anger in Faranah after a student's death, with hospital explanations

summary.en: Guinea's news over the period is mostly routine but leans positive, led by a government bond raise of 4,579 billion GNF (nearly double the target) and a $520 million local financing. Mining (Simandou), a UN visit and stadium homologation add to the stable picture, offset only by a military dismissals decree and a media-minister story.

en: Bond issue of 4,579 billion GNF, nearly double target
$520 million raised on local financial market
Simandou mining operations and Rio Tinto SimFer coverage

summary.en: Routine news dominated the period: a domestic bond issuance, a sports title, a hotel deal, and Simandou mining coverage, with GDELT tone (-0.10) well above the world average. Negatives were local (power shortages, administrative suspensions in Siguiri, student housing complaints), and no crisis or crackdown appears in the headlines.

en: Simandou mining coverage and a hotel development deal signed in Conakry
UFOA U20 football title and U18 school team's return from the world championship
Administrative suspensions in Siguiri and power shortages affecting communities

summary.en: The period was mostly routine, with a few positive signals: the parliament adopted the 2026 revised budget law, and a government bond raised 4,579 billion GNF, well above target. Offsetting concerns include about 3.39 billion USD of external-financed projects reported as blocked, and complaints from contract workers and villages lacking water.

en: Government bond raised 4,579 billion GNF, exceeding initial target
Parliament adopted the revised 2026 budget law
About 3.39 billion USD of external-financed projects reported blocked

summary.en: The period was mostly upbeat: the inauguration of the country's first gold refinery, a record bond issue, and new investment partnerships, alongside routine army anniversary events. Negatives were local and limited, including a water shortage protest in Kérouané and errors in a school digital system.

en: Inauguration of Nimba Gold Refinery, the country's first gold refinery
Record bond issue in Guinean francs and new Samsung investment partnership
Local water shortage protest and school digital system errors

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: the inauguration of a first gold refinery and urban-rehabilitation projects are positive, while the central bank's warnings on liquidity and cash shortages and the army deployment against illegal gold mining in Siguiri weigh against them. GDELT tone is above the world average, so the overall picture is slightly positive.

en: First gold refinery inaugurated in Conakry, reported by multiple outlets
Central bank warns of liquidity crisis and banknote shortage
State deploys army against anarchic gold mining in Siguiri

summary.en: The period mixes routine governance and development news with serious concerns: mass dismissals of local officials over illegal gold mining in Siguiri, a detained former official's unclear fate, and an alleged abduction ending in death. Positive items, including a new gold refinery and a regional diplomatic appointment, and a tone more negative than the world average keep the score just below neutral.

en: Mass dismissals of 479 local officials and 22 administrators over illegal gold mining
Alleged abduction and death of Boubacar Barry; detained ex-OGP head's health and fate
Proposed anti-terrorism bill raising concerns about civil liberties

summary.en: The period is dominated by routine anti-corruption prosecutions and administrative dismissals over illegal gold mining, alongside a state gold refinery inauguration and a regional vote scheduled for 29 November. Negatives include slowing growth, rising inflation, mass departures of foreign miners after the mining ban, and an unpaid $29bn arbitration claim.

en: Mass departure of foreign miners after illegal gold mining ban
Growth slowing and inflation rising, per government explanations
Dismissals of 22 officials and 479 local leaders in Siguiri

summary.en: The period is dominated by the army's closure of Siguiri gold mines, expulsions of Burkinabe miners, a diplomatic row with Burkina Faso and a reported humanitarian crisis of displaced people on the Mali border. Some routine governance and economic news (a gold refinery inauguration, a workplace-injury compensation decree) partly offsets this, and GDELT tone is more negative than the world average.

en: Army closes Siguiri gold mines; expulsions of foreign miners
Diplomatic tension with Burkina Faso over expulsions and treatment
Humanitarian displacement at Mali-Guinea border reported

summary.en: The period mixes positive news (release of opposition leader Aliou Bah, a Chinese alumina EPC contract, regional energy integration) with serious strain from the crackdown on illegal gold mining. Thousands of foreigners were reportedly arrested and expelled, mines were closed, and layoffs and garbage backlogs followed, so the score sits modestly below an ordinary day.

en: Thousands of foreigners arrested and expelled over illegal gold mining
Release of opposition leader Aliou Bah
Siguiri mine closures hitting poultry sector and households

summary.en: Guinea's news flow is dominated by positive economic and institutional developments: the Simandou mining summit, investor outreach, a rectified budget, new international retail投资 in Conakry, and the release of opposition figure Aliou Bah. This is offset by a large anti-illegal-gold-mining operation with mass arrests and expulsions, which foreign media describe as a humanitarian concern.

en: Simandou Mining Summit and investor calls dominate coverage
Release of opposition figure Aliou Bah after nearly two years
Mass expulsions and 1,263 arrests in anti-illegal-gold-mining operations

summary.en: Guinea's period was dominated by a large anti-illegal-gold-mining crackdown, with over 1,200 arrests and reports of tens of thousands of miners expelled into Mali, creating a humanitarian emergency at the border. Offsetting this, budget and investment news was routine to mildly positive, including a deficit reported at 2.01% of GDP and a $900m AngloGold investment.

en: Mass expulsion of illegal gold miners creating border humanitarian emergency
Over 1,200 arrests in anti-illegal-gold-mining operation in Siguiri
Budget rectification and deficit narrowed to 2.01% of GDP

summary.en: The period is dominated by a large crackdown on illegal gold mining in Siguiri, with over 1,400 arrests, mass trials and expulsions that have strained relations with Burkina Faso. Routine positives, including a Hilton hotel opening, the SBPME business fair and administrative modernisation praise, partly offset these, and GDELT tone is slightly less negative than the world average.

en: Mass arrests and trials over illegal gold mining in Siguiri
Expulsions of Burkinabe miners causing diplomatic tension with Burkina Faso
Hilton hotel entry and SBPME business fair planned

summary.en: The period mixes routine news with a crackdown on illegal gold mining, including mass trials of hundreds of miners and the detention of a general and a youth-employment fund director on corruption-related charges. Mass expulsions of foreign miners have caused friction with Mali and Burkina Faso, while Simandou investment and a labour pact add some positive signals. Overall tone is negative, but there is no acute violence or institutional breakdown.
summary.tr: Bu dönem, rutin haberler ile yasa dışı altın madenciliğine yönelik bir operasyonun bir arada yer aldığı bir tablo sunuyor; bu kapsamda yüzlerce madencinin yargılandığı toplu davalar ve yolsuzlukla bağlantılı suçlamalarla bir generalin ve bir gençlik istihdam fonu müdürünün gözaltına alınması öne çıkıyor. Yabancı madencilerin toplu sınır dışı edilmesi Mali ve Burkina Faso ile gerginliğe yol açtı; Simandou yatırımı ve bir işgücü anlaşması ise bazı olumlu sinyaller veriyor. Genel ton olumsuz, ancak akut bir şiddet veya kurumsal çöküş yok.
summary.es: El período combina noticias rutinarias con una represión contra la minería ilegal de oro, que incluye juicios masivos contra cientos de mineros y la detención de un general y de un director del fondo de empleo juvenil por cargos relacionados con la corrupción. Las expulsiones masivas de mineros extranjeros han generado tensiones con Malí y Burkina Faso, mientras que la inversión en Simandou y un pacto laboral aportan algunas señales positivas. El tono general es negativo, pero no hay violencia aguda ni colapso institucional.
summary.fr: La période mêle actualités courantes et répression de l'orpaillage illégal, avec notamment des procès de masse visant des centaines de mineurs et la détention d'un général et d'un directeur du fonds pour l'emploi des jeunes pour des faits de corruption. Les expulsions massives de mineurs étrangers ont provoqué des tensions avec le Mali et le Burkina Faso, tandis que l'investissement dans Simandou et un accord sur le travail apportent quelques signaux positifs. Le ton général est négatif, mais il n'y a ni violence aiguë ni effondrement institutionnel.
summary.de: Der Zeitraum verbindet Routinenachrichten mit einem Vorgehen gegen illegalen Goldabbau, darunter Massenprozesse gegen Hunderte Bergleute sowie die Festnahme eines Generals und eines Direktors des Jugendbeschäftigungsfonds wegen korruptionsbezogener Vorwürfe. Massenausweisungen ausländischer Bergleute haben die Beziehungen zu Mali und Burkina Faso belastet, während Investitionen in Simandou und ein Arbeitsabkommen einige positive Signale setzen. Der Gesamtton ist negativ, doch gibt es weder akute Gewalt noch einen institutionellen Zusammenbruch.
summary.pt: O período combina notícias de rotina com uma repressão à mineração ilegal de ouro, incluindo julgamentos em massa de centenas de mineiros e a detenção de um general e de um diretor do fundo de emprego juvenil por acusações relacionadas com corrupção. As expulsões em massa de mineiros estrangeiros provocaram atritos com o Mali e o Burkina Faso, enquanto o investimento em Simandou e um pacto laboral trazem alguns sinais positivos. O tom geral é negativo, mas não há violência aguda nem colapso institucional.
summary.ja: この期間は日常的なニュースと違法な金採掘の取り締まりが混在しており、数百人の採掘者に対する大量裁判や、汚職関連の容疑による将官および青年雇用基金の局長の拘束が含まれる。外国人採掘者の大量追放はマリおよびブルキナファソとの間に摩擦を生んでいる一方、シマンドゥへの投資や労働協定は前向きな兆しを加えている。全体的な論調は否定的だが、急性の暴力や制度の崩壊は見られない。
summary.ko: 이 기간에는 일상적인 뉴스와 불법 금광 채굴에 대한 단속이 뒤섞여 있으며, 수백 명의 광부에 대한 대규모 재판과 부패 관련 혐의로 장성 1명과 청년고용기금 국장이 구금된 일이 포함된다. 외국인 광부의 대규모 추방으로 말리 및 부르키나파소와 마찰이 빚어졌으며, 시만두 투자와 노동 협약은 긍정적인 신호를 일부 더하고 있다. 전반적인 분위기는 부정적이나 급성 폭력이나 제도적 붕괴는 없다.
summary.hi: इस अवधि में नियमित समाचारों के साथ अवैध सोने के खनन पर कार्रवाई भी शामिल है, जिसमें सैकड़ों खनिकों के सामूहिक मुकदमे और भ्रष्टाचार से जुड़े आरोपों में एक जनरल तथा युवा रोजगार निधि के निदेशक की हिरासत शामिल है। विदेशी खनिकों के सामूहिक निष्कासन से माली और बुर्किना फ़ासो के साथ तनाव पैदा हुआ है, जबकि सिमांदू निवेश और एक श्रम समझौता कुछ सकारात्मक संकेत देते हैं। समग्र स्वर नकारात्मक है, लेकिन कोई तीव्र हिंसा या संस्थागत विघटन नहीं है।
summary.el: Η περίοδος συνδυάζει τακτικές ειδήσεις με περιορισμό της παράνομης εξόρυξης χρυσού, συμπεριλαμβανομένων μαζικών δικών εκατοντάδων ανθρακωρύχων και της κράτησης ενός στρατηγού και του διευθυντή του ταμείου απασχόλησης νέων για κατηγορίες που σχετίζονται με διαφθορά. Οι μαζικές απελάσεις ξένων εξορυκτών έχουν προκαλέσει τριβές με το Μάλι και το Μπουρκίνα Φάσο, ενώ οι επενδύσεις στο Simandou και ένα εργασιακό σύμφωνο προσθέτουν ορισμένα θετικά σημάδια. Συνολικά ο τόνος είναι αρνητικός, χωρίς όμως οξεία βία ή θεσμική κατάρρευση.
summary.it: Il periodo combina notizie di routine con un giro di vite contro l'estrazione illegale dell'oro, inclusi processi di massa a centinaia di minatori e il fermo di un generale e del direttore di un fondo per l'occupazione giovanile con accuse legate alla corruzione. Le espulsioni di massa di minatori stranieri hanno causato tensioni con Mali e Burkina Faso, mentre gli investimenti su Simandou e un patto sul lavoro aggiungono alcuni segnali positivi. Il tono complessivo è negativo, ma non si registrano violenze acute né crolli istituzionali.
summary.ru: Период сочетает рутинные новости с кампанией против незаконной добычи золота, включая массовые судебные процессы над сотнями старателей и задержание генерала и директора фонда содействия занятости молодежи по обвинениям, связанным с коррупцией. Массовые высылки иностранных старателей вызвали напряженность в отношениях с Мали и Буркина-Фасо, а инвестиции в Симанду и трудовое соглашение добавляют некоторые позитивные сигналы. В целом тон негативный, однако острого насилия или институционального кризиса нет.
summary.ar: تجمع الفترة بين الأخبار الروتينية وحملة على التعدين غير القانوني للذهب، بما في ذلك محاكمات جماعية لمئات عمال المناجم، واحتجاز جنرال ومدير صندوق تشغيل الشباب بتهم تتعلق بالفساد. وقد تسببت عمليات الطرد الجماعي لعمال المناجم الأجانب في توتر العلاقات مع مالي وبوركينا فاسو، فيما تضيف استثمارات سيماندو واتفاق العمل بعض المؤشرات الإيجابية. النبرة العامة سلبية، لكن لا يوجد عنف حاد ولا انهيار مؤسسي.
summary.fa: این دوره ترکیبی از اخبار معمول و سرکوب استخراج غیرقانونی طلا است، از جمله محاکمه‌های دسته‌جمعی صدها معدنچی و بازداشت یک ژنرال و مدیر صندوق اشتغال جوانان به اتهامات مرتبط با فساد. اخراج دسته‌جمعی معدنچیان خارجی با مالی و بورکینافاسو تنش ایجاد کرده، در حالی که سرمایه‌گذاری در سیماندو و توافق کاری برخی نشانه‌های مثبت می‌افزایند. لحن کلی منفی است، اما خشونت حاد یا فروپاشی نهادی وجود ندارد.

summary.tr: Trakia otoyolunda yoğun sis nedeniyle meydana gelen çok araçlı zincirleme kazada yaklaşık 11-12 kişi hayatını kaybetti, yaklaşık 50 kişi yaralandı. Bu durum bir yas günü ilan edilmesine ve devlet tazminat planlarına yol açtı. Muhalefetin bakanların istifasını talep etmesi ve kamuoyu hoşnutsuzluğuna dair uyarılar siyasi baskıyı artırıyor, ancak otoyol yeniden açıldı ve diğer haberler olağan seyrindeydi.
summary.es: Un accidente en cadena con múltiples vehículos en una densa niebla en la autopista Trakia dejó unos 11-12 muertos y unos 50 heridos, lo que llevó a declarar un día de luto y a planificar indemnizaciones estatales. La oposición exige la dimisión de los ministros y advierte del descontento público, lo que aumenta la presión política, aunque la autopista ha reabierto y el resto de noticias fue rutinario.
summary.fr: Un carambolage impliquant plusieurs véhicules dans un brouillard dense sur l'autoroute Trakia a fait environ 11 à 12 morts et une cinquantaine de blessés, ce qui a conduit à une journée de deuil national et à des projets d'indemnisation par l'État. L'opposition réclame la démission des ministres et met en garde contre le mécontentement public, ce qui accentue la pression politique, bien que l'autoroute ait rouvert et que les autres informations aient été courantes.
summary.de: Ein Massenunfall mit mehreren Fahrzeugen bei dichtem Nebel auf der Trakia-Autobahn forderte rund 11-12 Todesopfer und etwa 50 Verletzte; daraufhin wurde ein nationaler Trauertag ausgerufen und staatliche Entschädigungen wurden geplant. Die Opposition fordert den Rücktritt der Minister und warnt vor wachsender Unzufriedenheit in der Bevölkerung, was den politischen Druck erhöht; die Autobahn wurde jedoch wieder freigegeben, andere Nachrichten waren Routine.
summary.pt: Um engavelamento de múltiplos veículos em meio a neblina densa na autoestrada Trakia matou cerca de 11-12 pessoas e feriu cerca de 50, levando a um dia de luto nacional e a planos de compensação estatal. A oposição exige a renúncia dos ministros e alerta para o descontentamento público, o que aumenta a pressão política, embora a rodovia tenha sido reaberta e as demais notícias tenham sido rotineiras.
summary.it: Un tamponamento a catena di più veicoli nella fitta nebbia sull'autostrada Trakia ha causato la morte di circa 11-12 persone e il ferimento di circa 50, portando alla proclamazione di una giornata di lutto e a piani di risarcimento statale. L'opposizione chiede le dimissioni dei ministri e avverte del malcontento pubblico, aumentando la pressione politica, sebbene l'autostrada sia stata riaperta e le altre notizie fossero di routine.
summary.ru: Массовое ДТП с участием нескольких автомобилей в густом тумане на автомагистрали «Тракия» унесло жизни около 11-12 человек, около 50 получили ранения. Объявлен день траура и планируются государственные компенсации. Оппозиция требует отставки министров и предупреждает о недовольстве общества, что добавляет политического давления, хотя движение по магистрали возобновлено, а другие новости были рутинными.
summary.ar: وقع تصادم متسلسل لعدة مركبات في ضباب كثيف على الطريق السريع تراكيا، وأسفر عن مقتل نحو 11-12 شخصًا وإصابة نحو 50 آخرين، مما دفع إلى إعلان يوم حداد وخطط لتعويضات حكومية. وتطالب المعارضة باستقالة الوزراء وتحذر من استياء شعبي، ما يزيد الضغط السياسي، رغم إعادة فتح الطريق السريع، وكانت الأخبار الأخرى روتينية.
summary.fa: یک تصادف زنجیره‌ای چندخودرویی در مه غلیظ در بزرگراه تراکیا حدود 11-12 نفر را کشت و حدود 50 نفر را زخمی کرد که منجر به اعلام روز عزا و برنامه‌های جبران خسارت دولتی شد. مخالفان خواستار استعفای وزیران شده و نسبت به نارضایتی عمومی هشدار داده‌اند که فشار سیاسی را افزایش می‌دهد، هرچند بزرگراه بازگشایی شد و سایر اخبار عادی بود.
summary.zh: 在特拉基亚高速公路上，浓雾中发生多车连环追尾事故，造成约11-12人死亡、约50人受伤。政府宣布哀悼日，并计划对受害者进行国家赔偿。反对派要求部长辞职，并警告公众不满情绪，加剧了政治压力；不过高速公路已恢复通车，其他新闻均属例行报道。
summary.ja: トラキア自動車道で濃霧の中、複数車両が絡む多重衝突事故が発生し、約11〜12人が死亡、約50人が負傷した。これを受けて服喪の日が設けられ、国による被害者への補償計画も打ち出された。野党は閣僚の辞任を求め、国民の不満が高まると警告しており、政治的な緊張も強まっている。高速道路は再開されており、その他のニュースは通常通りであった。
summary.ko: 트라키아 고속도로에서 짙은 안개 속 다중 차량 추돌 사고가 발생해 약 11~12명이 숨지고 약 50명이 다쳤다. 이에 따라 하루 동안의 국가 애도 기간이 선포되었고 피해자에 대한 국가 보상 계획이 마련되었다. 야당은 장관들의 사임을 요구하고 있으며 대중의 불만이 커질 수 있다고 경고해 정치적 긴장도 더해졌다. 고속도로는 다시 개통되었으며 그 밖의 뉴스는 평상시와 같았다.
summary.hi: ट्राकिया मोटरवे पर घने कोहरे के बीच कई वाहनों की भीषण टक्कर में लगभग 11-12 लोगों की मौत हो गई और लगभग 50 लोग घायल हुए। इसके चलते एक दिन का राष्ट्रीय शोक घोषित किया गया और पीड़ितों के लिए सरकारी मुआवज़े की योजनाएँ बनाई गईं। विपक्ष ने मंत्रियों के इस्तीफ़े की माँग की है और जनता के असंतोष की चेतावनी दी है, जिससे राजनीतिक दबाव बढ़ा है। राजमार्ग दोबारा खोल दिया गया है, और अन्य समाचार सामान्य रहे।
summary.el: Μια σύγκρουση πολλών οχημάτων σε πυκνή ομίχλη στον αυτοκινητόδρομο Τρακία στοίχισε τη ζωή σε περίπου 11-12 άτομα και τραυμάτισε περίπου 50. Εξαιτίας αυτού κηρύχθηκε ημέρα εθνικού πένθους και σχεδιάστηκαν κρατικές αποζημιώσεις για τα θύματα. Η αντιπολίτευση ζητά παραιτήσεις υπουργών και προειδοποιεί για δημόσια δυσαρέσκεια, προσθέτοντας πολιτική πίεση, ενώ ο αυτοκινητόδρομος άνοιξε ξανά και οι υπόλοιπες ειδήσεις ήταν συνηθισμένες.

Тональность GDELT заметно выше среднемировой, поэтому оценка немного выше, чем в обычный день.

summary.fa: این دوره عمدتاً عادی است: اخبار مربوط به سفر و تجارت مثبت است (صندوق سازمان تجارت جهانی به ارزش ۳۰۰,۰۰۰ دلار برای مدیریت پایدار شیلات، رشد محموله‌ها، رتبه‌بندی یکی از پرمقصدترین مناطق، و زندانی شدن سرکرده یک باند)، در حالی که حوادث امنیتی، انتقادها درباره مرگ کودکان و توقف رأی‌گیری بودجه در جهت مخالف فشار می‌آورند. لحن GDELT به‌وضوح بالاتر از میانگین جهانی است، بنابراین امتیاز کمی بالاتر از یک روز معمولی قرار دارد.
summary.zh: 这一时期大体属于常规情况：旅游和贸易方面的消息偏积极（世界贸易组织设立30万美元基金用于可持续渔业管理、货运量增长、热门目的地排名、一名帮派头目入狱），而安全事件、对儿童死亡的批评以及被叫停的预算投票则产生相反影响。GDELT语气明显高于全球平均水平，因此评分略高于普通的一天。

summary.en: Forest fires in Peru have caused 12 deaths and affected more than 800 people. El Niño risk, rains in Piura and a rising teen homicide rate are also in the news. On the other hand, there are routine developments such as an increase in banana exports, a tuberculosis vaccine project and local elections, but the positive news does not offset the negative. A day somewhat below average: serious, but not at the level of a widespread crisis.

en: Forest fires leave 12 dead and more than 800 affected
El Niño warnings and heavy rains in Piura
Decade-high teen homicides in Lima
25 Peruvians dead and 187 missing in the Russian army
Banana exports up 24.6% and a tuberculosis vaccine study

summary.en: Peru's period is dominated by El Niño-related flooding and wind alerts in the north and coast, with forecasts warning that worse rains are still to come, plus an electoral recount dispute in Piura. Positive items, including the Peru-Ecuador cooperation declaration and the Andean Community presidency, do not offset the disaster risk, so the score sits below an ordinary day.

en: El Niño floods in Piura and Tumbes, with school and market closures
Senamhi warns the heaviest rains are still to come
JNE orders vote recount in Piura over damaged records

summary.en: Peru faces an El Niño threat, with flooding in Piura, red rain alerts for several regions, and warnings of a 'Mega Niño', alongside a more negative-than-average news tone. Some positives appear, including a Citi view that Peru may respond best to El Niño in Latin America and a healthcare investment milestone, but the flood and climate risks dominate, pulling the score below an ordinary day.

en: Piura flooding and street collapse, with unspent flood-fund criticism
Senamhi red and orange rain alerts and 'Mega Niño' forecasts
Citi sees Peru's El Niño economic response as strongest in Latin America

summary.en: Peru faces a strong El Niño with flooding in Piura and Tumbes, port closures from heavy swells, and 12 fire deaths, alongside ongoing extortion and armed attacks. Government responses such as a supplementary budget credit for El Niño and emergency evacuation guidance partly offset the strain, and GDELT tone is more negative than the world average.

en: Strong El Niño causing flooding in Piura and northern coast
Fires linked to El Niño leave 12 dead
75 ports closed due to anomalous swells

summary.en: Peru's period is mostly routine: preparations for the Pope's visit, a solar investment, and relief measures for El Niño and wildfire victims. Negatives include El Niño damage, forest fires, illegal mining, a police shootout and a decree-powers grant, but no crisis of mass violence or institutional breakdown appears.

en: Government announces S/2,500M in bonuses for El Niño-affected families
El Niño rains and wildfires damaging crops and communities
Fujimori gets 90 days of decree powers to legislate

summary.en: The period mixes positive economic and institutional news, including the Lote 192 oil deal, the return of Air Canada and papal visit preparations, with serious stress from extortion and kidnapping, drought, forest fires and El Niño underspending. Tone matches the world average, so the net picture is an ordinary-to-slightly-strained day.

en: Lote 192 deal: Petroloreto takes 75% and operates for 27 years
Surge in kidnapping and extortion reported by foreign media
Protests in Lima over insecurity and forest fires

summary.en: Peru's period looks broadly routine: regional election results and runoffs, preparations for the Pope's visit, and a private investment deal for Petroperú's Lot 192. Weighing against this are El Niño rains, a forest fire in Apurímac, falling cacao exports and a reported tourism decline.

en: Petroperú ceding Lot 192 to private firm with $230M investment
El Niño rains and cacao export decline
Forest fire in Apurímac needing urgent aerial aid

summary.en: The period mixes a major positive development, the confirmed Papal visit that is broadly welcomed, with weather-related disruption, including a Senamhi red alert for extreme rain across 11 departments and flooding in Tumbes. Ongoing security measures, the Petroperú restructuring and municipal election disputes add routine strain, and the news tone is less negative than the world average.

en: Confirmed Papal visit to Peru welcomed across domestic media
Senamhi red alert for extreme rain in 11 departments
Flooding and class suspensions in Tumbes and Piura

summary.en: Peru faces active flood emergencies: red-alert rains in Tumbes and Piura, a river overflow in Cusco that trapped people, and medicine shortages in the health system. Positive signals include flood-prevention expropriations, the upcoming papal visit, and steady corporate and mining news, so the overall picture is a serious but localized disaster period.

en: Red-alert rains and river overflows in Tumbes, Piura and Cusco
Kimbiri flood sweeping homes and trapping people
Medicine shortages and dengue hospitalizations in Piura

summary.en: The period is dominated by El Niño rain and heat records, flood alerts and local complaints about inadequate prevention, which weigh on the score. Partly offsetting this are preparations for the papal visit, record remittances and infrastructure investment interest, while a setback for justice in the forced sterilizations case adds to the negatives.

en: Record rainfall and flood alerts linked to El Niño across northern and coastal regions
Residents report inadequate prevention works ahead of El Niño
Heavy blow to justice in the forced sterilizations case

summary.en: Peru's period mixes routine news with forward-looking positives, including preparations for Pope Leo XIV's visit and an MEF forecast of export growth. Weather risks from El Niño, heavy rain in Piura, a heat wave, a large power outage and a dengue warning, plus a more negative-than-average news tone, offset those gains, so the day reads as roughly ordinary.

en: Papal visit preparations and planned events across the country
El Niño rain warnings for Piura and Tumbes
MEF forecast that Peru's exports will surpass Chile's

summary.en: Peru's period mixes ordinary politics with a regional flood isolating communities in Piura and Huancabamba and growing El Niño risk to growth. Positive items include an upgraded China trade deal from November 1, a pension expansion vote, and the routine proclamation of regional election results, so the balance is near a typical day.

en: River flooding isolates Huancabamba localities and blocks highway access
El Niño forecast could cut 2027 growth to 2%
Peru Upgrades China Trade Deal effective 1 November

summary.en: The period is mostly routine news: preparations for the papal visit, tourism records, and an upgraded China-Peru free trade protocol entering into force. These are offset by a significant El Niño warning, coastal swells, power cuts, and ongoing violence, but no acute crisis is reported.

en: China-Peru FTA upgrade protocol entered into force
ENFEN: extraordinary El Niño lasting until February 2027
Over 500 homicides cited amid criminal violence

summary.en: Peru faces a serious period driven by intense rains and a feared Super El Niño, with red alerts, blackouts across five northern regions, and a Senate grant of emergency powers. Inflation topping 5% and an estimated 3,200 heat-related deaths add strain, partly offset by a large mining investment and a China trade upgrade.

en: Super El Niño threat and red alert for intense rains
Senate grants emergency powers; blackouts in five northern regions
Inflation tops 5% for first time since 2023

summary.en: Heavy rains and flooding in Tumbes and Piura, red alerts across Lima and 16 regions, rising child dengue deaths and a prison riot with three dead weigh on the period. Government emergency responses, the Pope's upcoming visit and some resource and investment news partly offset this.

en: Red-alert floods in Tumbes and Piura with river overflow risk
Child dengue deaths exceed the past two years' records
Government field hospital and response measures for northern rains

summary.en: Peru faces a serious El Niño-driven emergency: a state of emergency in 1,380 districts, floods in Piura and Tumbes, and warnings of water and power shortages. Modest positives include Petroperú's profit and Alicorp's acquisition, but the disaster response dominates and the tone is clearly negative.

en: State of emergency declared in 1,380 districts over El Niño rains
Flooding in Piura and Tumbes with displaced families and emergency medical modules
Warnings of water and power shortages in Lima and other regions

summary.en: Peru's news flow is mixed: El Niño flooding, extreme heat and anomalous sea conditions are driving emergencies, and October was the most violent month of the current government, with homicides at 182. Offsetting positives include record agricultural exports, the upcoming papal visit and a large peaceful march, and GDELT tone is only moderately more negative than the world average.

en: El Niño emergencies declared in Junín and flooding across northern and Lima districts
October recorded 182 homicides, the most violent month of the current administration
Navy closed over 30 ports due to anomalous swells

summary.en: Peru's news mix is heavily negative, driven by El Niño flooding in Tumbes and dengue deaths, plus high homicide and insecurity figures during the new government's first 100 days. Positive signals include avocado export growth and the upcoming papal visit, so the score sits below a routine day.

en: Red-alert flooding in Tumbes and record Lima rainfall
Dengue: over 82,000 cases and 91 deaths in 2026
About 6 homicides per day in the first 100 days of government

summary.en: The period mixes routine news with some strengths: record-pace exports to China, a papal visit, and a clear JNE ruling on municipal re-election disputes. Against that, rain damage in Tumbes, a police officer killed in Pataz, and falling business expectations weigh on the picture, so the day is roughly ordinary.

en: Rain damage in Tumbes: one death, 324 displaced
Business expectations fall to 49.5, growing economic pessimism
Exports to China nearly match full-year 2025 in nine months

summary.en: The period mixes a serious public health problem, with dengue deaths above 100 and rising, and flood impacts with a health alert in La Libertad, against positive signals: mining exports up 45.6%, an upcoming papal visit, and institutional rulings enforcing the constitution. GDELT tone (-0.12) is considerably less negative than the world average, so the overall picture is slightly better than a typical day.

en: Dengue deaths exceed 100 and nearly double 2025 records
Mining exports rise 45.6%, dominating foreign sales
JNE rejects covert re-election and corrects proclamation records

summary.en: The period looks mostly routine, with preparations for Pope Leo XIV's visit and sports and trade news. Negative signals include El Niño impacts on fishing and an economic outlook, flooding in Huaraz, and a crime case, but no acute crisis appears in the headlines.

en: El Niño preparations: Tumbes shelters and fishing sector impact
Pope Leo XIV visit preparations across northern Peru
Electoral jury annulled mayoral re-election in a regional case

summary.en: Peru's news this period is mixed: preparations for the papal visit, a US$5.2B plan against El Niño, and US investment interest point to constructive activity. Health risks (leptospirosis, dengue deaths), a move to reconsider protections for uncontacted peoples, and a weaker copper price offset these, so the day sits modestly above an ordinary period.

en: US$5.2B government spending plan against El Niño
US firms evaluating investment in four Peruvian projects
Leptospirosis up 109% with 54 deaths in 2026

summary.en: Peru's news in this period is dominated by Pope Leo XIV's upcoming visit, a celebratory event with large expected turnout. Other signals are mixed: lower international financing rates and a court ruling blocking mayors' backdoor re-election point to stronger institutions, while Buenaventura's 6.3% share fall reflects weaker mining stocks.
summary.tr: Bu dönemde Peru haberlerine Papa XIV. Leo'nun yaklaşan ziyareti hakim; büyük katılım beklenen kutlamalı bir etkinlik. Diğer sinyaller karışık: daha düşük uluslararası finansman oranları ve belediye başkanlarının dolaylı yoldan yeniden seçilmesini engelleyen bir mahkeme kararı, kurumların güçlendiğine işaret ediyor; Buenaventura'nın %6,3'lük pay kaybı ise madencilik hisselerinin zayıfladığını yansıtıyor.
summary.es: Las noticias de Perú en este período están dominadas por la próxima visita del papa León XIV, un acontecimiento festivo con una gran afluencia prevista. Otras señales son mixtas: tasas de financiación internacional más bajas y un fallo judicial que bloquea la reelección encubierta de alcaldes apuntan a instituciones más sólidas, mientras que la caída del 6,3 % en la participación de Buenaventura refleja un peor desempeño de las acciones mineras.
summary.fr: L'actualité péruvienne de cette période est dominée par la prochaine visite du pape Léon XIV, un événement festif attendant une large affluence. Les autres signaux sont contrastés : des taux de financement international plus bas et une décision de justice bloquant la réélection détournée des maires indiquent des institutions plus solides, tandis que la baisse de 6,3 % de la part de Buenaventura reflète un affaiblissement des valeurs minières.
summary.de: Die Nachrichten aus Peru in diesem Zeitraum werden vom bevorstehenden Besuch von Papst Leo XIV. dominiert, einem festlichen Ereignis mit großem erwartetem Andrang. Andere Signale sind gemischt: niedrigere internationale Finanzierungszinsen und ein Gerichtsurteil, das die verdeckte Wiederwahl von Bürgermeistern untersagt, deuten auf stärkere Institutionen hin, während der Rückgang des Buenaventura-Anteils um 6,3 % auf schwächere Bergbauwerte hinweist.
summary.pt: As notícias do Peru neste período são dominadas pela próxima visita do Papa Leão XIV, um evento festivo com grande afluência prevista. Outros sinais são mistos: taxas de financiamento internacional mais baixas e uma decisão judicial que bloqueia a reeleição disfarçada de prefeitos apontam para instituições mais fortes, enquanto a queda de 6,3% na participação da Buenaventura reflete ações de mineração mais fracas.
summary.it: Le notizie sul Perù in questo periodo sono dominate dalla prossima visita di Papa Leone XIV, un evento celebrativo con un'ampia affluenza prevista. Gli altri segnali sono contrastanti: tassi di finanziamento internazionali più bassi e una sentenza del tribunale che blocca la rielezione indiretta dei sindaci indicano istituzioni più solide, mentre il calo del 6,3% della quota di Buenaventura riflette titoli minerari più deboli.
summary.ru: Новости о Перу в этот период определяются предстоящим визитом Папы Льва XIV, торжественным событием, на которое ожидается большая явка. Другие сигналы неоднозначны: более низкие ставки международного финансирования и решение суда, блокирующее косвенное переизбрание мэров, указывают на укрепление институтов, тогда как снижение доли Buenaventura на 6,3% отражает ослабление акций горнодобывающих компаний.
summary.ar: تهيمن على أخبار بيرو في هذه الفترة الزيارة المرتقبة للبابا لاوون الرابع عشر، وهي فعالية احتفالية يُتوقع أن يحضرها عدد كبير. أما المؤشرات الأخرى فمختلطة: فانخفاض أسعار التمويل الدولي وحكم قضائي يمنع إعادة انتخاب رؤساء البلديات بطريقة غير مباشرة يشيران إلى مؤسسات أقوى، في حين يعكس تراجع حصة Buenaventura بنسبة 6.3% ضعف أسهم التعدين.
summary.fa: اخبار پرو در این دوره عمدتاً تحت تأثیر سفر پیش‌رو پاپ لئو چهاردهم است، رویدادی جشنی با حضور گسترده پیش‌بینی‌شده. سایر نشانه‌ها مختلط‌اند: نرخ‌های پایین‌تر تأمین مالی بین‌المللی و رأی دادگاهی که انتخاب مجدد غیرمستقیم شهرداران را مسدود می‌کند، به نهادهای قوی‌تر اشاره دارند، در حالی که کاهش ۶.۳ درصدی سهم Buenaventura نشان‌دهنده ضعف سهام معدنی است.
summary.zh: 本期秘鲁新闻主要聚焦于教宗良十四世即将到来的访问，这是一场预计将吸引大量民众参与的庆祝活动。其他信号喜忧参半：国际融资利率走低，以及法院裁定禁止市长以变相方式连任，表明制度正在加强；而Buenaventura的股份下降6.3%，反映出矿业股走弱。
summary.ja: この時期のペルーのニュースは、レオ14世教皇の今後の訪問が中心となっており、多くの参加者が見込まれる祝賀行事となっています。その他の動向はまちまちで、国際的な資金調達金利の低下と、市長による裏口からの再選を阻止する裁判所の判決は制度の強化を示す一方、ブエナベントゥーラの株価が6.3%下落したことは鉱業株の弱含みを反映しています。
summary.ko: 이 기간 페루 뉴스는 레오 14세 교황의 방문 예정이 주를 이루며, 대규모 인파가 예상되는 축하 행사입니다. 다른 신호들은 엇갈립니다. 국제 자금조달 금리 하락과 시장의 편법적 연임을 막은 법원 판결은 제도의 강화를 시사하는 반면, 부에나벤투라의 6.3% 지분 하락은 광업 주식의 약세를 반영합니다.
summary.hi: इस अवधि में पेरू की ख़बरों पर पोप लियो XIV की आगामी यात्रा हावी है, जो एक उत्सव कार्यक्रम है जिसमें बड़ी भीड़ की उम्मीद है। अन्य संकेत मिश्रित हैं: अंतरराष्ट्रीय वित्तपोषण दरों में कमी और उस अदालती फ़ैसले से, जिसने मेयरों के पिछले दरवाज़े से दोबारा चुनाव को रोका, संस्थाओं के मज़बूत होने के संकेत मिलते हैं, जबकि बुएनावेंतुरा में 6.3% हिस्सेदारी की गिरावट खनन शेयरों की कमज़ोरी को दर्शाती है।
summary.el: Τις ειδήσεις του Περού αυτής της περιόδου κυριαρχεί η επερχόμενη επίσκεψη του Πάπα Λέοντα XIV, μια εορταστική εκδήλωση με μεγάλη αναμενόμενη προσέλευση. Τα υπόλοιπα σήματα είναι μικτά: τα χαμηλότερα διεθνή επιτόκια χρηματοδότησης και μια δικαστική απόφαση που εμποδίζει την επαναεκλογή δημάρχων από την πίσω πόρτα υποδεικνύουν ισχυρότερους θεσμούς, ενώ η πτώση 6,3% του μεριδίου της Buenaventura αντικατοπτρίζει τις εξασθενημένες μετοχές εξόρυξης.

summary.tr: Bosna-Hersek'te büyük ölçüde rutin bir gün: iki organize suç grubuna karşı bir polis operasyonu, Tuzla Kantonu'nda rutin bir hükümet kurulumu ve diyaliz borçlarının ödenmesi. Olumsuz gelişmeler arasında Saraybosna ve Banja Luka'daki hava kirliliği, sağlık çalışanlarının maaş protestosu ve ölümle sonuçlanan bir trafik kazası yer alıyor; bunlar puanı olağan temel düzeyin yakınında tutuyor.
summary.es: Un día en gran parte rutinario en Bosnia y Herzegovina: una operación policial contra dos grupos de crimen organizado, la formación rutinaria de un gobierno en el Cantón de Tuzla y el pago de deudas por diálisis. Entre los aspectos negativos figuran la contaminación del aire en Sarajevo y Banja Luka, una protesta de los trabajadores sanitarios por sus salarios y un accidente de tráfico mortal, que mantienen la puntuación cerca del nivel habitual.
summary.fr: Une journée largement ordinaire en Bosnie-Herzégovine : une opération policière contre deux groupes de criminalité organisée, une formation routinière du gouvernement du canton de Tuzla et le règlement de dettes liées à la dialyse. Les aspects négatifs comprennent la pollution de l'air à Sarajevo et à Banja Luka, une manifestation des personnels de santé sur les salaires et un accident de la route mortel, ce qui maintient le score proche du niveau de référence habituel.
summary.de: Ein überwiegend routinemäßiger Tag in Bosnien und Herzegowina: eine Polizeiaktion gegen zwei Gruppen der organisierten Kriminalität, eine routinemäßige Regierungsbildung im Kanton Tuzla und die Begleichung von Dialyseschulden. Negative Aspekte sind die Luftverschmutzung in Sarajevo und Banja Luka, ein Protest von Beschäftigten im Gesundheitswesen wegen der Bezahlung und ein tödlicher Verkehrsunfall, wodurch der Wert nahe am üblichen Ausgangsniveau bleibt.
summary.pt: Um dia em grande parte rotineiro na Bósnia e Herzegovina: uma operação policial contra dois grupos de crime organizado, a formação rotineira de um governo no Cantão de Tuzla e a quitação de dívidas de diálise. Entre os aspetos negativos estão a poluição do ar em Sarajevo e Banja Luka, um protesto de profissionais de saúde por salários e um acidente de trânsito fatal, o que mantém a pontuação próxima da linha de base habitual.
summary.ja: ボスニア・ヘルツェゴビナでは概ね平常通りの一日でした。組織犯罪グループ2つに対する警察の作戦、トゥズラ州での定例の政府樹立、透析費用の未払い問題の解決などが報じられました。サラエボとバニャ・ルカの大気汚染、医療従事者の賃金抗議、死亡を伴う交通事故といったマイナス要素もあり、全体のスコアは通常の基準値付近にとどまりました。
summary.ko: 보스니아 헤르체고비나는 대체로 평범한 하루를 보냈습니다. 조직범죄 단체 두 곳을 겨냥한 경찰 작전, 투즐라 주의 정례적인 정부 구성, 투석 비용 미지급 문제 해결 등이 있었습니다. 사라예보와 바냐루카의 대기오염, 의료 종사자들의 임금 항의, 사망 사고를 낸 교통사고 등 부정적 요소도 있었지만, 전체 점수는 일반적인 기준선 부근에 머물렀습니다.
summary.hi: बोस्निया और हर्जेगोविना में अधिकांशतः एक सामान्य दिन रहा: संगठित अपराध के दो गिरोहों के खिलाफ पुलिस अभियान, तुज़ला कैंटन में नियमित सरकार गठन, और डायलिसिस के बकाया भुगतान का निपटारा। नकारात्मक पहलुओं में सरायेवो और बानजा लूका में वायु प्रदूषण, स्वास्थ्यकर्मियों का वेतन को लेकर विरोध प्रदर्शन, और एक घातक सड़क दुर्घटना शामिल रहे, जिनके कारण स्कोर सामान्य आधार रेखा के आसपास बना रहा।
summary.el: Μια κατά βάση συνηθισμένη ημέρα στη Βοσνία και Ερζεγοβίνη: επιχείρηση της αστυνομίας κατά δύο οργανωμένων εγκληματικών ομάδων, τακτικός σχηματισμός κυβέρνησης στο Καντόνι Τούζλα και διευθέτηση οφειλών για αιμοδιήθηση. Τα αρνητικά στοιχεία περιλαμβάνουν τη ρύπανση του αέρα στο Σαράγεβο και στο Μπάνια Λούκα, διαμαρτυρία εργαζομένων υγείας για τις αμοιβές τους και ένα θανατηφόρο τροχαίο, γεγονός που διατηρεί τη βαθμολογία κοντά στο συνήθη επίπεδο.
summary.it: Una giornata in gran parte ordinaria in Bosnia ed Erzegovina: un'operazione di polizia contro due gruppi di criminalità organizzata, una formazione di governo di routine nel Cantone di Tuzla e il saldo dei debiti per la dialisi. Tra gli aspetti negativi figurano l'inquinamento atmosferico a Sarajevo e Banja Luka, una protesta dei lavoratori sanitari per i salari e un incidente stradale mortale, che mantengono il punteggio vicino al livello di base ordinario.
summary.ru: В целом обычный день в Боснии и Герцеговине: полицейская операция против двух организованных преступных групп, плановое формирование правительства в Тузланском кантоне и погашение задолженности за диализ. К негативным моментам относятся загрязнение воздуха в Сараево и Баня-Луке, протест медицинских работников против оплаты труда и смертельное дорожно-транспортное происшествие, что удерживает показатель близко к обычному уровню.
summary.ar: يوم عادي إلى حد كبير في البوسنة والهرسك: عملية شرطية ضد جماعتين للجريمة المنظمة، وتشكيل حكومي روتيني في كانتون توزلا، وتسوية مستحقات غسيل الكلى. وتشمل السلبيات تلوث الهواء في سراييفو وبانيا لوكا، واحتجاجًا للعاملين في القطاع الصحي على الأجور، وحادث مرور مميت، مما يُبقي المؤشر قريبًا من المستوى الأساسي المعتاد.
summary.fa: روزی عمدتاً عادی در بوسنی و هرزگوین: عملیات پلیس علیه دو گروه جنایت سازمان‌یافته، تشکیل معمول دولت در کانتون توزla و تسویه بدهی‌های دیالیز. جنبه‌های منفی شامل آلودگی هوا در سارایوو و بانجا لوکا، اعتراض کارکنان بهداشتی به دستمزد و یک تصادف رانندگی مرگبار است که امتیاز را نزدیک به سطح عادی نگه می‌دارد.
summary.zh: 波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那的一天基本属于常规：警方对两个有组织犯罪团伙展开行动，图兹拉州例行组建政府，并结清了透析欠款。负面因素包括萨拉热窝和巴尼亚卢卡的空气污染、医护人员因薪酬抗议，以及一起致命交通事故，使得评分保持在普通基线附近。

summary.it: Il periodo è per lo più di routine: una fiera EICMA da record, risultati solidi di Recordati e un FTSE MIB in lieve rialzo, controbilanciati da tensioni nella coalizione, senatori che lasciano Forza Italia e un'impennata di attacchi informatici. Il tono è meno negativo della media mondiale, quindi il punteggio si colloca appena sopra il neutro.
summary.ru: Период в основном рутинный: рекордная выставка EICMA, устойчивые результаты Recordati и слегка растущий индекс FTSE MIB, которые уравновешиваются напряжённостью в коалиции, уходом сенаторов из «Forza Italia» и резким ростом кибератак. Тон менее негативен, чем в среднем по миру, поэтому оценка немного выше нейтральной.
summary.ar: الفترة روتينية في معظمها: معرض EICMA قياسي، ونتائج قوية لشركة Recordati، وارتفاع طفيف في مؤشر FTSE MIB، تقابلها توترات داخل الائتلاف الحاكم، ومغادرة أعضاء في مجلس الشيوخ حزب Forza Italia، وارتفاع حاد في الهجمات السيبرانية. النبرة أقل سلبية من المتوسط العالمي، لذلك تقع النتيجة أعلى قليلاً من الحياد.
summary.fa: این دوره عمدتاً عادی است: نمایشگاه رکوردشکن EICMA، نتایج قوی Recordati و افزایش اندک شاخص FTSE MIB، که با تنش‌های ائتلاف، خروج سناتورها از Forza Italia و افزایش چشمگیر حملات سایبری تعدیل می‌شود. لحن آن کمتر از میانگین جهانی منفی است، از این رو امتیاز اندکی بالاتر از خنثی قرار می‌گیرد.
summary.zh: 本时期总体属于常规：EICMA展会创历史纪录，Recordati业绩稳健，富时意大利MIB指数小幅上涨，但联合政府内部紧张、参议员退出Forza Italia以及网络攻击激增部分抵消了这些利好。语气比全球平均水平负面程度低，因此评分略高于中性。
summary.ja: 今回の期間は概ね平常通りで、EICMAの展示会は過去最多を記録し、Recordatiの業績は堅調、FTSE MIBはわずかに上昇しました。一方、連立政権内の対立、Forza Italiaからの上院議員の離脱、サイバー攻撃の急増が相殺要因となりました。全体の論調は世界平均よりも否定的ではないため、スコアは中立をわずかに上回る水準です。
summary.ko: 이번 기간은 대체로 평소와 같았습니다. EICMA 전시회는 역대 최대 기록을 세웠고, Recordati의 실적은 견조했으며, FTSE MIB는 소폭 상승했습니다. 반면 연립정부 내 갈등, Forza Italia 상원의원들의 이탈, 사이버 공격의 급증이 이를 상쇄했습니다. 전반적인 어조는 세계 평균보다 덜 부정적이어서 점수는 중립보다 약간 높습니다.
summary.hi: यह अवधि ज़्यादातर सामान्य रही: EICMA मेले में रिकॉर्ड उपस्थिति, Recordati के मज़बूत नतीजे और FTSE MIB में हल्की बढ़त रही, जबकि गठबंधन में तनाव, Forza Italia के सीनेटरों का पार्टी छोड़ना और साइबर हमलों में तेज़ उछाल इसके उलट रहे। स्वर विश्व औसत से कम नकारात्मक है, इसलिए स्कोर तटस्थ से थोड़ा ऊपर है।
summary.el: Η περίοδος ήταν κυρίως συνηθισμένη: ρεκόρ στην έκθεση EICMA, σταθερά αποτελέσματα της Recordati και ελαφρά άνοδος του FTSE MIB, σε συνδυασμό με τις εντάσεις στον συνασπισμό, την αποχώρηση γερουσιαστών από τη Forza Italia και την άνοδο των κυberεπιθέσεων. Ο τόνος είναι λιγότερο αρνητικός από τον παγκόσμιο μέσο όρο, γι' αυτό η βαθμολογία βρίσκεται ελαφρώς πάνω από το ουδέτερο επίπεδο.
summary.tr: Dönem büyük ölçüde rutin seyrediyor: rekor bir EICMA fuarı, sağlam Recordati sonuçları ve hafif yükselen bir FTSE MIB; bunları koalisyondaki gerilimler, Forza Italia'dan ayrılan senatörler ve siber saldırılarda yaşanan artış dengeliyor. Ton, dünya ortalamasından daha az olumsuz olduğu için skor nötrün hemen üzerinde kalıyor.
summary.es: El periodo es en su mayoría rutinario: una feria EICMA récord, sólidos resultados de Recordati y un FTSE MIB ligeramente al alza, compensados por las tensiones en la coalición, la salida de senadores de Forza Italia y un fuerte aumento de los ciberataques. El tono es menos negativo que la media mundial, por lo que la puntuación se sitúa justo por encima de neutral.
summary.fr: La période est pour l'essentiel routinière : un salon EICMA record, de solides résultats de Recordati et un FTSE MIB en légère hausse, compensés par les tensions au sein de la coalition, le départ de sénateurs de Forza Italia et une forte hausse des cyberattaques. Le ton est moins négatif que la moyenne mondiale, de sorte que le score se situe juste au-dessus du neutre.
summary.de: Der Zeitraum verläuft überwiegend routinemäßig: eine Rekordausgabe der EICMA-Messe, solide Ergebnisse von Recordati und ein leicht steigender FTSE MIB, denen Spannungen in der Koalition, der Austritt von Senatoren aus Forza Italia und ein starker Anstieg von Cyberangriffen gegenüberstehen. Der Ton ist weniger negativ als der weltweite Durchschnitt, weshalb der Wert knapp über dem neutralen Bereich liegt.
summary.pt: O período é, em grande parte, rotineiro: uma feira EICMA recorde, resultados sólidos da Recordati e um FTSE MIB ligeiramente em alta, compensados por tensões na coalizão, pela saída de senadores da Forza Italia e por um forte aumento de ciberataques. O tom é menos negativo do que a média mundial, pelo que a pontuação fica logo acima do neutro.

summary.en: In the last 24 hours, no notable crisis or major positive development has been seen in Tunisia. The news flow consists of routine topics such as housing programmes, energy and partnership with Japan, and tourism and cultural events. Water cuts in three governorates, youth emigration trends, engineer emigration, and a claim in a single foreign source of a severe cost-of-living protest are negative, but on their own they do not amount to a serious crisis. The score has therefore been kept at the normal-period level.

en: Investment and project news in housing, energy and tourism
70th-year partnership with Japan and international economic contacts
Water cuts and infrastructure problems in three governorates
Concern over youth emigration and loss of engineers (brain drain)
Claim of a protest of thousands against cost of living (single source)

summary.en: The period is routine: budget-law announcements for hospitals, housing and schools, a new patrol boat, and ordinary water cuts and storms.
