Financiamento de US$ 2,6 milhões para um grupo de apoio à AIDS e serviços de saúde
Parcerias de mobilidade verde e preparativos para o festival That Luang

summary.en: Curfews were imposed in Paris and other cities following widespread urban violence and unrest on October 17. Prime Minister Lecornu says the curfews helped the night pass calmly, but the government is under pressure. An orange alert is in force in 7 departments in the southeast due to flooding, the CAC 40 fell more than 3% on a monthly basis, and news coverage is very negative.

en: Violent incidents on October 17 and curfews in many cities
Flooding in the southeast and orange alert in 7 departments
Government under pressure, international echo of the events and Trump's harsh statements
Monthly decline of 3.29% in the CAC 40
Calm night after the curfews and reduced tension (mitigating)

summary.en: Violent protests over the weekend of 17 October have led to a large police and troop deployment, possible curfews and a military aircraft crash, which points to serious domestic strain. Partial offsets include the Code Noir repeal, solid Bureau Veritas and Atos results, and a broadly flat CAC 40.

en: Violent protests and riots; troops and police deployed, curfews considered
Military aircraft crash between Nancy and Pont-à-Mousson under search
Parliament approves symbolic repeal of Code Noir

summary.en: Violent unrest following the 17 October mobilisation dominates coverage, with local curfews, government crisis meetings, reports of soldiers possibly being deployed, and tourism cancellations. Markets fell 1.33% on the day, and a Mediterranean storm killed four people.

en: Violent protests and local curfews after the 17 October mobilisation
Government crisis meetings at Matignon and the Élysée over the unrest
Tourism cancellations and foreign travel advisories amid the riots

summary.en: France faces serious unrest: violent protests on 17 October, a Paris curfew, a court-lifted protest ban, government moves to restrict demonstrations, and widespread looting. A likely Moody's downgrade and a storm cutting power to 161,000 homes add to the strain.

en: Violent protests, looting and clashes; Paris curfew extended
Government tightening protest curbs and deploying military
Expected Moody's downgrade over debt and political crisis

summary.en: France faces serious unrest: riots on 17 October, a new weekend of protests under a 70,000-officer police deployment, museum closures, and a fatal racist shooting near Paris. Partial offsets include Moody's holding France's rating at Aa3 and storm damage that is still mostly restorable, but the CAC 40 is down 4.19% over the month.

en: Nationwide protests and riots, with 70,000 police deployed for the weekend
Fatal racist shooting near Paris; Macron calls it terrorism
Moody's keeps France's sovereign rating at Aa3

summary.en: France saw large nationwide cost-of-living protests (about 410,000 marchers) that turned violent in Paris, with roughly 1,000 detained, alongside a deadly shooting in the Yvelines. Press reports suggest calmer scenes in some places, but the government faces pressure for political answers, and debt concerns and a weaker CAC 40 add strain.

en: Nationwide cost-of-living protests with clashes and about 1,000 arrests
Deadly Yvelines shooting described by Macron as a racist terrorist attack
Government under pressure for political responses to protesters' demands

summary.en: France faces large, sometimes violent nationwide protests, with around 1,000 arrests, tear gas and police charges reported across several outlets. A mass shooting in Yvelines and a racist attack in Trappes add to the strain, while the CAC 40 rose 0.84% on the day.

en: Nationwide protests with about 410,000 participants and clashes with police
Around 1,000 arrests and police deployment of 70,000 officers
Mass shooting ('Tuerie') in Yvelines and racist attack in Trappes

summary.en: Mass cost-of-living and student protests continue, with about 1,000 arrests in Paris and 1,314 nationwide, and the government has vowed 'strong measures'. The CAC 40 is down 3.1% over the month, though the day and week moves are small, and routine news continues alongside.

en: Nationwide protests and mass arrests over cost of living
Student unrest and university closures, with reopening promised
Macron vows strong measures against protests

summary.en: France faces serious strain over the period: foreign outlets report riots and youth protests, bond yields near 5% and falling consumer confidence. Domestic coverage is mostly routine, and the CAC 40 is roughly flat over the day but down 2.4% over the month.

en: Riots and far-left unrest reported in foreign media
Bond yields near 5% raise debt-sustainability concerns
Student and social protests, with a strike planned for 5 November

summary.en: France faces broad social strain: student blockades, riots and planned general strikes, record drought, high fuel prices and a detained diplomat in Tehran. Markets were modestly up (CAC 40 +0.98% on the day), which partly offsets the picture.

en: Student blockades and protests, with riots reported in Paris and Lyon
Unprecedented drought heading toward worsening conditions
Fuel prices forcing Secours populaire to cut food distribution rounds

summary.en: France faces growing social tension, with Gilets jaunes and union mobilisations planned for 31 October, dockers striking over the budget, and authorities warning of a 'very high' violence risk and deploying 70,000 personnel. Strong corporate results (Crédit Agricole, Capgemini) and a firm CAC 40 partly offset the negative tone, so the score sits modestly below an ordinary day.

en: Gilets jaunes and union protests planned for 31 October nationwide
Authorities warn of 'very high' violence risk, deploying 70,000 personnel
Dockers strike against government budget

summary.en: France faces nationwide youth-led protests ('acte III') with 70,000 police deployed and warnings of violence, plus a negative outlook from Fitch on its credit rating. Markets were flat and much of the local news is routine, so the score sits in the serious-concern band but short of a crisis.

en: Nationwide protests with 70,000 police mobilised for Halloween weekend
Fitch turns credit outlook negative while Moody's stays stable
Government vows tough response to renewed unrest

summary.en: France faced a third weekend of large youth-led protests, with 320,000 participants and some violence on Halloween, met by a 70,000-strong police deployment. Fitch revised its outlook to negative, and GDELT tone is notably more negative than the world average, though the CAC 40 was flat and some foreign coverage called the unrest overstated.

en: Third weekend of large youth-led protests, about 320,000 participants
Violent unrest on Halloween and heavy 70,000-officer police deployment
Fitch revises France's rating outlook to negative

summary.en: Youth-led protests with police clashes and a Molotov attack on officers continued over the weekend, but foreign reports say violence was easing and schools were returning calmly. Domestic news is otherwise routine, and the CAC 40 rose modestly, so the day sits somewhat below an ordinary one.

en: Youth protests with violence easing as students return to school
779 arrests reported after weekend protests
Attempted murder probe into Molotov attack on police

summary.en: The period mixes routine news with moderate unrest: student school protests resumed on a smaller scale, and there were Paris riots and a racist attack in Trappes. Market data is steady (CAC 40 up 1.79% over the week) and one corporate update was strong, but the overall tone is more negative than the world average.

en: Student school protests resumed in dozens of schools after holidays
Paris riots with petrol bomb attack on an officer
Trappes racist attack and calls to ban a TV channel

summary.en: France faced student blockades of dozens of schools over education reforms ahead of a general strike, with reports of protesters injured by police weapons. Markets rose (CAC 40 +1.31% on the day) and the Mediterranean flood and drought stories are routine, so the overall picture is mildly negative.

en: Student blockades of dozens of schools over education reforms
Reports of protesters injured by weapons and tactics
CAC 40 up 1.31% on the day

summary.en: France faces a large nationwide strike and protests on 5 November, with about 800,000 expected and 70,000 police deployed, amid budget deadlock and controversy over house-arrest orders for protesters. Market indicators are positive (CAC 40 up 0.7% on the day) and some corporate results are strong, which keeps the score above the serious-crisis range.

en: Nationwide strike and mass protests with heavy police deployment
Budget deadlock and pressure on the Macron government
Controversy over house-arrest orders against protesters

summary.en: France saw its largest nationwide protests in years on 5 November, with about 1.6 million marching over wages and strikes, 448 arrests, and 53 police injured, though many marches were largely peaceful. Two deaths in Corsica floods and a one-day CAC 40 drop of 1.65% add to the strain.

en: Mass nationwide wage and strike protests, 1.6 million reported participants
448 arrests and 53 police officers injured in protests
Two deaths in Corsica flooding amid orange alerts

summary.en: France saw a third wave of cost-of-living protests, with large police deployments, 448 arrests and reported officer injuries, alongside debt-cost worries in foreign coverage. Markets were mixed but up over the week and month, so the picture is serious social tension rather than a full crisis.

en: Nationwide cost-of-living protests with 448 arrests and 70,000 police deployed
Reports of 193 protests and 100+ officers injured on Black Thursday
Foreign coverage of rising French debt costs and stability concerns

summary.en: Foreign media report multiple days of mass protests in Paris and other cities, with clashes, property damage and police bans on gatherings, a serious strain on public order. Domestic coverage is mostly routine, and the CAC 40 is up over the month, which tempers the score.

en: Mass protests with violent clashes and shop damage in Paris
Police bans on gatherings; protests continue despite them
Routine domestic news and a monthly CAC 40 gain limit the downgrade

summary.en: The period mixes routine news with social tension: a government-convened social conference is responding to public anger, and an EU report describes past riots. Markets were up (CAC 40 +0.71% on the day, +5% on the month) and the G7 meeting in Paris points to normal diplomacy, but negative tone and a plant closure weigh on the score.

en: Government social conference at Matignon responding to public anger
EU report on Russian networks exploiting French riots
CAC 40 gains over the day and month

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: the Banque de France expects France to avoid a Q4 recession and the CAC 40 rose over the week and month. Offsetting this are student protests and a strike, a diplomatic row with Iran over a cyberattack, and more negative foreign tone than average.

en: Banque de France says recession likely avoided in Q4
CAC 40 up 3.85% on the week and 6.74% on the month
Lycée and education strikes and protests continue with concessions called insufficient

summary.en: The period is mostly routine Armistice Day coverage, with the CAC 40 up 1.6% over the week and 6.1% over the month. Diplomatic friction over the alleged Iranian cyberattack on supermarket freezers and an unannounced US military landing at Istres push the news tone somewhat more negative than average.
summary.tr: Dönem büyük ölçüde 11 Kasım Ateşkes Günü'nün rutin haberleriyle geçiyor; CAC 40 haftalık bazda %1,6, aylık bazda ise %6,1 yükseldi. Süpermarket dondurucularına yönelik iddia edilen İran siber saldırısı ve Istres'e önceden haber verilmeden inen ABD askeri uçağı diplomatik gerilimi artırarak haber tonunu ortalamanın biraz daha olumsuz kılıyor.
summary.es: El periodo está dominado en su mayoría por la cobertura rutinaria del Día del Armisticio, y el CAC 40 subió un 1,6 % en la semana y un 6,1 % en el mes. La fricción diplomática por el presunto ciberataque iraní a congeladores de supermercados y el aterrizaje sin previo aviso de una aeronave militar estadounidense en Istres hacen que el tono informativo sea algo más negativo de lo habitual.
summary.fr: La période est essentiellement marquée par la couverture habituelle de la fête de l'Armistice, le CAC 40 ayant progressé de 1,6 % sur la semaine et de 6,1 % sur le mois. Les tensions diplomatiques liées à la cyberattaque iranienne présumée contre des congélateurs de supermarchés et l'atterrissage non annoncé d'un avion militaire américain à Istres rendent le ton de l'actualité un peu plus négatif que la moyenne.
summary.de: Der Zeitraum ist überwiegend von der routinemäßigen Berichterstattung zum Tag des Waffenstillstands geprägt; der CAC 40 legte in der Woche um 1,6 % und im Monat um 6,1 % zu. Diplomatische Spannungen wegen des mutmaßlichen iranischen Cyberangriffs auf Supermarkt-Tiefkühltruhen und der unangekündigten Landung eines US-Militärflugzeugs in Istres machen den Nachrichtenton etwas negativer als üblich.
summary.pt: O período é, em grande parte, marcado pela cobertura rotineira do Dia do Armistício, com o CAC 40 em alta de 1,6% na semana e de 6,1% no mês. O atrito diplomático em torno do suposto ciberataque iraniano a freezers de supermercados e a aterrissagem não anunciada de uma aeronave militar dos EUA em Istres tornam o tom das notícias um pouco mais negativo que a média.
summary.ja: この期間は主に例年どおりの休戦記念日の報道が中心で、CAC 40は週間で1.6%、月間で6.1%上昇した。スーパーマーケットの冷凍設備を狙ったとされるイランによるサイバー攻撃をめぐる外交摩擦と、イストルへの米軍機の事前通告なしの着陸により、ニュースの論調は平均よりやや否定的になっている。
summary.ko: 이번 기간은 대부분 일상적인 휴전기념일 보도로 이루어졌으며, CAC 40 지수는 일주일간 1.6%, 한 달간 6.1% 상승했다. 슈퍼마켓 냉동고를 겨냥했다는 이란의 사이버 공격 의혹을 둘러싼 외교적 마찰과 사전 통보 없이 이루어진 미 군용기의 이스트르 착륙으로 뉴스 논조는 평균보다 다소 부정적이다.
summary.hi: यह अवधि ज़्यादातर सामान्य युद्धविराम दिवस (Armistice Day) की कवरेज से भरी है, जिसमें CAC 40 सप्ताह में 1.6% और महीने में 6.1% चढ़ा। सुपरमार्केट फ्रीज़र पर कथित ईरानी साइबर हमले को लेकर कूटनीतिक तनाव और इस्त्र (Istres) में बिना सूचना के अमेरिकी सैन्य विमान की लैंडिंग के कारण समाचार का स्वर औसत से कुछ अधिक नकारात्मक है।
summary.el: Η περίοδος αφορά κυρίως τη συνήθη κάλυψη της Ημέρας Ανακωχής, με τον δείκτη CAC 40 να ανεβαίνει 1,6% μέσα στην εβδομάδα και 6,1% μέσα στον μήνα. Η διπλωματική ένταση για την υποτιθέμενη ιρανική κυberεπίθεση σε καταψύκτες σουπερμάρκετ και η μη ανακοινωθείσα προσγείωση αμερικανικού στρατιωτικού αεροσκάφους στο Istres κάνουν τον τόνο των ειδήσεων κάπως πιο αρνητικό από το συνηθισμένο.
summary.it: Il periodo è caratterizzato per lo più da una copertura di routine della Giornata dell'Armistizio, con il CAC 40 in rialzo dell'1,6% nella settimana e del 6,1% nel mese. Le tensioni diplomatiche legate al presunto attacco informatico iraniano contro i congelatori di un supermercato e all'atterraggio non annunciato di un velivolo militare statunitense a Istres rendono il tono delle notizie leggermente più negativo della media.
summary.ru: Период в основном характеризуется рутинным освещением Дня перемирия: индекс CAC 40 вырос на 1,6% за неделю и на 6,1% за месяц. Дипломатическая напряжённость из-за предполагаемой кибератаки Ирана на морозильные камеры супермаркета и неанонсированной посадки американского военного самолёта в Истре делают общий тон новостей несколько более негативным, чем обычно.
summary.ar: تغطي الفترة في معظمها أخبار يوم الهدنة المعتادة، مع ارتفاع مؤشر CAC 40 بنسبة 1.6% خلال الأسبوع و6.1% خلال الشهر. ويدفع الاحتكاك الدبلوماسي بشأن الهجوم الإلكتروني المزعوم الذي نفذته إيران على مجمدات أحد السوبرماركتات، وهبوط طائرة عسكرية أمريكية دون إشعار في إستر، نبرة الأخبار إلى أن تكون أكثر سلبية بقليل من المعتاد.
summary.fa: این دوره عمدتاً شامل پوشش معمول روز آتش‌بس است و شاخص CAC 40 در طول هفته ۱٫۶ درصد و در طول ماه ۶٫۱ درصد افزایش یافته است. تنش‌های دیپلماتیک بر سر حمله سایبری ادعایی ایران به یخچال‌های یک فروشگاه زنجیره‌ای و فرود بدون اطلاع قبلی یک هواپیمای نظامی آمریکا در استر، لحن اخبار را کمی منفی‌تر از میانگین کرده است.
summary.zh: 该时段主要为例行的停战日报道，CAC 40指数一周上涨1.6%，一个月上涨6.1%。关于伊朗涉嫌对一家超市冷柜实施网络攻击的外交摩擦，以及一架美国军机在伊斯特尔未经通知降落，使新闻基调比平均水平略显负面。

summary.zh: 这一时期的报道以例行新闻为主：粮食收获报告表现强劲、国家授奖，以及与俄罗斯和委内瑞拉关系的深化，另有关于白俄罗斯可能主办乌克兰和平谈判的讨论。负面信号仅限于外国媒体关于军事化以及将人士贴上“极端分子”标签的报道，尚不构成危机。
summary.ja: 期間の報道は定例的な内容が中心である。好調な穀物収穫報告、国家表彰、ロシアおよびベネズエラとの関係強化に加え、ベラルーシがウクライナ和平交渉の開催地となる可能性についての話題もある。否定的な材料は、軍事化や「過激派」と分類された人々に関する海外報道に限られており、危機とみなすほどのものではない。
summary.ko: 해당 기간의 보도는 대체로 일상적인 내용이 중심을 이룬다. 곡물 수확 보고서의 호조, 국가 시상, 러시아 및 베네수엘라와의 관계 심화에 더해, 벨라루스가 우크라이나 평화 회담의 개최지가 될 수 있다는 논의도 있다. 부정적 신호는 군사화 및 '극단주의자'로 분류된 사람들에 관한 해외 보도에 국한되며, 이는 위기 수준에 이르지 않는다.
summary.hi: इस अवधि में अधिकतर नियमित समाचार कवरेज है: फसल की मजबूत रिपोर्ट, राज्य पुरस्कार, और रूस तथा वेनेज़ुएला के साथ गहरे होते संबंध, साथ ही इस चर्चा कि बेलारूस यूक्रेन शांति वार्ता की मेज़बानी कर सकता है। नकारात्मक संकेत केवल सैन्यीकरण और 'चरमपंथी' कहे गए लोगों पर विदेशी रिपोर्टों तक सीमित हैं, जो किसी संकट के बराबर नहीं हैं।
summary.el: Η περίοδος κυριαρχείται από συνηθισμένη κάλυψη: μια ισχυρή έκθεση για τη συγκομιδή σιτηρών, κρατικές διακρίσεις, και εμβαθυνόμενες σχέσεις με τη Ρωσία και τη Βενεζουέλα, καθώς και συζήτηση για το ενδεχόμενο η Λευκορωσία να φιλοξενήσει διαπραγματεύσεις ειρήνης για την Ουκρανία. Τα αρνητικά σήματα περιορίζονται σε ξένες αναφορές για τη στρατιωτικοποίηση και για άτομα που χαρακτηρίζονται «εξτρεμιστές», που δεν ισοδυναμούν με κρίση.
summary.tr: Dönem büyük ölçüde rutin haberlerle öne çıkıyor: güçlü bir hasat raporu, devlet ödülleri ve Rusya ile Venezuela ile derinleşen ilişkiler; ayrıca Belarus'un Ukrayna barış görüşmelerine ev sahipliği yapabileceğine dair söylentiler. Olumsuz sinyaller yalnızca yabancı kaynaklı askerileştirme ve 'aşırıcı' olarak etiketlenen kişilere ilişkin haberlerle sınırlı; bunlar bir krize dönüşmüş değil.
summary.es: El período está dominado por la cobertura rutinaria: un sólido informe de cosecha, premios estatales y lazos más estrechos con Rusia y Venezuela, además de conversaciones sobre la posible organización por parte de Bielorrusia de negociaciones de paz con Ucrania. Las señales negativas se limitan a informes extranjeros sobre militarización y sobre personas etiquetadas como 'extremistas', que no constituyen una crisis.
summary.fr: La période est dominée par une couverture de routine : un solide bilan de récolte, des distinctions d'État et un renforcement des liens avec la Russie et le Venezuela, ainsi que des spéculations sur une éventuelle organisation par la Biélorussie de pourparlers de paix sur l'Ukraine. Les signaux négatifs se limitent à des rapports étrangers sur la militarisation et sur des personnes qualifiées d'« extrémistes », qui ne constituent pas une crise.
summary.de: Der Berichtszeitraum wird von routinemäßiger Berichterstattung dominiert: ein starker Erntebericht, staatliche Auszeichnungen und vertiefte Beziehungen zu Russland und Venezuela, dazu Gerüchte, Belarus könnte Friedensgespräche zur Ukraine ausrichten. Negative Signale beschränken sich auf ausländische Berichte über Militarisierung und über als „Extremisten“ bezeichnete Personen, die keine Krise darstellen.
summary.pt: O período é dominado por cobertura rotineira: um forte relatório de safra, premiações estatais e laços aprofundados com a Rússia e a Venezuela, além de conversas sobre a possível realização pela Bielorrússia de negociações de paz para a Ucrânia. Os sinais negativos limitam-se a relatos estrangeiros sobre militarização e sobre pessoas rotuladas como 'extremistas', que não configuram uma crise.

summary.en: In Lebanon, Israeli strikes in the south, accusations against the Lebanese army over Hezbollah's weapons, and domestic tension in Beirut (Fanar tunnel) continue. Positive signs include Qatar's proposal for a power plant and gas agreement, Arab League and international diplomatic support, and increased army patrols. However, the fragile post-war situation, concern over a security gap after the end of UNIFIL, and economic difficulties keep the score low.

summary.ja: レバノンでは、南部へのイスラエルの攻撃、国連平和維持部隊への攻撃、そしてベイルートで元イラク議員が殺害された事件が一日の主な出来事となった。国連ミッションの終了に伴う治安の空白への懸念も高まっている。小さな前向きな動きとして、銀行危機をめぐるIMFとの初期協議や季節的な観光客の増加も見られたが、全体としては深刻な治安上の緊張が続いている。
summary.ko: 레바논에서는 남부 지역에 대한 이스라엘의 공습, 유엔 평화유지군에 대한 공격, 그리고 베이루트에서 전직 이라크 의원이 살해된 사건이 이날의 주요 뉴스였다. 유엔 임무가 종료되면서 치안 공백에 대한 우려도 커지고 있다. 은행 위기와 관련한 IMF와의 초기 협의, 계절적 관광객 증가 등 소폭의 긍정적 신호도 있었으나, 전반적으로 심각한 안보 긴장 상황이 이어지고 있다.
summary.hi: लेबनान में दिन की मुख्य घटनाएँ दक्षिण में इज़राइली हमले, संयुक्त राष्ट्र शांति सेना पर गोलीबारी और बेरूत में एक पूर्व इराकी सांसद की हत्या रहीं। संयुक्त राष्ट्र मिशन के समाप्त होने के साथ सुरक्षा शून्यता को लेकर चिंता भी बढ़ रही है। बैंकिंग संकट पर IMF के साथ शुरुआती बातचीत और मौसमी रूप से पर्यटकों के आगमन में वृद्धि जैसे मामूली सकारात्मक संकेत भी रहे, लेकिन कुल मिलाकर तस्वीर गंभीर सुरक्षा तनाव की है।
summary.el: Η ημέρα στον Λίβανο κυριάρχησε από ισραηλινά πλήγματα στο νότο, επιθέσεις εναντίον δυνάμεων ειρηνευτών των Ηνωμένων Εθνών και τη δολοφονία ενός πρώην Ιρακινού βουλευτή στη Βηρυτό. Αυξάνεται επίσης η ανησυχία για κενό ασφαλείας καθώς λήγει η αποστολή του ΟΗΕ. Μικρές θετικές εξελίξεις αποτέλεσαν οι πρώιμες συνομιλίες με το ΔΝΤ για την τραπεζική κρίση και η εποχική αύξηση των αφίξεων, όμως συνολικά η εικόνα είναι σοβαρής πίεσης για την ασφάλεια.
summary.it: La giornata in Libano è stata dominata dagli attacchi israeliani nel sud, dai peacekeeper dell'ONU finiti sotto il fuoco e dall'uccisione di un ex deputato iracheno a Beirut, mentre cresce la preoccupazione per un vuoto di sicurezza con la fine della missione ONU. Modesti segnali positivi includono i primi colloqui con il FMI sulla crisi bancaria e un aumento stagionale degli arrivi, ma il quadro generale è quello di una grave pressione sulla sicurezza.
summary.ru: День в Ливане был отмечен израильскими ударами на юге, обстрелом миротворцев ООН и убийством бывшего иракского депутата в Бейруте, а также растущей обеспокоенностью из-за вакуума безопасности по мере завершения миссии ООН. Скромные позитивные моменты включали первые переговоры с МВФ по банковскому кризису и сезонный рост числа прибывающих, однако общая картина свидетельствует о серьёзном напряжении в сфере безопасности.
summary.ar: طغت على يوم لبنان الغارات الإسرائيلية في الجنوب، وتعرض قوات حفظ السلام التابعة للأمم المتحدة لإطلاق النار، ومقتل نائب عراقي سابق في بيروت، مع تزايد القلق من فراغ أمني مع انتهاء مهمة الأمم المتحدة. ومن الإيجابيات المحدودة بدء محادثات أولية مع صندوق النقد الدولي بشأن الأزمة المصرفية، وارتفاع موسمي في عدد الوافدين، لكن الصورة العامة تعكس ضغطًا أمنيًا خطيرًا.
summary.fa: روز لبنان بیشتر تحت تأثیر حملات هوایی اسرائیل در جنوب، شلیک به نیروهای حافظ صلح سازمان ملل و قتل یک نماینده سابق پارلمان عراق در بیروت بود، و نگرانی فزاینده‌ای درباره خلأ امنیتی با پایان یافتن ماموریت سازمان ملل وجود دارد. نکات مثبت محدودی نیز دیده می‌شد، از جمله آغاز گفت‌وگوهای اولیه با صندوق بین‌المللی پول درباره بحران بانکی و افزایش فصلی ورود گردشگران، اما تصویر کلی حاکی از فشار جدی امنیتی است.
summary.zh: 黎巴嫩当天的新闻主要包括以色列对南部的袭击、联合国维和人员遭到炮火袭击，以及一名前伊拉克议员在贝鲁特被杀，同时随着联合国任务即将结束，人们对安全真空的担忧日益加深。一些积极信号包括与国际货币基金组织就银行业危机举行了初步会谈，以及季节性游客人数有所回升，但总体形势表明安全压力十分严峻。
summary.tr: Lübnan'ın gününe güney Lübnan'daki İsrail saldırıları, ateş altında kalan BM barış gücü askerleri ve Beyrut'ta eski bir Iraklı milletvekilinin öldürülmesi hakim oldu. BM misyonunun sona ermesiyle birlikte güvenlik boşluğuna ilişkin endişeler de arttı. Mütevazı olumlu gelişmeler arasında bankacılık krizine ilişkin erken IMF görüşmeleri ve mevsimsel bir ziyaretçi artışı yer aldı, ancak genel tablo ciddi bir güvenlik baskısını gösteriyor.
summary.es: La jornada en Líbano estuvo dominada por los ataques israelíes en el sur, los cascos azules de la ONU bajo fuego y el asesinato de un antiguo legislador iraquí en Beirut, junto con una creciente preocupación por un vacío de seguridad a medida que termina la misión de la ONU. Entre los pequeños aspectos positivos figuraron las primeras conversaciones con el FMI sobre la crisis bancaria y un aumento estacional de llegadas, pero el panorama general es de una grave presión en materia de seguridad.
summary.fr: La journée au Liban a été dominée par les frappes israéliennes dans le sud, les casques bleus de l'ONU pris pour cible et l'assassinat d'un ancien député irakien à Beyrouth, sur fond de préoccupation croissante face à un vide sécuritaire à l'approche de la fin de la mission de l'ONU. Quelques éléments positifs modestes ont été relevés, notamment les premiers pourparlers avec le FMI sur la crise bancaire et une hausse saisonnière des arrivées de touristes, mais le tableau général reflète de sérieuses tensions sécuritaires.
summary.de: Der Tag im Libanon wurde geprägt von israelischen Angriffen im Süden, Beschuss von UN-Friedenstruppen und der Tötung eines früheren irakischen Abgeordneten in Beirut; zugleich wächst die Sorge vor einem Sicherheitsvakuum, da das UN-Mandat ausläuft. Bescheidene positive Signale waren erste Gespräche mit dem IWF zur Bankenkrise und ein saisonbedingter Anstieg der Ankünfte, doch insgesamt zeigt sich ein ernsthafter Sicherheitsdruck.
summary.pt: O dia no Líbano foi dominado por ataques israelenses no sul, por patrulhas da ONU alvo de disparos e pelo assassinato de um antigo deputado iraquiano em Beirute, enquanto cresce a preocupação com um vácuo de segurança à medida que a missão da ONU chega ao fim. Positivos modestos incluíram as primeiras conversas com o FMI sobre a crise bancária e um aumento sazonal de chegadas, mas o quadro geral é de forte pressão na segurança.

en: Israeli strikes in south Lebanon and UNIFIL patrols under fire
Former Iraqi lawmaker found dead in Beirut after reported kidnapping
G7 warns of security vacuum as UNIFIL mandate nears end
ja: レバノン南部でのイスラエルによる攻撃とUNIFILのパトロール部隊への攻撃
元イラク議員が、誘拐されたと報じられた後にベイルートで遺体で発見された

전직 이라크 의원, 납치 보도 이후 베이루트에서 사망한 채 발견

hi: दक्षिणी लेबनान में इज़राइली हमले और UNIFIL की गश्त पर गोलीबारी

Ex deputato iracheno trovato morto a Beirut dopo un presunto rapimento
Il G7 avverte di un vuoto di sicurezza mentre il mandato dell'UNIFIL si avvicina alla scadenza

summary.en: Panama is experiencing the effects of the strong earthquake of 9 October: about 11,460 people were affected, more than 8,000 children need humanitarian assistance, ground collapse and tsunami-related displacement in Isla Cañas, a road blocked by a landslide, and damaged schools and health facilities are reported. Aftershocks are decreasing, and reconstruction, the gradual reopening of schools and international aid are ongoing, which signals recovery. For a large-scale disaster period, the upper part of the 'serious problems' band is appropriate, because state institutions are functioning and economic indicators (financial inclusion, services trade) are positive.

en: Humanitarian impact after the earthquake: 11,460 affected, more than 8,000 children in need of assistance
Infrastructure damage: El Valle de Antón road closed for one month, damaged schools and polyclinics
Recovery efforts: housing reconstruction, gradual reopening of schools, decreasing aftershocks, international support
Pressure of drought on the canal and supply chain
Positive economic news: third place in financial inclusion, record services trade

summary.en: A magnitude 5.4 earthquake damaged homes, schools and institutions in Herrera, Coclé and Veraguas, and recovery is underway with schools reopening and aid arriving. Record Canal traffic offsets the damage, but the drought and rising femicide figures weigh on the score.

en: Earthquake damage in Herrera, Coclé and Veraguas, with reconstruction under way
Record annual Panama Canal traffic reported by foreign media
Water shortage and drought constraining the Canal's operations

summary.en: Panama is recovering from a recent earthquake, with housing inspections, rebuilding of the first 31 homes, and relief efforts under way, while the Canal posted record FY2026 revenue of $6.6 billion and record cargo. Tone is more negative than the global average, and the earthquake, dengue deaths and El Niño alerts weigh on the score, but the response appears to be functioning.

en: Earthquake damage: 47 critical road points and 23 bridges need repair
Canal de Panamá record revenue of $6.6 billion, up 16.6%
Reconstruction started; 9,391 homes under evaluation

summary.en: A magnitude 7.7 earthquake on the Azuero peninsula caused two deaths, damage in Penonomé and school closures affecting over 3,000 students, and reports say over 37,000 people were affected. This is offset by strong economic news: Canal of Panama revenue up 16%, WEF investment promotion, and a cabinet budget move.

en: Magnitude 7.7 earthquake; 37,000+ affected, two deaths
Penonomé cancels November celebrations after quake damage
Canal revenue up 16%; traffic and tonnage rising

summary.en: Panama is in the aftermath of a major magnitude 7.5 earthquake in the Azuero region, with damaged churches, shelters and reconstruction measures under way. Foreign aid, tax relief and positive economic items (canal traffic, coffee) partly offset the disaster and ongoing gang killings.

en: Major earthquake aftermath in Azuero with reconstruction and shelter needs
Foreign medical and financial aid, including Costa Rican mission and donations
Canal traffic and tonnage rose in fiscal 2026

summary.en: Panama is recovering from a recent earthquake, with international relief, a US$310M credit line for small firms, and ECLAC raising its 2026 growth forecast to 4.5%. Damage to schools and churches and water contamination weigh against these positives, so the day sits modestly above an ordinary period.

en: ECLAC raises Panama 2026 growth forecast to 4.5%
US$310M credit opens for small firms after quake
Foreign and UAE relief aid launched for earthquake victims

summary.en: Panama is recovering from a strong earthquake in the Azuero region, with reconstruction, school-year plans and mass meals for displaced people underway, plus a landslide at a former gold mine. Routine positives such as the World of Coffee event, Cobre Panamá hiring and sports results offset part of the disaster coverage, and press-freedom complaints add some strain.

en: Earthquake in Azuero causing displacement and reconstruction needs
Education ministry three-phase plan to save the school year
Landslide at quake-hit former gold mine threatening water sources

summary.en: A significant earthquake has damaged infrastructure and affected over 37,000 people, with over 1,000 aftershocks and temporary electoral sites set up. Offsetting this, the Line 3 Metro tunnel boring milestone, an approved port environmental impact study, and aid from companies show functioning institutions, and GDELT tone is milder than the world average.

en: Earthquake damage with over 37,000 people affected
Metro Line 3 tunnel excavation completed under the Canal
Corporate aid and temporary electoral sites after quake damage

summary.en: Panama's news over the period is mostly routine, with positive economic items such as Maersk's port commitment, the Puerto Barú environmental approval and improving Canal watershed conditions. Ongoing seismic activity, a new magnitude 5.6 tremor with evacuations and over 1,000 aftershocks, weighs against these gains.

en: Repeated magnitude 5.6 tremors and over 1,000 aftershocks weeks after the earthquake
Maersk commits to operating Panamanian ports permanently
Canal watershed improves and last-minute reservations restored

summary.en: Panama is in earthquake recovery, with the government funding 2,700 replacement homes and shelters being activated, alongside routine positive economic and diplomatic news such as Cobre Panamá hiring, canal advisory meetings and foreign ministerial visits. Negatives include an embezzlement arrest, scaled-back marina rebuilding and a new tremor, but overall the tone is better than the world average.

en: Government plans 2,700 homes and loans for earthquake reconstruction
Cobre Panamá surpasses 2,500 hires
Canal advisory board and strategic project meetings with Mulino

summary.en: Panama's news over the period is mostly routine, with positive diplomatic and economic items: German aid after the Azuero earthquake, support for leaving the EU tax list, and expanded Cobre Panamá hiring. Offsetting concerns include aftershocks, a 32-homicide rise in three provinces, and rising environmental crime.

en: German humanitarian aid sent after Azuero earthquake
Germany backs Panama's exit from EU tax list
Cobre Panamá hiring rises above 2,600 workers

summary.en: A magnitude 7.7 earthquake killed at least three people and forced demolition of historic buildings in Penonomé, and a Panamanian-flagged ship was attacked and set on fire off Oman. Offsetting this, the canal strategy, the US$35.1B budget advancing and diplomatic overtures such as offering to host US-Cuba talks show ordinary governance continuing.

en: Magnitude 7.7 earthquake; three deaths confirmed
Penonomé buildings made uninhabitable and slated for demolition
Panamanian-flagged vessel attacked and set on fire off Oman

summary.en: A series of strong earthquakes (reported up to magnitude 7.5 in one headline) hit Panama, with at least three deaths, power outages in Cañas, hospital evacuation protocols and damage assessments underway. Routine economic news, such as export growth and Canal transit increases, partly offsets the disaster, but the period is dominated by a major natural disaster.

en: Series of strong earthquakes with at least three reported deaths
Power outages in Cañas and hospital evacuation protocols activated
Government assessing earthquake damage; Metro briefly suspended then resumed

summary.en: Panama's last 24 hours mix earthquake recovery work, a water crisis in Azuero, drought effects on the Canal and Metro equipment failures with routine positive economic news (exports up 17.2%, a larger IMA budget). Tone is slightly less negative than the world average, so the period reads as close to ordinary with a mild negative lean from the earthquake and infrastructure problems.

en: Post-earthquake reconstruction jobs and aid efforts underway
Azuero water crisis and drought effects on the Canal
Exports up 17.2% and IMA budget tripled

summary.en: Panama is recovering from a recent earthquake: headlines describe a paralyzed capital, a rebuilding plan covering about 2,700 homes costing roughly $81 million, and international humanitarian aid. Routine National Day events, a flash flood and a malaria case add to the strain, though the overall tone is less negative than average.

en: Earthquake damage: rebuilding plan for about 2,700 homes
Capital described as paralyzed after the earthquake
International humanitarian aid delivered after the quake

summary.en: Panama's 3 November national day coverage is largely routine and upbeat, with US congratulations, a foreign investment deal (Alicorp buying Flora Food Group) and a reconstruction pledge after a recent earthquake. The lingering earthquake damage and a large drug seizure keep the score from being higher, and GDELT tone (-0.33) is slightly less negative than the world average.

en: Mulino pledges reconstruction of homes, hospitals and schools after earthquake
Alicorp acquires Flora Food Group for over $150 million
Trump and Rubio congratulate Panama on national day and cooperation

summary.en: Panama's day was mostly routine, with steady economic news such as record exports, Canal terminal tender progress and a large electrical investment. Earthquake recovery and fault-line warnings add some strain, but metro service was restored and there was no acute crisis.

en: Canal terminal bidder shortlist and expansion plans advancing
Ongoing quake recovery: damaged schools delayed to March 2027
Metro service restored after Arraiján tremor

summary.en: Panama's period mixes positive institutional and investment news, including the European Investment Bank and EU financial arm choosing Panama as regional headquarters and canal terminal bidding advancing, with a notable earthquake affecting about 21,000 people. GDELT tone is close to the world average, so the net picture is a slightly positive ordinary day.

en: EIB and EU financial arm set regional headquarters in Panama
Earthquake affecting over 21,000 people per MIDES
Canal terminal bidders and Metro Line 3 progress

summary.en: Panama's period mixes ongoing earthquake recovery, with aftershocks, displaced residents and road repairs, and a spike in violence with eight deaths, against positive diplomatic and institutional news such as Singapore joining the Canal neutrality treaty and the EIB opening a regional office. The mildly negative GDELT tone, better than the world average, points to a roughly ordinary day.

en: Singapore joins Panama Canal neutrality treaty
EIB opens regional office in Panama
Ongoing earthquake recovery and aid, with 55,000 displaced

summary.en: Panama's recent news mixes an earthquake aftermath, strained emergency response, and a dispute over the Río Indio reservoir with routine items: port tenders, sports wins and steady growth. GDELT tone is less negative than the world average, so the period looks close to ordinary with some stress.

en: Earthquake aftermath and strained Sinaproc emergency resources
Río Indio campesino opposition to reservoir project
Canal port terminal tender and steady growth, though credit lags

summary.en: Panama is a month past a magnitude 7.5 earthquake, with reconstruction slow (about 1,900 homes in Veraguas still to rebuild) but recovery signals emerging, such as schools reopening and US geologists being sent. Otherwise the news is routine: investment, congress tourism and trade-diplomacy items.

en: Ongoing post-earthquake housing emergency with about 1,900 homes unrepaired
Schools in Bocas del Toro, Chiriquí and Ngäbe Buglé reopening for in-person classes
US geologists sent to investigate fault lines after the quake

summary.en: The period is mostly routine, with recovery from the Coclé earthquake advancing through reconstruction contracts and housing work, and the Canal raising daily transits and draft after drought limits. Offsetting concerns include the 22.1% export decline and the scale of earthquake damage, so the score sits modestly above an ordinary day.

en: Canal raises daily transits to 34 and draft to 50 feet
Government awards $90.5M in earthquake housing reconstruction contracts
Over 40,000 homes affected by earthquake; reconstruction underway

summary.en: Panama's news over the period is mixed but leans modestly positive: the Canal raised daily transits to 34, tourism grew 14%, and a record Geisha coffee price was reported. Offsetting this are earthquake recovery problems in Coclé and a dispute over US remarks on joint control of the Canal, which Panama rejected.
summary.it: Le notizie sul Panama nel periodo sono miste ma tendono moderatamente al positivo: il Canale ha portato i transiti giornalieri a 34, il turismo è cresciuto del 14% ed è stato riportato un prezzo record per il caffè Geisha. A controbilanciare ci sono i problemi di ricostruzione dopo il terremoto nella provincia di Coclé e una disputa per le dichiarazioni statunitensi sul controllo congiunto del Canale, che Panama ha respinto.
summary.ru: Новости о Панаме за этот период неоднозначны, но в целом умеренно позитивны: Панамский канал увеличил количество ежедневных проходов до 34, туризм вырос на 14%, и сообщалось о рекордной цене на кофе «Гейша». Этому противостоят проблемы с восстановлением после землетрясения в провинции Кокле и спор из-за заявлений США о совместном контроле над каналом, которые Панама отвергла.
summary.ar: أخبار بنما خلال الفترة متباينة لكنها تميل بشكل معتدل نحو الإيجابية: رفعت قناة بنما عدد عبورها اليومي إلى 34، ونما قطاع السياحة بنسبة 14%، وأُفيد عن سعر قياسي لقهوة جيشا. ويقابل ذلك مشكلات التعافي من الزلزال في إقليم كوكلي، وخلاف حول تصريحات أمريكية بشأن السيطرة المشتركة على القناة، رفضتها بنما.
summary.fa: اخبار پاناما در این دوره متفاوت است اما به‌طور متوسط به سمت مثبت متمایل است: کانال پاناما تعداد عبور روزانه را به 34 رساند، گردشگری 14% رشد کرد و قیمت رکوردی برای قهوه گیشا گزارش شد. در مقابل، مشکلات بازسازی پس از زمین‌لرزه در کوکله و اختلاف بر سر اظهارات آمریکا درباره کنترل مشترک کانال وجود دارد که پاناما آن را رد کرد.
summary.zh: 期间巴拿马的新闻好坏参半，但总体略偏正面：巴拿马运河将每日通行量提高至34艘次，旅游业增长14%，并报道了创纪录的瑰夏咖啡价格。与之相抵的是科克莱省地震后的恢复问题，以及美国关于运河共同控制权言论引发的争议，巴拿马已对此予以拒绝。
summary.ja: パナマのこの期間のニュースは賛否が入り混じるものの、やや前向きな傾向にある。パナマ運河庁は1日の通航隻数を34隻に引き上げ、観光は14%増加し、ゲイシャ種コーヒーの過去最高価格が報告された。一方で、コクレ州における地震からの復旧の問題や、運河の共同管理に関する米国の発言をめぐる対立があり、パナマはこの発言を拒否した。
summary.ko: 파나마의 이 기간 뉴스는 엇갈리지만 완만하게 긍정적인 편입니다. 파나마 운하청은 일일 통행 선박 수를 34척으로 늘렸고, 관광은 14% 성장했으며, 게이샤 커피의 최고가 기록이 보고되었습니다. 반면 코클레 지역의 지진 복구 문제와 운하 공동 통제에 관한 미국의 발언을 둘러싼 분쟁이 상쇄 요인으로 작용했으며, 파나마는 이를 거부했습니다.
summary.hi: पनामा की इस अवधि की ख़बरें मिली-जुली हैं, पर थोड़ा सकारात्मक झुकाव रखती हैं। नहर ने प्रतिदिन के जहाज़ों की संख्या बढ़ाकर 34 कर दी, पर्यटन में 14% की वृद्धि हुई, और गीशा कॉफ़ी की रिकॉर्ड कीमत की रिपोर्ट मिली। इसके विपरीत कोक्ले में भूकंप के बाद पुनर्वास की समस्याएँ हैं, और नहर के संयुक्त नियंत्रण पर अमेरिकी बयानों को लेकर विवाद है, जिसे पनामा ने खारिज कर दिया।
summary.el: Οι ειδήσεις για τον Παναμά την περίοδο αυτή είναι μικτές, με μετρίως θετική κατεύθυνση: η Διώρυγα αύξησε τις ημερήσιες διελεύσεις σε 34, ο τουρισμός αυξήθηκε κατά 14% και αναφέρθηκε νέο ρεκόρ τιμής για τον καφέ Geisha. Αντισταθμιστικά, υπάρχουν προβλήματα ανάκαμψης μετά τον σεισμό στην Coclé και διαφωνία για δηλώσεις των ΗΠΑ σχετικά με τον κοινό έλεγχο της Διώρυγας, τις οποίες ο Παναμάς απέρριψε.
summary.tr: Panama'nın bu dönemdeki haberleri karışık, ancak hafif bir olumlu eğilim taşıyor: Kanal günlük geçiş sayısını 34'e çıkardı, turizm %14 büyüdü ve rekor bir Geisha kahvesi fiyatı bildirildi. Buna karşılık Coclé'de deprem sonrası toparlanma sorunları ve ABD'nin Kanal'ın ortak kontrolüne ilişkin açıklamalarıyla ilgili, Panama'nın reddettiği bir anlaşmazlık var.
summary.es: Las noticias de Panamá en el periodo son mixtas, pero se inclinan moderadamente hacia lo positivo: el Canal elevó a 34 los tránsitos diarios, el turismo creció un 14 % y se informó de un precio récord para el café Geisha. Como contrapeso, persisten los problemas de recuperación tras el terremoto en Coclé y una disputa por declaraciones de EE. UU. sobre el control conjunto del Canal, que Panamá rechazó.
summary.fr: Les nouvelles de Panama sur la période sont mitigées mais penchent légèrement vers le positif : le Canal a porté à 34 le nombre de transits quotidiens, le tourisme a progressé de 14 % et un prix record du café Geisha a été signalé. En contrepoids, les difficultés de reconstruction après le séisme à Coclé et un différend sur des propos américains concernant le contrôle conjoint du Canal, que Panama a rejeté.
summary.de: Die Nachrichten aus Panama sind in diesem Zeitraum gemischt, tendieren aber leicht ins Positive: Der Kanal erhöhte die täglichen Durchfahrten auf 34, der Tourismus wuchs um 14 %, und ein Rekordpreis für Geisha-Kaffee wurde gemeldet. Dem stehen Probleme beim Wiederaufbau nach dem Erdbeben in Coclé und ein Streit über US-Äußerungen zur gemeinsamen Kontrolle des Kanals gegenüber, die Panama zurückwies.
summary.pt: As notícias do Panamá no período são mistas, mas inclinam-se moderadamente para o positivo: o Canal elevou para 34 as travessias diárias, o turismo cresceu 14% e foi relatado um preço recorde para o café Geisha. Por outro lado, há problemas de recuperação após o terremoto em Coclé e uma disputa sobre declarações dos EUA a respeito do controle conjunto do Canal, que o Panamá rejeitou.

ONU Turismo reports 14% tourism growth in Panama
Rejection of Hegseth remarks on shared control of the Canal

summary.en: In Suriname, there is no notable crisis in the past 24 hours; the news consists mostly of routine local events such as traffic accidents, fires, robberies, and an eviction ultimatum to illegal settlers in the Masonia area. In contrast, news of Sunny Point gaining access to clean drinking water, an investment of 600,000 euros in emergency care training, relations with Vietnam and Spain, and mining investment is mildly positive. The overall picture reflects an ordinary period.

Traffic accidents, drownings, armed incidents, fires and robberies (routine crime and safety news)

summary.en: Suriname's day was mixed: S&P raised its credit rating from CCC+ to B-, a clear economic positive confirmed by foreign media. Against that, several violent incidents (a triple fatal stabbing, mob violence) and a hospital service cutback weigh on the score, though most other headlines are routine.
summary.tr: Surinam'ın günü karışık geçti: S&P kredi notunu CCC+'dan B-'ye yükseltti; bu, yabancı basında da teyit edilen açık bir ekonomik olumlu gelişme. Buna karşılık, birden fazla şiddet olayı (üç kişinin öldüğü bıçaklama ve kalabalık şiddeti) ile bir hastane hizmetinin azaltılması skoru aşağı çekiyor, ancak diğer manşetlerin çoğu rutin nitelikte.
summary.es: La jornada en Surinam fue mixta: S&P elevó su calificación crediticia de CCC+ a B-, un claro factor económico positivo confirmado por medios extranjeros. En cambio, varios incidentes violentos (una puñalada mortal triple y violencia de turba) y un recorte de servicios hospitalarios pesan sobre el balance, aunque la mayoría de los demás titulares son rutinarios.
summary.fr: La journée au Suriname a été contrastée : S&P a relevé sa note de crédit de CCC+ à B-, un signal économique positif clairement confirmé par la presse étrangère. En revanche, plusieurs incidents violents (un triple coup de couteau mortel et des violences de foule) et une réduction de services hospitaliers pèsent sur le bilan, même si la plupart des autres titres sont de routine.
summary.de: Der Tag in Suriname verlief gemischt: S&P hob das Kreditrating von CCC+ auf B- an, ein eindeutig positives wirtschaftliches Signal, das auch ausländische Medien bestätigen. Dagegen belasten mehrere gewalttätige Vorfälle (eine dreifache tödliche Messerattacke und Gewalt durch einen Mob) sowie eine Kürzung von Krankenhausdiensten die Bilanz, während die meisten übrigen Schlagzeilen routinemäßig sind.
summary.pt: O dia no Suriname foi misto: a S&P elevou a classificação de crédito de CCC+ para B-, um claro fator econômico positivo confirmado pela imprensa estrangeira. Por outro lado, vários incidentes violentos (um esfaqueamento triplamente fatal e violência de multidão) e um corte de serviços hospitalares pesam no balanço, embora a maioria das outras manchetes seja de rotina.
summary.ja: スリナムの一日は好悪入り混じるものだった。S&Pが格付けをCCC+からB-に引き上げ、これは外国メディアも確認した明確な経済的好材料である。一方で、複数の暴力事件(三人が死亡した刺傷事件、群衆による暴力)や病院の診療縮小が評価を押し下げている。ただし、その他の見出しの大半は通常の報道である。
summary.ko: 수리남의 하루는 엇갈렸다. S&P가 신용등급을 CCC+에서 B-로 상향 조정했으며, 이는 외국 언론도 확인한 분명한 경제적 긍정 요인이다. 반면 여러 건의 폭력 사건(3명이 사망한 칼부림, 군중 폭력)과 병원 진료 축소가 평가를 짓누르고 있으나, 그 밖의 대부분의 헤드라인은 일상적인 보도다.
summary.hi: सूरीनाम के लिए दिन मिश्रित रहा: S&P ने उसकी साख रेटिंग CCC+ से बढ़ाकर B- कर दी, जो एक स्पष्ट आर्थिक सकारात्मक संकेत है और जिसकी पुष्टि विदेशी मीडिया ने भी की। इसके विपरीत, कई हिंसक घटनाएँ (तीन लोगों की जानलेवा चाकूबाज़ी और भीड़ की हिंसा) और एक अस्पताल में सेवा कटौती स्कोर पर भारी पड़ती हैं, हालाँकि अधिकांश अन्य सुर्खियाँ सामान्य हैं।
summary.el: Η ημέρα για το Σουρινάμ ήταν μικτή: ο S&P αναβάθμισε την πιστοληπτική του αξιολόγηση από CCC+ σε B-, μια σαφώς θετική οικονομική εξέλιξη που επιβεβαιώθηκε από ξένα μέσα ενημέρωσης. Αντίθετα, αρκετά βίαια περιστατικά (μαχαιρωμα με τρεις νεκρούς, βία όχλου) και η περικοπή υπηρεσιών σε νοσοκομείο βαραίνουν την εικόνα, αν και οι περισσότεροι άλλοι τίτλοι είναι συνηθισμένοι.
summary.it: La giornata in Suriname è stata mista: S&P ha alzato il rating creditizio del Paese da CCC+ a B-, un chiaro segnale economico positivo confermato dai media esteri. Al contrario, diversi episodi di violenza (un accoltellamento con tre vittime e violenza di massa) e una riduzione dei servizi ospedalieri pesano sul bilancio, anche se la maggior parte degli altri titoli è di routine.
summary.ru: День в Суринаме был противоречивым: S&P повысило кредитный рейтинг страны с CCC+ до B-, что является явным позитивным экономическим сигналом, подтвержденным зарубежными СМИ. Однако несколько насильственных инцидентов (нападение с ножом с тремя погибшими, самосуд толпы) и сокращение больничных услуг снижают общую оценку, хотя большинство остальных новостей рутинны.
summary.ar: كان يوم سورينام متبايناً: رفعت وكالة S&P تصنيفها الائتماني للدولة من CCC+ إلى B-، وهو مؤشر اقتصادي إيجابي واضح أكدته وسائل الإعلام الأجنبية. في المقابل، تثقل عدة حوادث عنف (طعن أسفر عن ثلاث وفيات وعنف جماعي) وتقليص خدمات أحد المستشفيات على التقييم العام، غير أن معظم العناوين الأخرى روتينية.
summary.fa: روز سورینام ترکیبی بود: موسسه S&P رتبه اعتباری این کشور را از CCC+ به B- ارتقا داد که یک نکته مثبت اقتصادی آشکار است و رسانه‌های خارجی آن را تأیید کرده‌اند. در مقابل، چند حادثه خشونت‌آمیز (چاقوکشی با سه کشته و خشونت جمعی) و کاهش خدمات یک بیمارستان بر امتیاز کلی اثر منفی دارد، اما بیشتر تیترهای دیگر عادی هستند.
summary.zh: 苏里南当天的消息喜忧参半：标普将该国信用评级从CCC+上调至B-，这是明确的经济利好，并获得外国媒体证实。另一方面，多起暴力事件（一起造成三人死亡的刺伤事件和暴徒暴力）以及一家医院服务削减拖累了整体评价，不过其他大部分新闻都属常规报道。

en: S&P credit rating upgrade from CCC+ to B-
Triple fatal stabbing and mob violence reported
Surgical patients referred away from Diakonessenhuis hospital
tr: S&P'nin kredi notunu CCC+'dan B-'ye yükseltmesi
Üç kişinin öldüğü bıçaklama ve kalabalık şiddeti bildirildi
Cerrahi hastaların Diakonessenhuis hastanesinden başka yerlere yönlendirilmesi
es: Mejora de la calificación crediticia de S&P de CCC+ a B-
Reportan una puñalada mortal triple y violencia de turba
Pacientes quirúrgicos derivados fuera del hospital Diakonessenhuis
fr: Relèvement de la note de crédit par S&P de CCC+ à B-
Triple coup de couteau mortel et violences de foule signalés
Patients chirurgicaux réorientés loin de l'hôpital Diakonessenhuis
de: Heraufstufung des S&P-Kreditratings von CCC+ auf B-
Dreifache tödliche Messerattacke und Mob-Gewalt gemeldet
Chirurgische Patienten werden vom Krankenhaus Diakonessenhuis weiterverwiesen
pt: Elevação da classificação de crédito da S&P de CCC+ para B-
Relatado esfaqueamento triplamente fatal e violência de multidão
Pacientes cirúrgicos encaminhados para fora do hospital Diakonessenhuis
ja: S&Pによる格付けの引き上げ（CCC+からB-へ）
三人が死亡した刺傷事件および群衆による暴力が報じられる
ディアコネセンハイス病院で外科手術の患者が他施設へ回される
ko: S&P의 신용등급 상향 조정(CCC+에서 B-로)
3명이 사망한 칼부림 사건과 군중 폭력 보도
디아코네센하위스 병원에서 외과 수술 환자들이 다른 곳으로 이송됨
hi: S&P द्वारा साख रेटिंग में सुधार, CCC+ से B- तक
तीन लोगों की मौत वाली चाकूबाज़ी और भीड़ की हिंसा की रिपोर्ट
डियाकोनेसेनहुइस अस्पताल से सर्जरी के मरीजों को अन्यत्र भेजा गया
el: Αναβάθμιση πιστοληπτικής αξιολόγησης από τον S&P, από CCC+ σε B-
Αναφορές για μαχαίρωμα με τρεις νεκρούς και βία όχλου
Ασθενείς χειρουργικής μεταφέρθηκαν από το νοσοκομείο Diakonessenhuis σε άλλα ιδρύματα
it: Miglioramento del rating creditizio di S&P da CCC+ a B-
Segnalati un accoltellamento con tre vittime e violenza di massa
Pazienti chirurgici rinviati altrove dall'ospedale Diakonessenhuis
ru: Повышение кредитного рейтинга S&P с CCC+ до B-
Сообщения о нападении с ножом с тремя погибшими и самосуде толпы
Направление пациентов хирургического профиля из больницы Diakonessenhuis в другие учреждения
ar: ترقية S&P للتصنيف الائتماني من CCC+ إلى B-
الإبلاغ عن طعن أسفر عن ثلاث وفيات وعنف جماعي
تحويل مرضى الجراحة بعيداً عن مستشفى Diakonessenhuis

گزارش چاقوکشی با سه کشته و خشونت جمعی
ارجاع بیماران جراحی از بیمارستان دیاکونسهوئیس به جای دیگر
zh: 标普将信用评级从CCC+上调至B-
报道一起造成三人死亡的刺伤事件及暴徒暴力
外科患者被转往其他医院，Diakonessenhuis医院服务缩减

summary.en: The period is largely routine: news on aviation safety and trade cooperation with Canada, tourism and investment is positive. On the other hand, deaths in security operations, the killing of a police officer, power outages and strikes over high prices, along with mass deportation procedures, form a counterbalancing negative load. There is no clear crisis; positive and negative elements balance each other.

en: Aviation safety and trade cooperation agreement with Canada
Death of 11 suspects in the operation in Santiago and the toughness of the security plan
Power outages in San Francisco de Macorís and surrounding areas, and a strike against prices
Deportation of about 3,000 Haitians in two days
Tourism and investment news (Accor, Breeze, Hyatt)

summary.en: The period is largely routine: investment and tourism announcements (Accor, Four Seasons), a labour inspection of Chinese-owned stores, and ongoing security operations. A strike in San Francisco de Macorís with reported detentions is the main tension, and overall tone is less negative than the world average.

en: Strike in San Francisco de Macorís intensifies with reported detentions
Accor announces hotel projects with over 5,000 rooms
Labour ministry inspects 24 Chinese-owned stores over violations

summary.en: A mostly routine day: heavy-rain alerts and flooding in Santiago and the north, plus a killing in Nagua and a police chief accused over deaths. Partly offset by the resumption of mango exports to the US, areas returning to normal after earlier disruption, and ordinary investment and culture news. GDELT tone is more negative than the world average, but the headlines show no crisis.

en: Heavy rains and flood alerts across many provinces
Police chief accused over deaths; Nagua killing investigation
Mango exports to US set to resume

summary.en: The period is dominated by a rain event (vaguada) that affected about 1,793 people and 358 homes in Puerto Plata, with alerts in 22 to 23 provinces, a moderate weather disaster. Otherwise the news is routine, with positive investment and aviation items and a Haiti border security concern, and GDELT tone is slightly less negative than the world average.

en: Vaguada rains affecting about 1,793 people and 358 homes in Puerto Plata
COE alerts across 22 to 23 provinces for flood risk
Investment promotion and airline growth headlines (BCRD award, Arajet Mexico)

summary.en: The period was dominated by heavy-rain alerts that affected about 2,360 people and 590 homes, though authorities later scaled alerts back to two provinces. Otherwise the news was routine: migration enforcement, border troop deployments, tourism and agriculture items, and a relatively mild news tone.

en: Rain flooding affected 2,360 people and 590 homes
COE reduced emergency alerts to two provinces and the Distrito Nacional
Border troop deployment above 10,000 amid Haiti situation

summary.en: A largely routine day in the Dominican Republic, with the most notable development being an official report of a 17% drop in the cumulative homicide rate versus 2025. Smaller items included a rice-farmer march, border reinforcement along Haiti, and a foreign report on Dominican men allegedly recruited into the Russian army, against a mildly negative news tone.

en: Official report: homicide rate down 17% versus 2025
Routine DNCD drug arrests in Distrito Nacional
Rice producers march in Nagua over government protection

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: weather alerts from a trough, social-program and infrastructure announcements, and sports and trade news. It is weighed down by a border reinforcement against the Haiti crisis, a brutal murder case, and a fatal police confrontation, and the news tone is somewhat more negative than the world average.

en: Deployment of two battalions and artillery to the Haiti border
Weather alerts for 14-16 provinces from a trough
Brutal decapitation murder of mother and daughter

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: rain-related yellow alerts and flooding affected a few hundred people and damaged about 100 homes, with a border reinforcement against Haiti and a large contraband seizure. Positive notes include the exit from the FAO Hunger Map and the opening of the World Police Games, which offset the weather impacts.

en: Yellow weather alerts and flooding affecting 412 people
Exit from FAO Hunger Map announced
World Police Games inaugurated with 32 countries

summary.en: The period is dominated by heavy rains and weather alerts across many provinces, with a foreign report of flood deaths and damaged homes. Offsetting this are positive development stories, including FAO recognition after the country left the Hunger Map, new cold-storage investment, and vocational training integration.

en: Rain alerts in up to 18 provinces; flood risk in vulnerable zones
Reported flood deaths and destroyed homes in DR and Haiti
FAO recognition for exiting the Hunger Map

summary.en: Heavy rains and flooding displaced about 2,670 people, closed highways and suspended classes, and prompted government aid operations. Offsetting this, the country exited the FAO Hunger Map and reported US$4.5 billion in investment, with routine arms seizures and parliamentary cooperation deals.

en: Flooding displaces 2,670 people and closes Autopista del Nordeste
FAO hails Dominican exit from Hunger Map
Foreign investment reaches US$4.5 billion

summary.en: A mostly routine day with moderate rain-related flooding affecting about 2,600 people, met with food aid and alerts, alongside positive news of a first-ever World Baseball Classic-style U18 qualification and new trade ties with Portugal. GDELT tone is slightly more negative than the world average, which keeps the score near neutral.

en: Rains isolate 51 communities and affect over 2,600 people
Historic first qualification for U18 Baseball World Cup
Food aid deployed in flood-affected provinces

summary.en: The period is largely routine: weather alerts, tourism and investment announcements, and public works. Negative items include a US embassy warning on drugging and robbery of travellers, a prison escape, and debate over security plans, which offset positive items such as US praise as a counter-cartel ally and a new cruise port opening.

en: US embassy warnings on drugging and robbery of tourists
US praise of Dominican Republic as anti-cartel ally
New cruise port opening and tourism investment announcements

summary.en: A routine day in the Dominican Republic, dominated by government school and training-centre inaugurations and a central bank decision to hold rates. Migration enforcement and a US crime advisory are mild negatives, and the GDELT tone is slightly positive.

en: Government inaugurates schools and Infotep training centre in San Pedro de Macorís
Central bank holds monetary policy rate amid international uncertainty
Large migration enforcement operations detain over 2,000 irregular foreigners

summary.en: The period was mostly routine with clear positives: the country was promoted to British investors, was reported as having left the FAO Hunger Map, and tourism was described as strong. Flood alerts, gang-related killings in Bávaro and mass detentions of migrants weigh against this, and the negative news tone is more pronounced than the world average.

en: Dominican Republic removed from FAO Hunger Map, tied to tourism
Investment promotion in London as a trusted partner
Flood and heavy-rain alerts from Indomet across provinces

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: investment promotion, a government BPO hiring subsidy, Accor hotel projects, and easing weather alerts. Offsetting negatives include police operations with several deaths, a US security alert for travellers, and rising fuel-price concerns, so the score sits slightly above an ordinary day.

en: Dominican Republic offers three-month subsidized BPO hiring
Accor signs more than 20 hotel projects in the country
Police operations leave several suspects dead; further deaths reported

summary.en: The period is mostly routine news, with a clear positive from Fitch's upgrade of the sovereign rating to BB with a stable outlook, plus new energy-storage and logistics investment. Offsetting concerns are a detained protest leader in Puerto Plata (later freed), prison incidents in Najayo, and a security threat case against the president, which keep the score moderate.

en: Fitch upgrades sovereign credit rating to BB, stable outlook
Acciona and DP World investments in storage and Caucedo warehouses
Puerto Plata protest leaders detained then freed; Najayo prison incidents

summary.en: A mostly routine day, with investment promotion, praise for economic stability and diversity, and rehabilitation of irrigation systems. The foiled alleged plot against President Abinader and a poverty statistic weigh slightly negative, and GDELT tone is less negative than the world average.

en: Foreign investment promotion and BP chairman praising the country's stability
Alleged plot against President Abinader foiled; suspect held and raids conducted
Official data showing high poverty concentration in Gran Santo Domingo and the border

summary.en: A routine day in the Dominican Republic: the opposition criticised the government over the high cost of living, and there were heavy-rain alerts and migration enforcement. Positive business and investment items, such as a Banreservas award and a cruise deal, roughly balance these concerns, and nothing suggests an institutional or security crisis.

en: Opposition criticism of cost of living and government responsiveness
Migration enforcement and deportation figures reported
Banreservas named bank of the year; AIDA 10-year cruise deal

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: weather alerts, cultural and business news, and tourism growth such as a large cruise-passenger week. Negatives are limited to a prison riot with one death, a court-ordered liquidation of Falcondo, and an unverified audio story involving the president, so the score sits slightly above an ordinary day.

en: Strong cruise tourism: over 56,000 passengers in one week
Court orders Falcondo liquidation, a modest economic setback
Prison riot in Nagua leaves one dead, several injured

summary.en: The period was largely routine: a localized power outage, rain alerts, a traffic accident involving beauty pageant figures, and ordinary law-enforcement and court items. No clear crisis or major institutional shift appears in the headlines, and the negative GDELT tone is only a secondary signal.

en: Localized power outage in Bahoruco and Independencia communities
Traffic accident injuring Miss RD Universo and a pageant trainer
Routine arrests, seizures and court rulings; rain alerts ended

summary.en: The period was largely routine: government inaugurations and investments in schools, offices, health and farm equipment, alongside scheduled power outages. The main negative items were an investigation into an alleged plot against President Abinader and complaints about blackouts and water, which the justice system is handling. GDELT tone is close to the world average.

en: Government inaugurations and health and education investments in Monseñor Nouel
Scheduled blackouts and water-supply complaints in several provinces
Justice investigating ten people over an alleged plot against the president

summary.en: A routine day in the Dominican Republic: security operations, prison and hospital construction, reforestation, and expanded trade finance from Banreservas and IFC. Mild negatives include inflation rising to 5.14% on fuel and a diplomatic spat with China, which keep the score only slightly above an ordinary day.

en: Banreservas and IFC expand trade finance support
Inflation rises to 5.14%, driven by fuel
China-US dispute over a factory closure in the country

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: positive items include a US official praising the closure of an illegal factory, a Banreservas-IFC trade finance deal, and an Olympic gold medal. Offsetting these are an alleged plot against the president, a dengue surge, feminicides, and criticism of the new ID card's security.
summary.it: Il periodo è per lo più di routine: tra gli elementi positivi figurano un funzionario statunitense che elogia la chiusura di una fabbrica illegale, un accordo di finanziamento del commercio tra Banreservas e IFC e una medaglia d'oro olimpica. Di segno opposto, un presunto complotto contro il presidente, un aumento dei casi di dengue, femminicidi e critiche alla sicurezza della nuova carta d'identità.
summary.ru: Период в целом проходит в штатном режиме: к позитивным событиям относятся высокая оценка со стороны представителя США закрытия нелегальной фабрики, сделка Banreservas и IFC по торговому финансированию и олимпийская золотая медаль. Этому противостоят сообщения о предполагаемом заговоре против президента, рост числа случаев лихорадки денге, феминициды и критика безопасности новой идентификационной карты.
summary.ar: الفترة روتينية في معظمها: من الأخبار الإيجابية إشادة مسؤول أمريكي بإغلاق مصنع غير قانوني، واتفاقية تمويل تجاري بين بانريزيرفاس ومؤسسة التمويل الدولية، وميدالية ذهبية أولمبية. وفي المقابل، مؤامرة مزعومة ضد الرئيس، وارتفاع حاد في حالات حمى الضنك، وجرائم قتل النساء، وانتقادات لأمان بطاقة الهوية الجديدة.
summary.fa: این دوره بیشتر عادی است: از موارد مثبت می‌توان به تمجید یک مقام آمریکایی از تعطیلی یک کارخانه غیرقانونی، توافق تأمین مالی تجاری میان بانک Banreservas و IFC، و یک مدال طلای المپیک اشاره کرد. در مقابل، توطئه ادعایی علیه رئیس‌جمهور، افزایش شدید موارد تب denge، قتل‌های زنان و انتقادها از امنیت کارت شناسایی جدید قرار دارند.
summary.zh: 这一时期大多属于常规新闻：积极方面包括一名美国官员赞扬关闭一家非法工厂、Banreservas与国际金融公司达成贸易融资协议，以及一枚奥运金牌。与之相抵的是涉嫌针对总统的阴谋、登革热激增、女性遭杀害事件，以及对新身份证安全性的批评。
summary.ja: 今回の期間はおおむね平穏な日常で、前向きな出来事には、米国当局者による違法工場閉鎖への評価、バンレservasとIFCによる貿易金融の合意、そしてオリンピックの金メダルがあります。一方で、大統領に対する陰謀の疑惑、デング熱の急増、女性に対する殺人事件、そして新しいIDカードの安全性に対する批判が、これらを相殺しています。
summary.ko: 이번 기간은 대체로 평범한 일상이 이어졌습니다. 긍정적인 소식으로는 한 미국 관리가 불법 공장 폐쇄를 높이 평가한 일, Banreservas와 IFC의 무역금융 합의, 그리고 올림픽 金메달 소식이 있었습니다. 반면 대통령을 겨냥한 음모 혐의, 뎅기열 급증, 여성 살해 사건, 새 신분증의 보안성에 대한 비판은 이러한 긍정적 소식을 상쇄했습니다.
summary.hi: इस अवधि में ज़्यादातर सामान्य घटनाक्रम रहा। सकारात्मक खबरों में एक अमेरिकी अधिकारी द्वारा अवैध कारखाने के बंद होने की सराहना, Banreservas और IFC का व्यापार वित्त समझौता, और एक ओलंपिक स्वर्ण पदक शामिल हैं। इनके विपरीत, राष्ट्रपति के खिलाफ कथित साजिश, डेंगू में उछाल, स्त्री-हत्याएं और नए पहचान पत्र की सुरक्षा पर आलोचना जैसी खबरें हैं।
summary.el: Η περίοδος είναι κυρίως ρουτινική. Τα θετικά στοιχεία περιλαμβάνουν έναν Αμερικανό αξιωματούχο που επαινεί το κλείσιμο ενός παράνομου εργοστασίου, μια συμφωνία χρηματοδότησης εμπορίου μεταξύ Banreservas και IFC, και ένα χρυσό μετάλλιο στους Ολυμπιακούς Αγώνες. Αντισταθμίζονται από μια φερόμενη συνωμοσία κατά του προέδρου, μια έξαρση του dengue, γυναικοκτονίες και κριτική για την ασφάλεια της νέας ταυτότητας.
summary.tr: Dönem genel olarak rutin seyrediyor: olumlu gelişmeler arasında bir ABD yetkilisinin yasa dışı bir fabrikanın kapatılmasını övmesi, Banreservas-IFC ticari finansman anlaşması ve bir Olimpiyat altın madalyası yer alıyor. Bunların karşısında ise cumhurbaşkanına yönelik iddia edilen bir komplo, dengue salgınında artış, kadın cinayetleri ve yeni kimlik kartının güvenliğine yönelik eleştiriler bulunuyor.
summary.es: El periodo transcurre en gran medida con normalidad: entre los aspectos positivos figuran un funcionario estadounidense que elogia el cierre de una fábrica ilegal, un acuerdo de financiamiento comercial entre Banreservas y la IFC, y una medalla de oro olímpica. Frente a ello, se registran una presunta conspiración contra el presidente, un aumento de los casos de dengue, feminicidios y críticas a la seguridad de la nueva cédula de identidad.
summary.fr: La période est globalement routinière : parmi les éléments positifs, un responsable américain salue la fermeture d'une usine illégale, un accord de financement du commerce entre Banreservas et l'IFC, et une médaille d'or olympique. En revanche, on relève un prétendu complot contre le président, une forte hausse des cas de dengue, des féminicides et des critiques sur la sécurité de la nouvelle carte d'identité.
summary.de: Der Zeitraum verläuft überwiegend routinemäßig: Zu den positiven Meldungen zählen ein US-Beamter, der die Schließung einer illegalen Fabrik lobt, eine Handelsfinanzierungsvereinbarung zwischen Banreservas und der IFC sowie eine olympische Goldmedaille. Dem gegenüber stehen ein mutmaßlicher Anschlagsplan gegen den Präsidenten, ein Anstieg der Denguefälle, Feminizide und Kritik an der Sicherheit des neuen Personalausweises.
summary.pt: O período é, em grande parte, de rotina: entre os aspectos positivos estão um funcionário dos EUA elogiando o fechamento de uma fábrica ilegal, um acordo de financiamento comercial entre o Banreservas e a IFC e uma medalha de ouro olímpica. Em contrapartida, há uma suposta trama contra o presidente, um aumento de casos de dengue, feminicídios e críticas à segurança da nova carteira de identidade.

en: US official praises closure of illegal Chinese factory
Banreservas and IFC expand trade finance support
Alleged plot against President Abinader under terrorism investigation
it: Funzionario statunitense elogia la chiusura di una fabbrica cinese illegale
Banreservas e IFC ampliano il sostegno al finanziamento del commercio
Presunto complotto contro il presidente Abinader sotto indagine per terrorismo
ru: Представитель США высоко оценил закрытие нелегальной китайской фабрики
Banreservas и IFC расширяют поддержку торгового финансирования
Предполагаемый заговор против президента Абинадера расследуется как террористический
ar: مسؤول أمريكي يشيد بإغلاق مصنع صيني غير قانوني
بانريزيرفاس ومؤسسة التمويل الدولية توسعان دعم التمويل التجاري
مؤامرة مزعومة ضد الرئيس أبينادر قيد التحقيق بتهمة الإرهاب
fa: مقام آمریکایی از تعطیلی یک کارخانه غیرقانونی چینی تمجید کرد
Banreservas و IFC حمایت از تأمین مالی تجاری را گسترش می‌دهند
توطئه ادعایی علیه رئیس‌جمهور آبیناдер تحت بررسی اتهام تروریسم قرار دارد
zh: 美国官员赞扬关闭一家非法中国工厂
