summary.en: The report highlights an attack in Mali's Ménaka region in which armed men (attributed to ISIS) killed more than 40 civilians, and a Human Rights Watch report documenting war crimes by the army, its Russian allies and insurgents, including 89 civilian deaths from airstrikes. Local media emphasize military operations and diplomatic and economic developments, but the level of violence and the humanitarian situation score markedly lower.

en: Mass attack in Ménaka that killed more than 40 civilians
HRW report: war crimes by the army and insurgents, 89 civilian deaths from airstrikes
Ongoing military operations and clashes (Dougoukoloko, Kidal)
10 dead in a building collapse in Dioïla
Signs of diplomatic and economic rapprochement with Qatar, Côte d'Ivoire and AES-ECOWAS

summary.en: A mass-casualty attack by an Islamic State-affiliated group in Ménaka killed at least 48 civilians, dominating foreign coverage, and an ICT report warns that Bamako is no longer safe. Domestic media otherwise show routine news, including university progress and a fall in meat prices, which keeps the score above the crisis band.

en: Attack in Ménaka killed at least 48 civilians, widely reported
Reports that JNIM is shifting scale and threatening Bamako
Ongoing FAMa strikes and displaced-persons night patrols signal insecurity

summary.en: Mali's period was dominated by serious violence: reports of around 40 and 48 civilians killed in separate attacks, alleged abuses by the army and Africa Corps, and displacement in the centre. Routine economic, cultural and diplomatic news and a Senegal-ECOWAS rapprochement partly offset this, but the security situation weighs heavily.

en: Around 40 civilians killed by armed men in Ménaka region
Reported IS attack killing 48 civilians
Alleged army and Africa Corps abuses reported by foreign media

summary.en: Mali's coverage is mostly routine: budget and infrastructure work, a justice protocol with Morocco, and cautious regional dialogue. Offsetting this, there is a Kidal military escalation, HRW reports of abuses by the army and Africa Corps, and new citizenship-stripping sanctions against people deemed hostile to the state.

en: Kidal military pressure and airstrikes escalate
HRW reports army and Africa Corps abuses
Citizenship-stripping sanctions for hostile acts validated

summary.en: Mali's period mixes security strain, including an extended curfew in Koulikoro, a widened nationality-stripping law, and allegations of army and Africa Corps civilian abuses. Routine positives include H1 gold output of 23.5 t, lithium sector news, and a budget revision passed by parliament. GDELT tone is less negative than the world average.

en: Koulikoro curfew extended to 20 November amid security concerns
Nationality-stripping law expanded to Malians of origin
Allegations of army and Africa Corps civilian killings and abuses

summary.en: A jihadist attack attributed to IS Sahel killed 54 civilians in Ménaka, a serious security shock, though government and army activity and routine economic and social news continued. The negative tone is consistent with the massacre, which outweighs the otherwise ordinary administrative news.

en: 54 civilians killed in Tagadayat (Ménaka) attack
Army airstrikes on militant positions in Ménaka, Mopti, Ségou
Budget settlement shows revenues above forecasts

summary.en: Mali's period is dominated by a deadly Islamic State attack on camps that left 54 dead, plus reports of a rebellion and the army's 'carnage' at Moura, which points to serious ongoing insecurity. Routine development news (solar plant, vaccination drive, Russia-Africa summit travel) and a GDELT tone less negative than the world average partly offset this.

en: IS attacks on camps over weekend, 54 dead
Rebellion and clashes reported at Moura
Routine development and solar-energy projects announced

summary.en: The period is dominated by serious violence: the discovery of 54 bodies after attacks in Ménaka, an army and Russian-linked strike reported to have killed at least 13 people, and a national rights commission condemning the killings. Partial positives such as a 30% rise in gold output, budget and electoral-list routine, and secured fuel convoys do not offset the security crisis, and the GDELT tone is more negative than the world average.

en: 54 bodies found after ISGS attacks in Ménaka
Reported army and Russian-linked attack killing at least 13
CNDH condemns killings and calls for investigations

summary.en: The period mixes routine governance and development news, including a fuel convoy arriving in Bamako, a 100 MW solar project step, and ten laws adopted by the CNT, with some serious negatives. These include a drone strike reported to have killed 13 civilians in Timbuktu, school closures under armed threat in Banamba, and a ten-year sentence for the former Bamako mayor. The overall tone is slightly more negative than the world average.

en: Drone strike reported to have killed 13 civilians in Timbuktu region
Two schools closed in Banamba under armed threat
Fuel convoy of 1,107 tankers arrives in Bamako

summary.en: The period mixes routine economic and social news (a KAMAZ industrial contract, a Qatar education partnership, the 2027 budget) with a serious security picture: a reported drone strike that activists say killed 13 civilians, and a claimed army recapture of Kidal. Detained pro-democracy activists being brought to court after nearly six months and a university strike add to the strain on institutions, so the score sits below an ordinary day.

en: Activists say a drone strike killed 13 civilians
Reported army recapture of Kidal amid jihadist threat
Pro-democracy activists presented to court after six months' detention

summary.en: Mali's day mixes diplomatic and economic activity, including the Russia-Africa summit and mining and cartography agreements with Russia, with serious security and rights concerns. These include a reported forced disappearance of a junta critic, killings and disappearances in Bamako, clashes near Djenné, and a surge of displaced people in Macina.

en: Forced disappearance of junta critic reported by foreign media
Dozo-jihadist clashes near Djenné and displacement of 3,200 in Macina
Russia-Africa summit and new Russian mining agreements

summary.en: Mali's period is dominated by serious problems: a junta critic reported forcibly disappeared, a worsening humanitarian situation, a US entry ban, a higher-education strike, an extended curfew and reports of livestock killings. Positive items such as Russia-Africa and Russia-Mali economic cooperation, cybersecurity events and army strikes on militants are routine by comparison, and GDELT tone is slightly less negative than the world average.

en: Critic of junta reported forcibly disappeared for six months
Humanitarian situation worsening amid underfunding and US entry ban
Higher-education strike and curfew extension in Koutiala

summary.en: The period was mostly routine, with a strategic Mali-Russia summit at the Kremlin, a secured fuel convoy of 596 tankers reaching Bamako, and new academic and youth-sport cooperation. GDELT tone (+0.31 against a world average of -0.84) supports a modestly positive reading, with no crisis or crackdown in the headlines.

en: Secured 596-tanker fuel convoy delivered to Bamako
Strategic Kremlin meeting between Goïta and Putin
Academic cooperation agreement with a Russian university

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: Mali's Russia-Africa summit diplomacy and Russia partnership news sit alongside ongoing counter-terror operations. Negatives include a series of Bamako killings, a deadly mining-site accident and an unresolved 2013 murder case, and the GDELT tone is more negative than the world average.

en: Russia-Africa summit and Goïta-Putin partnership coverage
FAMa counter-terror operation neutralising mobile cells
Series of murders reported in Bamako

summary.en: Domestic media report mostly routine development, social-cohesion and administrative news. Foreign coverage stresses the unresolved abduction of opposition figure Mountaga Tall, the murder of a nurse, and displacement strain in Macina, which keeps the score below a normal day.

en: Mountaga Tall abduction unresolved after six months, with NGO and rights criticism
Displaced people overwhelming Macina after an influx from Souleye
Routine development and social-stability news: hospital construction, social pact, Bamako Document

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: local development, health and solidarity initiatives, and police and gendarmerie arrests. Counterterrorism strikes continue, and NGOs press for information on the six-month abduction of opposition figure Mountaga Tall, so the score sits below a typical day.

en: Ongoing military strikes against militants in north and centre
NGOs demand answers on opposition figure Mountaga Tall's abduction
Routine development, health and solidarity initiatives and anti-crime arrests

summary.en: The period mixes routine governance and economic items (IMF technical assistance, ECOWAS electrification, mining results) with security operations and strain from thousands of returnees expelled from Guinea. The GDELT tone is mildly positive, but the missing-opposition-leader story and the migration pressure offset it, so the net picture is close to an ordinary day.

en: Thousands of returnees from Guinea strain Kouremalé and Bamako
Army strikes on terrorist bases reported near Koro and Gourma-Rharous
Pressure on Mali over missing opposition leader and son

summary.en: Coverage is mostly routine: state-media reports of donations, official visits, a forum and a corruption ruling with repayment ordered. Humanitarian strain from displacement in Macina and Ménaka and crop losses from uneven rains weigh slightly against these.

en: Court ruling in Sidi Sosso Diarra corruption case, with repayment ordered
Displacement and rising humanitarian needs in Macina and Ménaka
Influx of returning miners and repatriation arrangements with Guinea and Burkina Faso

summary.en: The period mixes routine governance, Sahel alliance meetings and security operations against armed groups with a humanitarian strain from roughly 80,000 people crossing from Guinea, including expelled miners. Overall the news reads as an ordinary day with some pressure, so the score sits near the baseline.

en: Roughly 80,000 people crossed from Guinea, straining humanitarian capacity
FAMa operations destroyed terrorist bases in Koro, Sandaré and Sofara
Dioïla curfew extended to 30 November amid security concerns

summary.en: Mali's period is mostly routine government business, including budget increases for hospitals and a fuel convoy reaching Bamako. The main strain is the humanitarian response to mass expulsions of gold miners from Guinea, which foreign outlets describe as a catastrophe with six reported deaths, though the government is mobilising transport and aid.

en: Mass expulsion of gold miners from Guinea, with reported deaths
Government mobilising trucks, buses and aid for returnees
Budget increase of 125 billion FCFA for hospitals

summary.en: Mali faces a large humanitarian strain from the forced return of roughly 160,000 people from Guinea, with around 17,000 moved to Burkina Faso and shelter needs in Bamako. Partly offset by organised state and civil response, Algerian reconciliation diplomacy and AES cooperation, but military operations and detention-abuse allegations weigh on the score.

en: Mass expulsion of about 160,000 people from Guinea strains border and shelters
Allegations of deaths and abuse in Sébénicoro detention reported by former detainee
Organised state and civil relief response to returnees in Kouremalé and Bamako

summary.en: Mali's period mixes routine diplomacy, defence and development news with a serious humanitarian strain: roughly 160,000 people expelled from Guinea, several deaths among returnees, and a suicide attack. Ongoing military operations in Ménaka and Kidal add security pressure, though no institutional breakdown appears in the headlines.

en: Mass expulsion of around 160,000 people from Guinea strains Bamako and Kouremalé
Suicide attack killing three and continued military operations in Ménaka and Kidal
Deaths among expelled gold miners and routine AES and Senegal diplomacy

summary.en: The period mixes routine diplomacy and cooperation (BAMEX defence fair, Turkish flight talks, budget and education plans) with a serious humanitarian strain from the mass expulsion of gold miners from Guinea, reported at 9 deaths and about 49,000 people evacuated. Ongoing military operations and a diplomatic dispute with Conakry add to the pressure, though the country's institutions are functioning.
summary.it: Il periodo unisce diplomazia e cooperazione di routine (la fiera della difesa BAMEX, colloqui sui voli con la Turchia, piani di bilancio e istruzione) a una grave pressione umanitaria dovuta all'espulsione di massa di minatori d'oro dalla Guinea, con 9 morti segnalati e circa 49,000 persone evacuate. Le operazioni militari in corso e una controversia diplomatica con Conakry aumentano la pressione, sebbene le istituzioni del paese continuino a funzionare.
summary.ru: Период сочетает рутинную дипломатию и сотрудничество (оборонная выставка BAMEX, переговоры о авиасообщении с Турцией, планы по бюджету и образованию) с серьёзной гуманитарной нагрузкой из-за массовой высылки золотодобытчиков из Гвинеи: 9 погибших и около 49,000 эвакуированных. Продолжающиеся военные операции и дипломатический спор с Конакри усиливают давление, однако институты страны продолжают работать.
summary.ar: تجمع الفترة بين الدبلوماسية والتعاون الروتينيين (معرض BAMEX للدفاع، ومحادثات الرحلات الجوية مع تركيا، وخطط الميزانية والتعليم) وضغطًا إنسانيًا خطيرًا ناجمًا عن الطرد الجماعي لعمال مناجم الذهب من غينيا، وقد أُفيد عن 9 وفيات وإجلاء نحو 49,000 شخص. وتزيد العمليات العسكرية الجارية والنزاع الدبلوماسي مع كوناكري الضغوط، رغم أن مؤسسات البلاد لا تزال تعمل.
summary.fa: این دوره ترکیبی از دیپلماسی و همکاری روتین (نمایشگاه دفاعی BAMEX، گفت‌وگوهای پروازی با ترکیه، برنامه‌های بودجه و آموزش) با فشار انسانی جدی ناشی از اخراج دسته‌جمعی معدنچیان طلا از گینه است که از ۹ کشته و حدود 49,000 تخلیه‌شده گزارش شده است. عملیات نظامی جاری و اختلاف دیپلماتیک با کوناکری بر فشارها می‌افزایند، هرچند نهادهای کشور همچنان فعال‌اند.
summary.zh: 本时期既有例行外交与合作（BAMEX国防展、与土耳其的航班会谈、预算和教育计划），也因大规模驱逐来自几内亚的金矿工人而面临严重的人道主义压力，据报道造成9人死亡、约49,000人撤离。持续的军事行动以及与科纳克里的外交争端加剧了压力，但该国机构仍在正常运作。
summary.ja: この期間には、定例の外交・協力活動（BAMEX防衛見本市、トルコとの航空協議、予算および教育計画）と、ギニアからの金鉱夫の大量追放に伴う深刻な人道的負担が併存している。追放では9人の死亡が報告され、約49,000人が避難した。継続中の軍事作戦やコナクリとの外交摩擦も圧力を強めているが、国の諸機関は機能している。
summary.ko: 이번 기간에는 일상적인 외교 및 협력 활동(BAMEX 방위 박람회, 튀르키예와의 항공 회담, 예산 및 교육 계획)과 함께 기니에서 금광 노동자들이 대규모로 추방되면서 빚어진 심각한 인도적 부담이 겹쳐 나타났다. 추방 과정에서 9명이 사망하고 약 49,000명이 대피한 것으로 보도되었다. 진행 중인 군사 작전과 코나크리와의 외교 분쟁이 압박을 더하고 있으나, 국가 기관들은 정상적으로 기능하고 있다.
summary.hi: इस अवधि में नियमित कूटनीति और सहयोग (BAMEX रक्षा मेला, तुर्की के साथ उड़ान वार्ता, बजट और शिक्षा योजनाएँ) के साथ गिनी से सोने की खदानों में काम करने वाले खनिकों के बड़े पैमाने पर निष्कासन से गंभीर मानवीय दबाव भी दिखा। निष्कासन में 9 मौतें दर्ज की गईं और लगभग 49,000 लोगों को निकाला गया। चल रहे सैन्य अभियानों और कोनाक्री के साथ कूटनीतिक विवाद से दबाव और बढ़ा है, फिर भी देश की संस्थाएँ कार्यरत हैं।
summary.el: Η περίοδος συνδυάζει τη συνηθισμένη διπλωματία και συνεργασία (έκθεση άμυνας BAMEX, συνομιλίες για πτήσεις με την Τουρκία, σχέδια προϋπολογισμού και εκπαίδευσης) με σοβαρή ανθρωπιστική πίεση από τη μαζική απέλαση χρυσωρύχων από τη Γουινέα, με 9 θανάτους και περίπου 49.000 άτομα που εκκενώθηκαν. Οι συνεχιζόμενες στρατιωτικές επιχειρήσεις και η διπλωματική διαφορά με το Κονακρί αυξάνουν την πίεση, ωστόσο οι θεσμοί της χώρας λειτουργούν κανονικά.
summary.tr: Dönem, rutin diplomasi ve iş birliğini (BAMEX savunma fuarı, Türkiye ile uçuş görüşmeleri, bütçe ve eğitim planları) ciddi bir insani baskıyla bir arada sunuyor: Gine'den altın madencilerinin toplu sınır dışı edilmesi, 9 ölüm ve yaklaşık 49.000 kişinin tahliyesiyle sonuçlandı. Süregelen askeri operasyonlar ve Konakri ile yaşanan diplomatik anlaşmazlık baskıyı artırıyor; ancak ülkenin kurumları işlevini sürdürüyor.
summary.es: El periodo combina la diplomacia y la cooperación rutinarias (la feria de defensa BAMEX, las conversaciones aéreas con Turquía, los planes presupuestarios y educativos) con una grave presión humanitaria por la expulsión masiva de mineros de oro de Guinea, con 9 muertos y unas 49.000 personas evacuadas. Las operaciones militares en curso y una disputa diplomática con Conakri aumentan la presión, aunque las instituciones del país siguen funcionando.
summary.fr: La période mêle diplomatie et coopération de routine (salon de la défense BAMEX, entretiens sur les vols avec la Turquie, plans budgétaires et éducatifs) à une grave tension humanitaire liée à l'expulsion massive de mineurs d'or depuis la Guinée, qui a fait 9 morts et environ 49 000 personnes évacuées. Les opérations militaires en cours et un différend diplomatique avec Conakry accentuent la pression, bien que les institutions du pays continuent de fonctionner.
summary.de: Der Zeitraum verbindet routinemäßige Diplomatie und Zusammenarbeit (BAMEX-Verteidigungsmesse, Gespräche über Flugverbindungen mit der Türkei, Haushalts- und Bildungspläne) mit einer ernsten humanitären Belastung durch die Massenausweisung von Goldschürfern aus Guinea, bei der laut Berichten 9 Menschen starben und rund 49.000 Personen evakuiert wurden. Laufende Militäroperationen und ein diplomatischer Streit mit Conakry erhöhen den Druck, doch die staatlichen Institutionen funktionieren weiterhin.
summary.pt: O período combina diplomacia e cooperação de rotina (feira de defesa BAMEX, conversações sobre voos com a Turquia, planos orçamentais e educativos) com uma séria pressão humanitária decorrente da expulsão em massa de mineiros de ouro da Guiné, com 9 mortes e cerca de 49.000 pessoas evacuadas. As operações militares em curso e um diferendo diplomático com Conacri aumentam a pressão, embora as instituições do país continuem a funcionar.

summary.en: The Privy Council's ruling striking down the colonial-era law criminalising gay sex is a notable rights advance, widely covered abroad. It is tempered by a deadly boat collision with five people still missing, questions over the State response, and a minister's plan to appeal.
summary.it: La sentenza del Privy Council che annulla la legge di epoca coloniale che criminalizza i rapporti sessuali tra uomini è un importante passo avanti nel campo dei diritti, ampiamente riportato all'estero. Il quadro è però attenuato da una collisione mortale tra imbarcazioni con cinque persone ancora disperse, da interrogativi sulla risposta delle autorità e dal piano di un ministro di presentare ricorso.
summary.ru: Решение Тайного совета об отмене колониального закона, криминализировавшего однополые половые отношения, является заметным шагом в сфере прав человека и широко освещалось за рубежом. Однако его значение омрачено смертельным столкновением лодок, в результате которого пять человек остаются пропавшими без вести, вопросами о действиях государственных органов и планом министра обжаловать решение.
summary.ar: يمثل حكم مجلس الملكة الخاص (Privy Council) بإلغاء القانون الاستعماري الذي يجرّم العلاقات الجنسية بين الرجال تقدمًا ملحوظًا في مجال الحقوق، وقد حظي بتغطية واسعة في الخارج. لكن هذا التقدم يقابله حادث اصطدام قارب أسفر عن وفيات، ولا يزال خمسة أشخاص في عداد المفقودين، إضافة إلى تساؤلات حول استجابة الدولة، وخطة أحد الوزراء للاستئناف.
summary.fa: حکم شورای خصوصی (Privy Council) مبنی بر لغو قانون استعماری که رابطه جنسی میان مردان را جرم‌انگاری می‌کرد، گامی قابل توجه در زمینه حقوق بشر است و در خارج از کشور به‌طور گسترده پوشش داده شد. با این حال، برخوردِ مرگبارِ دو قایق که پنج نفر همچنان مفقود هستند، پرسش‌هایی درباره واکنش دولت و طرح یک وزیر برای تجدیدنظرخواهی این دستاورد را تعدیل کرده است.
summary.zh: 枢密院推翻殖民时代将男性同性性行为定为犯罪的法律，是人权领域的一项重要进展，在海外受到广泛报道。然而，一起造成人员死亡的船只相撞事故使这一进展打了折扣：仍有五人失踪，国家应对措施受到质疑，且一名部长计划提起上诉。
summary.ja: 同性間の性行為を犯罪とする植民地時代の法律を無効とした枢密院の判決は、海外でも広く報じられた注目すべき人権前進である。一方で、死者を出したボートの衝突事故で5人が依然行方不明であることや、国家の対応への疑問、閣僚が控訴を計画していることから、その評価は和らいでいる。
summary.ko: 추밀원이 동성 간 성관계를 범죄로 규정한 식민지 시대 법을 무효화한 판결은 해외에서도 널리 보도된 주목할 만한 인권 진전이다. 다만 사망자를 낸 보트 충돌 사고로 5명이 여전히 실종 상태이고, 국가 대응에 대한 의문이 제기되고 있으며, 장관이 항소를 계획하고 있어 그 성과는 다소 퇴색된다.
summary.hi: प्रिवी काउंसिल का वह फैसला, जिसने औपनिवेशिक काल के उस कानून को रद्द किया जो समलैंगिक यौन संबंध को अपराध मानता था, अधिकारों की दिशा में एक उल्लेखनीय प्रगति है और विदेशों में इसकी व्यापक चर्चा हुई है। हालांकि एक घातक नाव टक्कर में पाँच लोग अब भी लापता हैं, राज्य की प्रतिक्रिया पर सवाल उठ रहे हैं, और एक मंत्री फैसले के खिलाफ अपील करने की योजना बना रहे हैं, जिससे इस उपलब्धि की चमक कुछ फीकी पड़ जाती है।
summary.el: Η απόφαση του Privy Council που ακύρωσε τον νόμο της αποικιακής εποχής, ο οποίος ποινικοποιούσε το ομοφυλοφιλικό σεξ, αποτελεί σημαντική πρόοδο για τα δικαιώματα και έχει καλυφθεί ευρέως στο εξωτερικό. Ωστόσο, την περιορίζουν η θανατηφόρα σύγκρουση σκάφους, με πέντε άτομα ακόμη αγνοούμενα, τα ερωτήματα για την αντίδραση του κράτους και το σχέδιο υπουργού για προσφυγή.
summary.tr: Privy Council'ın sömürge dönemine ait, eşcinsel ilişkiyi suç sayan yasayı iptal eden kararı, yurt dışında geniş yer bulan önemli bir hak kazanımıdır. Bununla birlikte, beş kişinin hâlâ kayıp olduğu ölümcül bir tekne çarpışması, Devletin müdahalesine ilişkin sorular ve bir bakanın kararı temyiz etme planı bu gelişmeyi gölgelemektedir.
summary.es: La decisión del Consejo Privado que anula la ley de la época colonial que criminalizaba las relaciones sexuales entre hombres es un avance notable en derechos, ampliamente cubierto en el extranjero. Lo matiza una colisión mortal de embarcaciones con cinco personas aún desaparecidas, las dudas sobre la respuesta del Estado y el plan de un ministro de recurrir la decisión.
summary.fr: La décision du Conseil privé annulant la loi de l'époque coloniale qui incriminait les relations sexuelles entre hommes constitue une avancée notable en matière de droits, largement relayée à l'étranger. Elle est nuancée par une collision mortelle entre deux embarcations, cinq personnes étant toujours portées disparues, par les interrogations sur la réaction de l'État et par le projet d'un ministre de faire appel.
summary.de: Das Urteil des Privy Council, mit dem ein aus der Kolonialzeit stammendes Gesetz zur Kriminalisierung gleichgeschlechtlicher Sexualkontakte aufgehoben wurde, gilt als bedeutender Fortschritt für die Rechte und fand im Ausland breite Beachtung. Getrübt wird dies durch eine tödliche Bootskollision, bei der fünf Menschen noch vermisst werden, durch Fragen zum Vorgehen des Staates sowie durch die Ankündigung eines Ministers, das Urteil anzufechten.
summary.pt: A decisão do Conselho Privado que anulou a lei da era colonial que criminalizava as relações sexuais entre pessoas do mesmo sexo é um avanço notável nos direitos, amplamente noticiado no exterior. A decisão é atenuada por uma colisão mortal de barcos com cinco pessoas ainda desaparecidas, por questionamentos sobre a resposta do Estado e pelo plano de um ministro de recorrer da decisão.

en: Privy Council overturns colonial-era law criminalising gay sex
Boat collision with five missing; safety and State response questioned
Minister and opposition vow appeal or challenge to court ruling
it: Il Privy Council annulla una legge di epoca coloniale che criminalizza i rapporti sessuali tra uomini

summary.zh: 这一时期大多是例行政治活动：布拉格的联合执政谈判、政府与总统府的会晤，以及支持公共广播机构的学生和平集会，未见有镇压报道。GDELT的语调接近全球平均水平，因此这一天看起来较为平常，只是在公共媒体资金问题上存在轻微摩擦。
summary.tr: Dönem çoğunlukla olağan siyasetle geçti: Prag'daki koalisyon görüşmeleri, cumhurbaşkanı-hükümet toplantısı ve kamu yayıncılarına destek veren barışçıl öğrenci mitingleri; bildirilen bir baskı olayı yok. GDELT tonu dünya ortalamasına yakın, dolayısıyla gün sıradan görünüyor; kamu medyasının finansmanı konusunda hafif bir gerginlik var.
summary.es: El periodo refleja sobre todo política rutinaria: las negociaciones de coalición en Praga, una reunión entre el presidente y el gobierno, y manifestaciones estudiantiles pacíficas en favor de las radiotelevisiones públicas, sin represión informada. El tono en GDELT está cerca del promedio mundial, por lo que el día parece ordinario, con una leve fricción por la financiación de los medios públicos.
summary.fr: La période relève surtout de la politique courante : négociations de coalition à Prague, réunion entre le président et le gouvernement, et rassemblements étudiants pacifiques en faveur des médias publics, sans répression signalée. summary.ja: 報道の中心は、クーデター指導者を批判していたラッパーの殺害事件で、検察官が60日間にわたり捜査している点と、元経済相の自宅に警察が家宅捜索を行い、武器と現金を押収した件である。これらはクーデター後の緊張した情勢と、諸機関への圧力を示唆しているが、現在進行中の戦闘は報告されていない。

summary.hi: समाचार का मुख्य केंद्र एक रैपर की हत्या है, जिसने तख्तापलट के नेताओं की आलोचना की थी और जिसकी अभियोजक 60 दिनों से जांच कर रहे हैं, साथ ही एक पूर्व अर्थव्यवस्था मंत्री के घर पर पुलिस छापे का मामला है जिसमें हथियार और नकदी जब्त की गई। ये घटनाएं तख्तापलट के बाद के तनावपूर्ण माहौल और संस्थाओं पर दबाव की ओर संकेत करती हैं, हालांकि किसी सक्रिय लड़ाई की सूचना नहीं है।

Αυτά υποδηλώνουν ένα τεταμένο κλίμα μετά το πραξικόπημα με πίεση σε θεσμούς, ωστόσο δεν αναφέρονται ενεργές συγκρούσεις.
summary.tr: Haberlerin merkezinde, darbe liderlerini eleştiren bir rapçinin öldürülmesi ve savcının bu olayı 60 gün içinde soruşturması ile eski bir ekonomi bakanının evine yapılan polis baskını yer alıyor; baskında silah ve nakit ele geçirildi. Bunlar darbe sonrası gerginlik ortamına ve kurumlar üzerindeki baskıya işaret ediyor, ancak aktif bir çatışma bildirilmiyor.
summary.es: La cobertura se centra en el asesinato de un rapero que criticaba a los líderes del golpe, cuyo caso investiga la fiscalía durante 60 días, y en un allanamiento policial en la residencia de un exministro de Economía, donde se incautaron armas y dinero en efectivo. Estos hechos apuntan a un clima tenso tras el golpe y a presiones sobre las instituciones, aunque no se informa de combates activos.
summary.fr: La couverture porte principalement sur l'assassinat d'un rappeur critique des chefs du coup d'État, que le procureur instruit pendant 60 jours, ainsi que sur une perquisition policière au domicile d'un ancien ministre de l'Économie, au cours de laquelle des armes et des espèces ont été saisies. Ces faits traduisent un climat tendu au lendemain du coup d'État et des pressions sur les institutions, bien qu'aucun combat actif ne soit signalé.
summary.de: Die Berichterstattung konzentriert sich auf die Tötung eines Rappers, der die Putschführer kritisiert hatte und die der Staatsanwalt innerhalb von 60 Tagen untersucht, sowie auf eine Polizeidurchsuchung im Haus eines ehemaligen Wirtschaftsministers, bei der Waffen und Bargeld beschlagnahmt wurden. Diese Ereignisse deuten auf ein angespanntes Klima nach dem Putsch und einen Druck auf Institutionen hin, wobei jedoch keine aktiven Kämpfe gemeldet werden.
summary.pt: A cobertura concentra-se no assassinato de um rapper que criticava os líderes do golpe, caso que o Ministério Público investiga durante 60 dias, e numa operação policial na residência de um ex-ministro da Economia, onde foram apreendidas armas e dinheiro em espécie. Esses fatos apontam para um clima tenso após o golpe e pressão sobre as instituições, embora não haja registro de combates ativos.
summary.it: La copertura si concentra sull'uccisione di un rapper che aveva criticato i leader del colpo di stato, su cui il procuratore sta indagando da 60 giorni, e su un'irruzione della polizia nell'abitazione di un ex ministro dell'Economia, dove sono state sequestrate armi e denaro. Questi elementi indicano un clima teso nel periodo successivo al colpo di stato, con pressioni sulle istituzioni, anche se non si segnalano combattimenti in corso.
summary.ru: Освещение сосредоточено на убийстве рэпера, критиковавшего лидеров военного переворота, которое прокурор расследует в течение 60 дней, и на обыске полиции в доме бывшего министра экономики, где были изъяты оружие и деньги. Эти события указывают на напряжённую обстановку после переворота и давление на институты, хотя активных боевых действий не сообщается.
summary.ar: تتمحور التغطية حول مقتل مغنٍ من فئة الراب كان قد انتقد قادة الانقلاب، والذي يحقق فيه المدعي العام منذ 60 يومًا، وكذلك مداهمة الشرطة لمنزل وزير اقتصاد سابق حيث صودرت أسلحة ونقود. وتشير هذه الأحداث إلى أجواء متوترة في أعقاب الانقلاب، مع ضغوط على المؤسسات، رغم عدم الإبلاغ عن أي قتال نشط.
summary.fa: پوشش خبری بر قتل یک خواننده رپ که از رهبران کودتا انتقاد کرده بود، متمرکز است؛ موضوعی که دادستان طی ۶۰ روز در حال بررسی آن است، و نیز بر یورش پلیس به خانه یک وزیر اقتصاد سابق که در آن سلاح و پول نقد کشف و ضبط شد. این موارد نشان‌دهنده فضای متشنج پس از کودتا و فشار بر نهادهاست، هرچند هیچ درگیری فعالی گزارش نشده است.
summary.zh: 报道主要围绕一名批评政变领导人的说唱歌手被杀事件（检察官已对此展开为期60天的调查），以及警方搜查一名前经济部长住所并查获武器和现金的事件。这些情况表明政变后局势紧张、机构面临压力，但目前未报告有正在进行的交火。

summary.en: In the last 24 hours there is no clear crisis in Mauritania. The agenda includes routine administrative activities, talks with an IMF mission, a 16% increase in natural gas exports and a decline in the debt-to-GDP ratio. Although there are minor tensions such as a taxi drivers' strike threat in Nouadhibou and political debates, the overall picture is calm and slightly positive.

en: 16% increase in natural gas exports and a decline in the debt-to-GDP ratio
Talks with an IMF mission and diplomatic contacts (Chad, Russia, UN)
No crisis; routine administrative activities (cleanup campaigns, migration forum)
Minor issues such as a taxi strike threat in Nouadhibou and political debates

summary.en: The day's coverage is largely routine: diplomatic credential ceremonies, IMF and World Bank reform discussions, an EU urban-development agreement, and health-centre and climate initiatives. The main negative item is a drone strike at the Morocco-Mauritania border that killed a gold miner, which is a local incident rather than a national crisis.

en: Routine diplomatic activity: multiple ambassadors presented credentials
IMF mission and World Bank reform matrix discussions on finance and resilience
EU-Nouakchott agreement to redevelop a neighbourhood; uranium project progress

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: budget approval, diplomatic accreditations, EU and World Bank cooperation, and a local urban development deal. Negative items include a Lagouira border dispute with Morocco, coordinated opposition protests in 15 wilayas, and reports of a jailed deputy and bloggers' case, which together pull the score slightly below neutral.

en: Lagouira border dispute with Morocco and Mauritania's denials
Opposition Tewassoul protests across 15 wilayas
Jailing of anti-slavery deputy reported by foreign outlet

summary.en: A largely routine day in Mauritania: a budget surplus projection, development-partner meetings, and ministerial activity. Offsetting concerns include a government denial in a border dispute with Morocco, an opposition protest against a possible third presidential term, and student protests over scholarship irregularities.

en: Budget surplus of US$155M projected for 2027
Government denies claims over Lagouira border area with Morocco
Opposition protest against possible third presidential term

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: infrastructure and electricity-grid deals, mining revenue payments, a CAF stadium accreditation, and a cabinet reshuffle that kept the PM. Negatives are minor, including a student protest, a dust storm, illegal-fishing allegations and a criminal case, and the tone is somewhat more negative than the world average.

en: Billions in electricity grid expansion deals with foreign firms
Tasiast mine pays $266.1M to state in 2025
CAF accredits Nouakchott Olympic stadium for 2027 AFCON qualifiers

summary.en: The period is routine, with university research expansion, municipal cleaning campaigns, a new bank branch, mining-sector engagement and gas-sector discussions. Negatives are limited to a teachers' union demand, inflation forecasts above 7% from the IMF, fuel smuggling seizures and tensions with Morocco.

en: Six new university labs and eleven research units approved
Government and IMF inflation forecasts diverge sharply
Teachers' union demands ministry intervention over curriculum

summary.en: The period was mostly routine, with a forecast of 5% growth for 2027, a suspended university-union sit-in, and institutional visits to women's prisons. A Morocco-Mauritania dispute over Lagouira fishing waters, with reports of Moroccan navy expulsions of Mauritanian boats, is the main negative and keeps the score only slightly above an ordinary day.

en: Forecast of 5% growth expected in 2027
Lagouira fishing-boat expulsions fuel Morocco-Mauritania sovereignty dispute
Higher education union suspends planned sit-in in Nouakchott

summary.en: The period was mostly routine: presidential travel to a Russia-Africa summit, economic and investment initiatives, and infrastructure work such as the Mauritania-Mali power link. Negatives were limited to student protests with injuries at Nouakchott university, a postponed book fair, and a dispute over a language circular, which keep the score near neutral.

en: Student protests with injuries at Nouakchott university
Power interconnection project with Mali accelerating
Presidential trip to Russia-Africa summit

summary.en: The period looks routine with mild positives: an $80 million solar-plus-storage financing prospect, a 2027 budget projecting higher revenue, a new 5G launch, and active diplomacy with Russia and China. Offsetting concerns include a university transport-fare strike, uncertainty over the Spanish fishing agreement, and local power outages.

en: Possible $80M solar plant financing with storage in Nouakchott
2027 budget draft projects higher revenues and growth
Student strike over higher university transport fares

summary.en: The day was mostly routine: a first-of-its-kind medical procedure, development-financing talks and an AfDB project announcement. Mild negatives came from police dispersing a student protest and a debate over a third term and a proposed transition, with tone slightly better than the world average.

en: First brain catheterization procedures performed by Mauritanian medical teams
AfDB financing details for Nouakchott hybrid power station project
Police dispersal of student protest in Nouakchott

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: development consultations, investment and partnership talks (Spanish business chamber, IFAD expansion, EU military aid increase) and the president's return from the Russia-Africa summit. Negatives include a fatal stabbing in Nouakchott, a cross-border drone strike in Mali, and two worker deaths at Kinross, which keep the score only slightly above an ordinary day.

en: EU raises military support to Mauritania to €55 million
Investment talks with Spanish chamber and IFAD partnership expansion
Fatal stabbing of a Quran teacher in Nouakchott

summary.en: The period is mostly routine, with the first diaspora forum, presidential calls for investment, a health centre opening and a 51% mine stake purchase. Offsetting this, a reported prime minister resignation and a failed UN Western Sahara mandate renewal add some uncertainty, though the reports are thin.

en: Inaugural diaspora forum with presidential commitments to citizens abroad

summary.en: The period was largely routine: a diaspora forum, municipal cleanup drives, a governance ranking, and a migrant rescue. A central bank rate hike and a complaint about political violence add mild negatives, while GDELT tone is slightly below the world average.

summary.en: The period is mostly routine governance and local news: enforcement against bakeries over price hikes, a central bank rate rise to 7.25%, and ministerial follow-ups on services. summary.en: The period is dominated by routine government and diplomatic activity: a diaspora forum concluded, French funding agreements were signed, and a Senegal-Mauritania agricultural roadmap was drafted. summary.en: The period is mostly positive: a student strike ended in an agreement, new US oil and gas exploration contracts were signed, EU and Japanese funding was announced, and Spain praised migration cooperation. Offsetting concerns are opposition warnings about the cost of living and bakeries closing over a bread price rise.

en: Student strike ended through agreement between students and authorities

€15 million EU financing agreement to support employment

summary.en: The period was mostly positive: Murphy Oil signed two offshore exploration contracts, Germany announced a 15 million euro employment grant, and a Spanish security dialogue advanced. The main concern is border tension as the UN MINURSO mission winds down, prompting Mauritania to warn herders and citizens to keep away from the frontier.

en: Murphy Oil offshore exploration contracts signed for C-10 and Tiof blocks

Navy rescue of 166 migrants; Spain security cooperation talks

summary.en: Mauritania's day was dominated by routine government development news: a president-led urban programme phase launch, an IMF mission, and two new oil exploration contracts. Offsetting this, the MINURSO withdrawal from Western Sahara has raised border security concerns and prompted a warning to citizens near the Moroccan border.

en: Signing of two oil exploration contracts (blocks C10 and Tiof) with Murphy Oil
Launch of phase two of Nouakchott urban development programme
IMF mission reviewing economic reforms and food security

summary.en: A largely routine day with several positive developments: Mauritania's candidate won a UN civil service leadership post, and an oil exploration deal with Murphy Oil was announced. Security tightening in the capital and EU fishing-access tensions are ordinary governance issues, and GDELT tone (0.00) is above the world average.

en: Mauritanian candidate elected to head UN civil service commission
Murphy Oil exploration agreement details for blocks C10 and Teuf
Capital security plan with drones; public procurement reform planned

summary.en: Mauritania's news is mostly routine governance: the new government presented its programme to parliament with priorities on purchasing power and a 2060 vision, and it won a UN committee chairmanship. Negatives include the expiring EU fishing agreement, a wildfire, and sanitation problems, and GDELT tone is less negative than the world average.

en: Government programme presented to parliament, prioritising purchasing power and development
Mauritania wins chairmanship of a UN committee
Plan to cut external debt below 40% by 2026

summary.en: The period looks like a routine news day with mixed signals: the Prime Minister presented his policy declaration to parliament, and infrastructure and security cooperation with neighbours was reported. Pressures include a health-sector union warning about delayed payments, falling gold output and state mining revenue, and commentary on constitutional legitimacy. The overall tone is close to the world average, so the score sits slightly below neutral.

en: Health-sector union warns of rising tension over delayed payments
Gold output down 19% and state mining revenue down 18.5%
Prime Minister's policy declaration to parliament; Snim record iron sales

summary.en: A mostly routine day: parliament gave the government a confidence vote of 145 and Mauritania signed a Hajj agreement with Saudi Arabia, alongside development and financing news. Negatives include an MP's resignation alleging corruption, a fire at Somoil, and tensions with Algeria, but these are not a clear crisis.
summary.tr: Genel olarak sıradan bir gün: Meclis hükümete 145 oyla güven oyu verdi, Moritanya ise Suudi Arabistan ile Hac düzenlemesi anlaşması imzaladı; kalkınma ve finansman haberleri de vardı. Olumsuz gelişmeler arasında bir milletvekilinin yolsuzluk iddiasıyla istifası, Somoil'deki yangın ve Cezayir ile gerginlikler var, ancak bunlar açık bir kriz oluşturmuyor.
summary.es: Un día mayormente rutinario: el Parlamento otorgó al gobierno un voto de confianza de 145 votos y Mauritania firmó un acuerdo de peregrinación del Hach con Arabia Saudí, junto con noticias sobre desarrollo y financiación. Entre los aspectos negativos figuran la dimisión de un diputado que denuncia corrupción, un incendio en Somoil y tensiones con Argelia, pero no constituyen una crisis clara.
summary.fr: Une journée globalement routinière : le Parlement a accordé au gouvernement un vote de confiance de 145 voix, et la Mauritanie a signé avec l'Arabie saoudite un accord relatif au pèlerinage du Hajj, parallèlement à des nouvelles sur le développement et le financement. Les aspects négatifs comprennent la démission d'un député qui dénonce la corruption, un incendie à Somoil et des tensions avec l'Algérie, mais il ne s'agit pas d'une crise manifeste.
summary.de: Ein überwiegend routinemäßiger Tag: Das Parlament sprach der Regierung 145 Vertrauensstimmen aus, und Mauretanien unterzeichnete mit Saudi-Arabien ein Abkommen zur Hadsch, außerdem gab es Nachrichten zu Entwicklung und Finanzierung. Zu den negativen Meldungen gehören der Rücktritt eines Abgeordneten, der Korruption anprangert, ein Brand bei Somoil und Spannungen mit Algerien, doch handelt es sich nicht um eine eindeutige Krise.
summary.pt: Um dia em grande parte rotineiro: o parlamento concedeu ao governo um voto de confiança de 145 votos, e a Mauritânia assinou com a Arábia Saudita um acordo sobre o Hajj, além de notícias sobre desenvolvimento e financiamento. Entre os aspectos negativos estão a renúncia de um deputado que denuncia corrupção, um incêndio na Somoil e tensões com a Argélia, mas não se trata de uma crise clara.
summary.ja: おおむね平常の一日でした。国会はOuld Ajay政権に対して145票の信任を与え、モーリタニアはサウジアラビアとハッジ(巡礼)に関する協定に署名しました。開発や資金調達に関する報道もありました。懸念材料としては、汚職を訴えた国会議員の辞任、Somoilでの火災、アルジェリアとの緊張がありますが、明確な危機とは言えません。
summary.ko: 대체로 평범한 하루였습니다. 국회는 Ould Ajay 정부에 145표의 신임을 부여했고, 모리타니는 사우디아라비아와 하지(순례) 운영 협정에 서명했으며, 개발 및 자금 조달 관련 소식도 있었습니다. 부정적인 사안으로는 한 국회의원의 부패 의혹 제기 사퇴, Somoil의 화재, 알제리와의 긴장이 있지만, 명확한 위기로 볼 수는 없습니다.
summary.hi: यह लगभग एक सामान्य दिन था: संसद ने सरकार को 145 मतों के साथ विश्वास मत दिया और मॉरिटानिया ने सऊदी अरब के साथ हज व्यवस्था समझौते पर हस्ताक्षर किए, साथ ही विकास और वित्तपोषण से जुड़ी खबरें भी रहीं। नकारात्मक पहलुओं में एक सांसद का भ्रष्टाचार के आरोप लगाते हुए इस्तीफा, Somoil में आग और अल्जीरिया के साथ तनाव शामिल हैं, लेकिन ये स्पष्ट संकट नहीं हैं।
summary.el: Μια κατά βάση συνηθισμένη ημέρα: η βουλή παρείχε ψήφο εμπιστοσύνης 145 ψήφων στην κυβέρνηση και η Μαυριτανία υπέγραψε συμφωνία για το Χατζ με τη Σαουδική Αραβία, παράλληλα με ειδήσεις για ανάπτυξη και χρηματοδότηση. Αρνητικά στοιχεία περιλαμβάνουν την παραίτηση ενός βουλευτή με καταγγελίες για διαδεδομένη διαφθορά, μια πυρκαγιά στη Somoil και εντάσεις με την Αλγερία, χωρίς όμως να συνιστούν σαφή κρίση.
summary.it: Un giorno per lo più di routine: il parlamento ha concesso al governo un voto di fiducia con 145 voti e la Mauritania ha firmato con l'Arabia Saudita un accordo sull'Hajj, insieme a notizie su sviluppo e finanziamenti. Tra gli aspetti negativi figurano le dimissioni di un deputato che denuncia corruzione, un incendio alla Somoil e tensioni con l'Algeria, ma non si tratta di una crisi chiara.
summary.ru: В целом обычный день: парламент выразил правительству вотум доверия 145 голосами, а Мавритания подписала с Саудовской Аравией соглашение об организации хаджа; также появились новости о развитии и финансировании. К негативным моментам относятся отставка депутата, обвинившего в коррупции, пожар на Somoil и напряжённость с Алжиром, однако это не похоже на явный кризис.
summary.ar: يوم روتيني في معظمه: منح البرلمان الحكومة ثقة بـ145 صوتاً، ووقّعت موريتانيا اتفاقية مع المملكة العربية السعودية بشأن تنظيم الحج، إلى جانب أخبار تتعلق بالتنمية والتمويل. ومن الجوانب السلبية استقالة نائب يتهم بالفساد، وحريق في شركة سوموئيل، والتوتر مع الجزائر، لكن هذه الأحداث لا تشكل أزمة واضحة.
summary.fa: روزی عمدتاً معمولی: پارلمان با 145 رأی به دولت اعتماد داد و موریتانی با عربستان سعودی توافقنامه‌ای برای سازماندهی حج امضا کرد؛ همچنین اخباری درباره توسعه و تأمین مالی منتشر شد. از موارد منفی می‌توان به استعفای یک نماینده با ادعای فساد، آتش‌سوزی در سوموئیل و تنش با الجزایر اشاره کرد، اما این‌ها بحران مشخصی نیستند.
summary.zh: 总体上属于平常的一天：议会以145票通过对政府的信任投票，毛里塔尼亚与沙特阿拉伯签署了朝觐组织协议，同时还有发展和融资方面的消息。负面消息包括一名议员以腐败指控辞职、Somoil公司发生火灾，以及与阿尔及利亚的紧张关系，但这些并不构成明显的危机。

summary.it: Il periodo è di routine: l'opposizione ha criticato l'economia citando il FMI, mentre la copertura su turismo e cultura è stata positiva. L'unico elemento operativo è un avviso di Cabo Verde Airlines su possibili modifiche ai voli per Lisbona, e il tono di GDELT è leggermente positivo, quindi il punteggio si colloca di poco sopra a una giornata ordinaria.
summary.ru: Период носит рутинный характер: оппозиция критиковала экономику, ссылаясь на МВФ, а освещение туризма и культуры было позитивным. Единственный оперативный момент — предупреждение авиакомпании Cabo Verde Airlines о возможных изменениях рейсов в Лиссабон, а тон GDELT умеренно позитивный, поэтому оценка немного выше обычного дня.
summary.ar: الفترة روتينية: انتقدت المعارضة الاقتصاد مستشهدةً بتقييمات صندوق النقد الدولي، فيما كانت التغطية المتعلقة بالسياحة والثقافة إيجابية. البند التشغيلي الوحيد هو تحذير من شركة طيران كابو فيردي بشأن احتمال تغييرات في رحلات لشبونة، ونبرة GDELT إيجابية بشكل طفيف، لذلك تقع الدرجة أعلى قليلاً من يوم عادي.
summary.fa: این دوره عادی است: اپوزیسیون با استناد به ارزیابی‌های صندوق بین‌المللی پول از اقتصاد انتقاد کرد و پوشش خبری گردشگری و فرهنگ مثبت بود. تنها مورد عملیاتی هشدار شرکت هواپیمایی Cabo Verde Airlines درباره احتمال تغییر پروازهای لیسبون است و لحن GDELT اندکی مثبت است، بنابراین امتیاز کمی بالاتر از یک روز معمولی قرار دارد.
summary.zh: 这一时期属于例行情况：反对派引用国际货币基金组织的评估批评经济，旅游和文化报道则较为正面。唯一的运营相关事项是佛得角航空公司发出的提醒，称飞往里斯本的航班可能有所调整；GDELT的语气略为正面，因此评分略高于普通日子。
summary.tr: Dönem olağan seyrinde ilerliyor: muhalefet, IMF değerlendirmelerine atıfta bulunarak ekonomiyi eleştirdi; turizm ve kültür haberciliği olumlu oldu. Tek operasyonel gelişme, Cabo Verde Airlines'ın Lizbon uçuşlarında olası değişiklikler konusundaki uyarısı. GDELT tonu hafifçe olumlu olduğu için puan sıradan bir günün biraz üzerinde.
summary.es: El periodo transcurre con normalidad: la oposición criticó la economía citando al FMI, y la cobertura sobre turismo y cultura fue positiva. El único elemento operativo es una advertencia de Cabo Verde Airlines sobre posibles cambios en los vuelos a Lisboa, y el tono de GDELT es levemente positivo, por lo que la puntuación se sitúa algo por encima de un día ordinario.
summary.fr: La période est routinière : l'opposition a critiqué l'économie en citant le FMI, et la couverture touristique et culturelle a été positive. Le seul élément opérationnel est un avertissement de Cabo Verde Airlines concernant d'éventuels changements sur les vols vers Lisbonne ; le ton GDELT est légèrement positif, si bien que le score se situe un peu au-dessus d'une journée ordinaire.
summary.de: Der Zeitraum verläuft routinemäßig: Die Opposition kritisierte die Wirtschaft unter Verweis auf den IWF, und die Berichterstattung über Tourismus und Kultur fiel positiv aus. Der einzige operative Punkt ist eine Warnung der Cabo Verde Airlines vor möglichen Änderungen bei den Flügen nach Lissabon; der GDELT-Ton ist leicht positiv, weshalb der Wert knapp über einem gewöhnlichen Tag liegt.
summary.pt: O período decorre de forma rotineira: a oposição criticou a economia citando avaliações do FMI, e a cobertura sobre turismo e cultura foi positiva. O único item operacional é um aviso da Cabo Verde Airlines sobre possíveis alterações nos voos para Lisboa, e o tom do GDELT é ligeiramente positivo, pelo que a pontuação fica um pouco acima de um dia comum.
summary.ja: 今回の期間は通常どおりの内容です。野党がIMFの評価を引用して経済を批判した一方、観光と文化に関する報道は前向きでした。運航面で唯一の項目は、カーボベルデ航空によるリスボン便の変更の可能性に関する注意喚起です。GDELTのトーンはやや肯定的で、そのためスコアは通常の日よりわずかに高い水準にあります。
summary.ko: 이번 기간은 일상적인 흐름입니다. 야당은 IMF 평가를 인용하며 경제를 비판했고, 관광과 문화 관련 보도는 긍정적이었습니다. 운항 관련 유일한 사안은 카보베르데 항공이 리스본 노선 변경 가능성을 경고한 것입니다. GDELT 어조는 약간 긍정적이어서 점수는 보통의 날보다 조금 높습니다.
summary.hi: यह अवधि सामान्य है: विपक्ष ने IMF के आकलन का हवाला देते हुए अर्थव्यवस्था की आलोचना की, जबकि पर्यटन और सांस्कृतिक कवरेज सकारात्मक रहा। एकमात्र परिचालन मुद्दा केप वर्दे एयरलाइन्स की ओर से लिस्बन की उड़ानों में संभावित बदलावों की चेतावनी है। GDELT का स्वर हल्का सकारात्मक है, इसलिए स्कोर एक सामान्य दिन से थोड़ा ऊपर है।
summary.el: Η περίοδος είναι συνηθισμένη: η αντιπολίτευση επέκρινε την οικονομία επικαλούμενη εκτιμήσεις του ΔΝΤ, ενώ η κάλυψη του τουρισμού και του πολιτισμού ήταν θετική. Το μόνο επιχειρησιακό θέμα είναι προειδοποίηση της Cabo Verde Airlines για πιθανές αλλαγές στις πτήσεις προς Λισαβόνα, και ο τόνος του GDELT είναι ελαφρώς θετικός, οπότε η βαθμολογία βρίσκεται ελαφρώς πάνω από μια συνηθισμένη ημέρα.

summary.ja: この期間は通常どおりの推移で、選挙手続きは前進し、大統領候補の届出書12件が提出され、独立選挙委員会(IEC)がBensoudaの要件充足を確認しました。あわせて援助物資の配布、観光振興計画、中国とガンビアの外交上の節目も報じられました。一方で、最高裁判事任命をめぐる法的異議申し立ての遅延や政府白書をめぐる対立といった懸念もあり、そのためスコアは平常の一日よりわずかに高くなっています。
summary.ko: 이번 기간은 대체로 평이했습니다. 선거 절차는 진행되어 대통령 후보 등록 서류 12건이 접수되었고, 선거관리위원회(IEC)는 Bensouda가 요건을 충족한다고 확인했습니다. 이와 함께 구호물자 배포, 관광 청사진, 중국-감비아 외교적 이정표도 있었습니다. 다만 대법원장 임명에 대한 법적 이의 제기 소송의 지연과 정부 백서를 둘러싼 논란은 우려 사항으로, 이에 따라 점수는 평범한 하루보다 다소 높게 책정되었습니다.
summary.hi: यह अवधि सामान्य रही: चुनाव प्रक्रिया आगे बढ़ी, राष्ट्रपति पद के लिए 12 नामांकन पत्र दाखिल हुए और IEC ने पुष्टि की कि Bensouda आवश्यकताएँ पूरी करती हैं। साथ ही सहायता वितरण, पर्यटन खाका और चीन-गाम्बिया राजनयिक उपलब्धि भी रही। वहीं मुख्य न्यायाधीश की नियुक्ति को चुनौती देने वाले कानूनी मामले में देरी और सरकारी श्वेत पत्र को लेकर विवाद चिंता के विषय हैं, इसलिए स्कोर एक सामान्य दिन से थोड़ा ऊपर है।
summary.el: Η περίοδος ήταν συνηθισμένη: η εκλογική διαδικασία προχώρησε, με κατάθεση 12 αιτήσεων υποψηφιότητας για την προεδρία και επιβεβαίωση από την IEC ότι η Bensouda πληροί τις προϋποθέσεις, ενώ υπήρξαν επίσης διανομή βοήθειας, σχέδιο για τον τουρισμό και ένα διπλωματικό ορόσημο Κίνας-Γκάμπιας. Οι ανησυχίες αφορούν μια καθυστερημένη νομική προσφυγή για τον διορισμό του Αρχιδικαστή και διαφωνίες για μια Λευκή Βίβλο της κυβέρνησης, γι' αυτό η βαθμολογία βρίσκεται μετρίως πάνω από μια συνηθισμένη ημέρα.
summary.tr: Dönem olağan seyretti: seçim süreci ilerledi, 12 cumhurbaşkanlığı aday başvuru belgesi teslim edildi ve IEC, Bensouda'nın gerekli koşulları karşıladığını doğruladı. Bunun yanında yardım dağıtımı, bir turizm yol haritası ve Çin-Gambiya diplomatik bir dönüm noktası yaşandı. Baş Yargıç atamasına ilişkin ertelenen yasal itiraz ve bir Hükümet Beyaz Kitabı üzerindeki anlaşmazlıklar endişe konusu; bu nedenle skor sıradan bir günün biraz üzerinde.
summary.es: El período fue rutinario: el proceso electoral avanzó con 12 solicitudes de nominación presidencial presentadas y la IEC confirmó que Bensouda cumple los requisitos, junto con la distribución de ayuda, una hoja de ruta turística y un hito diplomático entre China y Gambia. Entre las preocupaciones figuran una demanda judicial retrasada sobre el nombramiento del presidente del Tribunal Supremo y disputas en torno a un Libro Blanco del gobierno, por lo que la puntuación se sitúa modestamente por encima de un día ordinario.
summary.fr: La période était routinière : le processus électoral a progressé avec le dépôt de 12 dossiers de candidature à la présidentielle et la CEI a confirmé que Bensouda remplit les conditions, parallèlement à la distribution d'aides, à une feuille de route touristique et à une étape diplomatique entre la Chine et la Gambie. Les inquiétudes portent sur un recours juridique retardé concernant la nomination du Juge en chef et sur des différends autour d'un Livre blanc du gouvernement ; le score se situe donc légèrement au-dessus d'une journée ordinaire.
summary.de: Der Zeitraum verlief routinemäßig: Der Wahlprozess kam voran, 12 Wahlvorschläge für das Präsidentenamt wurden eingereicht, und die IEC bestätigte, dass Bensouda die Voraussetzungen erfüllt; hinzu kamen Hilfsverteilungen, ein Tourismusplan und ein diplomatischer Meilenstein zwischen China und Gambia. Bedenken betreffen eine verzögerte Klage gegen die Ernennung des Obersten Richters sowie Streitigkeiten um ein Weißbuch der Regierung, weshalb der Wert knapp über einem gewöhnlichen Tag liegt.
summary.pt: O período foi de rotina: o processo eleitoral avançou com 12 pedidos de candidatura presidencial apresentados e a IEC confirmou que Bensouda cumpre os requisitos, além da distribuição de ajuda, de um plano de turismo e de um marco diplomático China-Gâmbia. As preocupações incluem uma ação judicial atrasada sobre a nomeação do Presidente do Supremo Tribunal e disputas sobre um Livro Branco do governo, pelo que a pontuação fica moderadamente acima de um dia comum.
summary.it: Il periodo è stato di routine: il processo elettorale è avanzato con 12 domande di candidatura presidenziale depositate e la IEC che ha confermato che Bensouda soddisfa i requisiti, insieme alla distribuzione di aiuti, a un piano per il turismo e a una tappa diplomatica tra Cina e Gambia. Le preoccupazioni riguardano un ricorso legale in ritardo sulla nomina del Presidente della Corte Suprema e le controversie su un Libro Bianco del governo, quindi il punteggio è leggermente superiore a una giornata ordinaria.
summary.ru: Период прошёл в штатном режиме: избирательный процесс продвигался, были поданы 12 заявок на выдвижение кандидатов в президенты, а IEC подтвердила, что Бенсуда соответствует требованиям; также состоялись распределение помощи, presentation плана развития туризма и дипломатическая веха в отношениях Китая и Гамбии. Вызывают беспокойство задержка с судебным иском по поводу назначения главного судьи и споры вокруг правительственного «Белой книги», поэтому оценка немного выше обычного дня.
summary.ar: كانت الفترة روتينية: تقدمت العملية الانتخابية مع تقديم 12 ملف ترشح للرئاسة وتأكيد المفوضية الوطنية للانتخابات أن بنسودا تستوفي الشروط، إلى جانب توزيع المساعدات وإعداد خطة للسياحة ومحطة دبلوماسية بين الصين وغامبيا. وتشمل المخاوف تأخر الطعن القانوني في تعيين رئيس القضاة والنزاعات حول الكتاب الأبيض الحكومي، لذلك تقع الدرجة أعلى قليلاً من يوم عادي.
summary.fa: این دوره عادی بود: روند انتخابات با ثبت ۱۲ برگه کاندیداتوری ریاست جمهوری پیش رفت و کمیسیون انتخابات تأیید کرد که بنسودا واجد شرایط است؛ همچنین توزیع کمک‌ها، طرح توسعه گردشگری و یک گام دیپلماتیک میان چین و گامبیا برداشته شد. نگرانی‌ها شامل تأخیر در دادخواست قانونی علیه انتصاب رئیس دیوان عالی و اختلاف بر سر کتاب سفید دولت است، از این رو امتیاز اندکی بالاتر از یک روز معمولی قرار دارد.
summary.zh: 此期间较为平常：选举进程有所推进，已提交12份总统候选人提名文件，独立选举委员会确认本达女士符合条件；同时进行了援助发放、旅游发展蓝图编制，以及中国与冈比亚的一项外交里程碑事件。令人担忧的是，对首席大法官任命的法律诉讼被推迟，且围绕政府白皮书存在争议，因此评分略高于普通的一天。

summary.en: Botswana's positive and negative developments are balanced: inflation has fallen markedly, foreign exchange reserves have risen to P63 billion, and investment opportunities in relations with China stand out. However, a P10 billion export collapse, De Beers' 11% cut in diamond production, and fiscal squeeze warnings point to economic pressure. No clear crisis; it is considered an ordinary period.

en: Sharp fall in inflation along with fuel costs, and reserves rising to P63 billion
Fiscal squeeze risk due to the collapse in diamond exports and the De Beers production cut
President Boko's visit to China and investment and trade agreements
Renewed rapprochement in De Beers–Botswana relations
Governance and health agenda, including abandoned projects, corruption allegations and foot-and-mouth disease vaccination efforts

summary.en: The period mixes positive news, including an elevated China partnership, zero-tariff access, a return to profit at BHC and new FIFA and BFA funding, with a notable downside in a reported P10 billion export collapse and a fiscal squeeze. Other items are routine crime and local stories, and GDELT tone is more positive than the world average.

en: Botswana and China elevate bilateral ties; presidential Beijing visit
BHC returns to profit and BFA receives FIFA and windfall funding
Reported P10 billion export collapse signals fiscal squeeze

summary.en: Botswana's news over the period is mostly positive: an opposition party won a by-election and the ruling party publicly accepted the result, and the government advanced a P1bn diamond fund with De Beers. Foreign coverage is routine to upbeat, covering China ties, a $73M revenue report and a planned power trading law.

en: Opposition BCP wins Sefhophe by-election; ruling party accepts defeat
Government and De Beers advance P1bn diamond fund
Reported $73M receipts and planned power trading law

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: a fatal mine crash that killed four workers is the main negative event, offset by investment news (NexMetals resource expansion), a malaria-free target and new disaster-management ties with Australia. GDELT tone (-0.49) is slightly better than the world average, so the overall picture is close to an ordinary day.

en: Four Khoemacau mine workers killed in head-on collision
NexMetals triples resource estimate in Phikwe
Botswana seeks malaria-free status by 2029

summary.en: The period was mostly routine, with several positive developments: a $503.75m African Development Bank financing package to cushion energy shocks, a new national malaria council, and a Botswana nomination for WHO leadership. A fatal crash at a copper mine is the main negative item, but it is a localised incident.

en: $503.75m African Development Bank financing for energy shocks and jobs
National 28-member malaria council established and renewed anti-malaria efforts
Botswana nominates Armenian doctor to lead WHO

summary.en: Botswana's news flow over the period is modestly positive, led by the approval of a $503.75m AfDB loan to support the economy and South Africa reopening its market to Botswana beef amid a foot-and-mouth disease crisis. Coverage is thin, with no domestic headlines, so the score rests on two concrete positive economic developments.

en: AfDB approves $503.75m loan for Botswana's economy
South Africa opens market to Botswana beef during FMD crisis

summary.en: The period is largely routine: bank assets rose, a foreign partnership was announced and a court gave life sentences for killings, offset by weak diamond demand, a looming El Niño and opposition by-election gains. Tone matches the world average, so the score sits near the ordinary baseline.

en: Banks' total assets rise, a modest positive economic signal
Weak diamond demand and falling De Beers output
BCP by-election win shifts Mmadinare politics

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: auctions, business forums, and policy discussion, with a positive tilt from De Beers' $73 million commitment to Botswana's economic future and a national honour for a Kalahari land-rights figure. Offsetting concerns include rising fuel prices, household inflation, an El Niño alert, and pressure on the diamond sector.

en: De Beers commits $73 million to Botswana's economic future
Higher fuel prices add to inflation and business costs
El Niño high alert issued for the region

summary.en: The period was mostly routine, with several constructive economic items: a P2.5 billion fiscal surplus, a planned special economic zone in Palapye, and a financial-hub strategy. Offsetting these were a fuel price increase, an acute water shortage, and debate over cadre deployment, so the score sits modestly above a typical day.

en: P2.5 billion fiscal surplus reported as possible turning point
Palapye special economic zone and Gaborone financial hub plans
Fuel price increase amid Middle East tensions

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: diplomatic and business items, a WHO nominee, a copper licence update and a rule-of-law commentary, with a mildly positive GDELT tone. The main negative is reporting on Botswana nationals recruited to fight in Ukraine, which is a minor social concern.

en: Botswana's WHO nominee championing health equity and youth
Reports of Botswana citizens recruited and killed fighting in Ukraine
Routine copper licence update and diamond-sector jobs blueprint

summary.en: Botswana's coverage over the period is routine to mildly positive: the central bank held its rate at 5.5%, a mining firm received AI-driven exploration approval, and the diaspora was mobilised for development. Minor negatives include a passport fee increase and a push for new fuel supply partners, and the market data is absent.

en: Central bank holds interest rate steady at 5.5%
Botswana Minerals receives approval for AI-driven exploration
Diaspora mobilised for national development; passport fees rise

summary.en: The period was mostly routine, with several constructive economic and social items: an IMF outlook pointing to a rebound, a bank IPO, and a historic land restitution process for the San. Mild offsets include IMF warnings about price pressures and a story on protection for crime victims, and many foreign items were not Botswana-specific.

en: IMF optimistic on Botswana rebound, though warning of price pressures
Stanbic Bank Botswana IPO selling a 20% stake
Historic land restitution process offering hope for Indigenous San

summary.en: Coverage of Botswana over the period is thin and mostly routine: a temporary border post closure with South Africa and a minor new egg export market opening with Namibia. Tone is slightly less negative than the world average, so the period looks ordinary.

en: Temporary closure of Kopfontein border post with South Africa
Namibia adds Botswana to its egg export market
Routine politics coverage with no clear crisis

summary.en: A routine day in Botswana with mixed signals: growth-rebound and SME-finance deals and a bank IPO sit alongside political disputes over cadre deployment and a procurement scandal, plus a pending marriage-law court case. Positive economic items and a favourable news tone push the score slightly above an ordinary day.

en: Growth rebound and mining support expected to lift growth
BBS Bank and Debswana MoU to support SMEs
Cadre deployment and procurement disputes raise governance concerns

summary.en: Botswana's coverage over the period is mostly routine: the central bank held rates as inflation cooled, and a Motswana-owned miner listed on the ASX. Offsetting concerns include debt pressures, IMF-linked wage-bill debate, El Niño inflation risk, and a fake-meat scandal, so the net picture is ordinary to slightly positive.

en: Bank of Botswana holds rates as inflation cools
Motswana-owned mining company lists on Australia's ASX
Debt reckoning and IMF wage-bill debate continue

summary.en: The period reads as routine, with a mild positive tilt: Botswana made gains in economic governance, and there are investment and partnership announcements such as a cement plant plan and a Huawei-Orange digital deal. Negatives are ordinary crime and traffic incidents, a declining pension index score, and a diplomatic issue over a detained artist, and GDELT tone (-0.15) is milder than the world average.

en: Botswana makes gains in economic governance
Cheetah Cement plans new plant; Huawei-Orange digital partnership
Passport fee increase postponed to January 2027

summary.en: The period was mostly routine with clear positives: the growth forecast was raised to 3.8%, a major fuel-hub investment and a reinsurer's profit surge were reported, and a court settlement resolved a dispute. Negatives were limited to El Niño pressure on wildlife and the death of a wildlife filmmaker.

en: Growth forecast raised to 3.8%
Dangote fuel-supply diversification and regional fuel hub interest
Continental Reinsurance profits up 902% with IPO reinforcement

summary.en: The period was routine for Botswana: a sharp rise in malaria cases and El Niño-driven human-wildlife conflict were offset by regional malaria cooperation, diplomatic credentials, and an upcoming State of the Nation address. GDELT tone was mildly positive, and no crisis or institutional stress appeared in the headlines.

en: Sharp rise in malaria cases reported
El Niño intensifying human-wildlife conflict
Regional cooperation push to eliminate malaria

summary.en: The period is routine: domestic coverage centres on scrutiny of the president's State of the Nation address, with critics questioning jobs and crime pledges, and foreign items are largely unrelated or diplomatic. Tone is mildly negative but less so than the global average, with no crisis, unrest or institutional breakdown reported.

en: SONA coverage and opposition scrutiny of jobs and crime pledges
Poll showing majority support for international trade engagement

summary.en: The period shows routine, mildly positive coverage: tourism listings, cultural and diplomatic events with China, and a health initiative presented in Gaborone. No crisis, unrest or economic shock appears in the headlines, and the GDELT tone is modestly positive.

Sudanese malaria-elimination initiative presented in Gaborone, a mild regional health signal
No crisis, unrest or economic shock reported in the headlines

summary.en: The period looks routine, with domestic coverage on investment outreach, crime threats to economic transformation, and calls for patience in national renewal. GDELT tone (-0.22) is milder than the world average, but the headline set is thin and includes unclear items.

en: Investment forum seeking capital; routine economic outreach
Commentary warning crime networks threaten economic transformation
Minor legal dispute over a cancelled concert

summary.en: The period is dominated by a clearly positive economic story: the government plans to raise its stake in De Beers to 30% as part of the Anglo American sale, reported across many outlets. Otherwise coverage is routine (climate finance, diplomatic appointments, a by-election), with some negative items such as ongoing rape charges and a bureaucracy critique.

en: Plan to double state stake in De Beers to 30%
Consortium moving to finalise De Beers acquisition from Anglo American
Routine diplomacy, climate-funding and by-election coverage

summary.en: The period is dominated by Botswana's move to double its stake in De Beers to 30% and a France declaration protecting the 'diamond' term, both signs of economic and diplomatic progress. Routine crime stories, a murder suspect's escape and governance critiques are negative but ordinary; GDELT tone is well above the world average.
summary.it: Il periodo è dominato dalla decisione del Botswana di raddoppiare la propria quota in De Beers portandola al 30% e da una dichiarazione con la Francia a tutela del termine "diamante", entrambi segnali di progresso economico e diplomatico. Le cronache di criminalità di routine, la fuga di un sospettato di omicidio e le critiche sulla governance sono negative ma ordinarie; il tono di GDELT è ben al di sopra della media mondiale.
summary.ru: Период определяется решением Ботсваны удвоить свою долю в De Beers, доведя её до 30%, и декларацией Франции о защите термина «алмаз», что свидетельствует об экономическом и дипломатическом прогрессе. Рутинные криминальные новости, побег подозреваемого в убийстве и критика в адрес управления носят негативный, но обычный характер; тональность GDELT заметно выше среднемировой.
summary.ar: تهيمن على هذه الفترة خطوة بوتسوانا لمضاعفة حصتها في شركة دي بيرز إلى 30%، وإعلان فرنسي بشأن حماية مصطلح «الماس»، وكلاهما مؤشر على تقدم اقتصادي ودبلوماسي. أما أخبار الجريمة الروتينية، وفرار مشتبه به في جريمة قتل، وانتقادات الحوكمة فهي سلبية لكنها عادية، ونبرة GDELT أعلى بكثير من المتوسط العالمي.
summary.fa: این دوره عمدتاً تحت تأثیر تصمیم بوتسوانا برای دو برابر کردن سهم خود در دی‌بیرز به ۳۰٪ و بیانیه فرانسه در حمایت از اصطلاح «الماس» است که هر دو نشانه پیشرفت اقتصادی و دیپلماتیک هستند. اخبار معمول جنایی، فرار مظنون به قتل و انتقادها از حکمرانی منفی اما عادی‌اند؛ لحن GDELT به‌طور قابل توجهی بالاتر از میانگین جهانی است.
summary.zh: 该时期的主要新闻是博茨瓦纳决定将其在戴比尔斯的股份翻倍至30%，以及法国发表声明保护“钻石”一词，二者均显示经济和外交方面的进展。常规犯罪报道、一名谋杀嫌疑人越狱以及对治理的批评属于负面但常见的新闻；GDELT语气明显高于全球平均水平。
summary.tr: Dönemde iki olumlu gelişme öne çıkıyor: Botsvana'nın De Beers'teki payını yüzde 30'a çıkarma kararı ve Fransa'nın 'elmas' terimini koruyan bildirisi; bunlar ekonomik ve diplomatik ilerlemenin göstergeleri. Olağan suç haberleri, bir cinayet şüphelisinin kaçışı ve yönetişim eleştirileri olumsuz ancak sıradan nitelikte; GDELT tonu dünya ortalamasının çok üzerinde.
summary.es: El periodo está dominado por la decisión de Botsuana de duplicar su participación en De Beers hasta el 30 % y por una declaración de Francia que protege el término 'diamante', ambas señales de avance económico y diplomático. Las noticias rutinarias de delitos, la fuga de un sospechoso de asesinato y las críticas a la gobernanza son negativas pero habituales; el tono de GDELT está muy por encima de la media mundial.
summary.fr: La période est dominée par la décision du Botswana de doubler sa participation dans De Beers, pour la porter à 30 %, et par une déclaration de la France protégeant le terme « diamant », deux signes de progrès économique et diplomatique. Les faits divers routiniers, la fuite d'un suspect de meurtre et les critiques sur la gouvernance sont négatifs mais ordinaires ; le ton GDELT est nettement supérieur à la moyenne mondiale.
summary.de: Der Berichtszeitraum wird von zwei positiven Entwicklungen geprägt: Botswana plant, seinen Anteil an De Beers auf 30 % zu verdoppeln, und Frankreich hat eine Erklärung zum Schutz des Begriffs „Diamant“ abgegeben; beides sind Zeichen wirtschaftlichen und diplomatischen Fortschritts. Routinemäßige Kriminalmeldungen, die Flucht eines Mordverdächtigen und Kritik an der Regierungsführung sind negativ, aber alltäglich; der GDELT-Tonwert liegt deutlich über dem weltweiten Durchschnitt.
summary.pt: O período é dominado pela decisão do Botsuana de duplicar sua participação na De Beers, para 30%, e por uma declaração da França que protege o termo 'diamante', ambos sinais de progresso econômico e diplomático. Notícias rotineiras de crime, a fuga de um suspeito de homicídio e críticas à governança são negativas, mas comuns; o tom do GDELT está bem acima da média mundial.
summary.ja: この期間は、ボツワナがデビアスの株式保有を30%へと倍増させる方針を進めたことと、フランスとの「ダイヤモンド」という用語の保護に関する宣言が中心となっています。どちらも経済面および外交面での前進を示すものです。日常的な犯罪報道、殺人容疑者の逃走、統治に関する批判は否定的な内容ですが、いずれもありふれたものです。GDELTのトーンは世界平均を大きく上回っています。
summary.ko: 이 기간에는 보츠와나가 드비어스 지분을 30%로 두 배 늘리려는 움직임과, 'diamond' 용어를 보호하는 프랑스의 선언이 주를 이루었으며, 두 가지 모두 경제적·외교적 진전을 보여줍니다. 일상적인 범죄 보도, 살인 용의자의 도주, 통치에 대한 비판은 부정적이지만 흔한 내용입니다. GDELT 톤은 세계 평균을 크게 웃돕니다.
summary.hi: इस अवधि में मुख्य रूप से बोत्सवाना द्वारा डी बीयर्स में अपनी हिस्सेदारी को दोगुना करके 30% करने का कदम और 'डायमंड' शब्द की रक्षा के लिए फ़्रांस की घोषणा रही, जो दोनों आर्थिक और कूटनीतिक प्रगति के संकेत हैं। नियमित अपराध समाचार, एक हत्या के आरोपी का भाग जाना और शासन की आलोचनाएँ नकारात्मक हैं, लेकिन सामान्य हैं। GDELT टोन विश्व औसत से काफ़ी ऊपर है।
summary.el: Η περίοδος κυριαρχείται από την κίνηση της Μποτσουάνα να διπλασιάσει το μερίδιό της στην De Beers στο 30% και από δήλωση Γαλλίας για την προστασία του όρου «διαμάντι», και τα δύο σημάδια οικονομικής και διπλωματικής προόδου. Οι συνήθεις ειδήσεις εγκληματικότητας, η απόδραση ενός υπόπτου για φόνο και οι κριτικές για τη διακυβέρνηση είναι αρνητικές αλλά συνηθισμένες. Ο τόνος του GDELT βρίσκεται πολύ πάνω από τον παγκόσμιο μέσο όρο.

summary.en: A routine day in Namibia: no major crisis is apparent. Rising tourism occupancy, dialogue with Angola, the upcoming ILO regional meeting in Windhoek, and energy cooperation are positive. Trust in the Anti-Corruption Commission (ACC) and calls for the Finestar investigation

summary.en: The period was mostly routine but leaned positive, led by large energy and infrastructure investments (a US$2.5bn Walvis Bay pipeline and storage project, a N$17bn green hydrogen plan, and a QatarEnergy stake in an offshore licence). summary.it: Il periodo è stato per lo più di routine ma con un orientamento positivo, trainato da grandi investimenti in energia e infrastrutture (un progetto di gasdotto e stoccaggio a Walvis Bay da 2,5 miliardi di dollari USA, un piano per l'idrogeno verde da 17 miliardi di dollari namibiani e una quota di QatarEnergy in una licenza offshore). Tra le preoccupazioni che hanno controbilanciato questo quadro figurano l'ampliamento del disavanzo commerciale, una malattia del bestiame che colpisce le imprese, problemi di approvvigionamento di acqua salmastra e la pressione del debito sull'accesso all'elettricità.
summary.ru: Период в целом прошёл в обычном режиме, но с преобладанием позитивных факторов, главным образом благодаря крупным инвестициям в энергетику и инфраструктуру (проект трубопровода и хранилищ в Walvis Bay стоимостью 2,5 млрд долларов США, план по зелёному водороду на 17 млрд намибийских долларов и доля QatarEnergy в офшорной лицензии). Сдерживающими факторами стали расширение торгового дефицита, заболевание скота, наносящее ущерб предприятиям, проблемы с водоснабжением солоноватой водой и долговая нагрузка, влияющая на доступ к электроэнергии.
summary.ar: كانت الفترة روتينية في معظمها لكنها مالت إلى الإيجابية، بقيادة استثمارات كبيرة في الطاقة والبنية التحتية (مشروع خط أنابيب ومرافق تخزين في والفيس باي بقيمة 2.5 مليار دولار أمريكي، وخطة للهيدروجين الأخضر بقيمة 17 مليار دولار ناميبي، وحصة لشركة QatarEnergy في ترخيص بحري). وفي المقابل، برزت مخاوف تمثلت في اتساع العجز التجاري، وتفشي مرض في الماشية أضر بالشركات، ومشكلات في إمدادات المياه المالحة، وضغوط الديون على الوصول إلى الكهرباء.
summary.fa: این دوره عمدتاً عادی بود اما با گرایشی مثبت، که عمدتاً ناشی از سرمایه‌گذاری‌های بزرگ در انرژی و زیرساخت بود (پروژه خط لوله و ذخیره‌سازی ۲٫۵ میلیارد دلار آمریکایی در والویس‌بی، طرح هیدروژن سبز ۱۷ میلیارد دلار نامیبیا، و سهم QatarEnergy در یک مجوز فراساحلی). در مقابل، نگرانی‌هایی وجود داشت از جمله گسترش کسری تجاری، بیماری دام که به کسب‌وکارها آسیب زد، مشکلات تأمین آب شور و فشار بدهی بر دسترسی به برق.
summary.zh: 这一时期总体属于常规状态，但整体偏向积极，主要得益于大型能源和基础设施投资（价值25亿美元的沃尔维斯湾管道和储存项目、170亿纳米比亚元的绿色氢能计划，以及卡塔尔能源公司在一项海上许可证中的股份）。与之相抵的担忧包括贸易逆差扩大、牲畜疫病影响企业、咸水供应问题，以及债务压力对电力普及的影响。
summary.ja: この期間は概ね平常通りだったが、ウォルビスベイのパイプライン・貯蔵事業（25億米ドル）、グリーン水素計画（170億ナミビアドル）、オフショア鉱区へのQatarEnergyの出資など、大規模なエネルギー・インフラ投資に支えられて全体として前向きな傾向を示した。一方で、貿易赤字の拡大、家畜の病気による企業への打撃、塩分を含む水供給の問題、電力アクセスをめぐる債務圧力などの懸念もあった。
summary.ko: 이번 기간은 대체로 평이했으나 긍정적인 방향이었으며, 대규모 에너지 및 인프라 투자가 이를 주도했다. 월비스베이 파이프라인 및 저장 사업(25억 미국 달러), 그린 수소 계획(170억 나미비아 달러), 해상 광구에 대한 QatarEnergy의 지분 투자 등이 그 예이다. 반면 무역 적자 확대, 가축 질병으로 인한 기업 피해, 염분이 섞인 물 공급 문제, 전기 접근성에 대한 부채 압박 등은 우려 요인으로 작용했다.
summary.hi: यह अवधि ज़्यादातर सामान्य रही, लेकिन सकारात्मक झुकाव के साथ, जिसका नेतृत्व बड़े ऊर्जा और बुनियादी ढांचे के निवेशों ने किया — वाल्विस बे पाइपलाइन और भंडारण परियोजना (US$2.5bn), N$17bn की हरित हाइड्रोजन योजना, और एक ऑफशोर लाइसेंस में QatarEnergy की हिस्सेदारी। इनके विपरीत चिंताओं में व्यापार घाटे का चौड़ा होना, पशुओं के रोग से व्यवसायों पर असर, खारे पानी की आपूर्ति की समस्याएं, और बिजली पहुंच पर कर्ज़ का दबाव शामिल रहे।
summary.el: Η περίοδος ήταν κυρίως συνηθισμένη αλλά με θετική κατεύθυνση, με πρωταγωνιστές τις μεγάλες επενδύσεις σε ενέργεια και υποδομές: το έργο αγωγού και αποθήκευσης στο Walvis Bay (US$2,5 δισ.), το σχέδιο πράσινου υδρογόνου (N$17 δισ.) και το μερίδιο της QatarEnergy σε άδεια υπεράκτιας έρευνας. Αντίθετα, οι ανησυχίες περιλάμβαναν τη διεύρυνση του εμπορικού ελλείμματος, ασθένειες των ζώων που έπληξαν επιχειρήσεις, προβλήματα με το αλμυρό νερό ύδρευσης και πίεση χρέους στην πρόσβαση σε ηλεκτρική ενέργεια.
summary.tr: Dönem büyük ölçüde rutin seyretti ancak olumlu bir eğilim taşıdı; bunda büyük enerji ve altyapı yatırımları öne çıktı (2,5 milyar ABD doları tutarında Walvis Bay boru hattı ve depolama projesi, 17 milyar Namibya doları tutarında yeşil hidrojen planı ve bir açık deniz ruhsatında QatarEnergy hissesi). Olumsuz yöndeki kaygılar arasında genişleyen ticaret açığı, işletmeleri etkileyen hayvan hastalığı, tuzlu su kaynaklı su tedarik sorunları ve elektriğe erişim üzerindeki borç baskısı yer aldı.
summary.es: El período fue en su mayoría rutinario, pero con una tendencia positiva, impulsada por grandes inversiones en energía e infraestructura (un proyecto de oleoducto y almacenamiento en Walvis Bay por 2.500 millones de dólares estadounidenses, un plan de hidrógeno verde de 17.000 millones de dólares namibios y una participación de QatarEnergy en una licencia offshore). Entre las preocupaciones compensatorias figuraron la ampliación del déficit comercial, una enfermedad del ganado que afecta a las empresas, problemas de suministro de agua salobre y la presión de la deuda sobre el acceso a la electricidad.
summary.fr: La période a été globalement routinière mais plutôt positive, portée par de importants investissements dans l'énergie et les infrastructures (un projet de pipeline et de stockage à Walvis Bay de 2,5 milliards de dollars américains, un plan d'hydrogène vert de 17 milliards de dollars namibiens et une participation de QatarEnergy dans une licence offshore). Les préoccupations en sens contraire comprenaient un élargissement du déficit commercial, une maladie du bétail touchant les entreprises, des problèmes d'approvisionnement en eau saumâtre et la pression de l'endettement sur l'accès à l'électricité.
summary.de: Der Berichtszeitraum verlief überwiegend routinemäßig, tendierte jedoch ins Positive, angeführt von großen Investitionen in Energie und Infrastruktur (ein Pipeline- und Speicherprojekt in Walvis Bay über 2,5 Mrd. US-Dollar, ein Plan für grünen Wasserstoff über 17 Mrd. namibische Dollar und eine Beteiligung von QatarEnergy an einer Offshore-Lizenz). Ausgleichend wirkten Sorgen über eine wachsende Handelslücke, eine Tierseuche, die Unternehmen trifft, Probleme mit salzhaltigem Wasser in der Versorgung sowie der Schuldendruck beim Zugang zur Stromversorgung.
summary.pt: O período foi em grande parte rotineiro, mas com tendência positiva, impulsionado por grandes investimentos em energia e infraestrutura (um projeto de gasoduto e armazenamento em Walvis Bay de US$ 2,5 bilhões, um plano de hidrogênio verde de N$ 17 bilhões e uma participação da QatarEnergy em uma licença offshore). Como contrapontos, houve preocupações com a ampliação do déficit comercial, uma doença animal afetando empresas, problemas no abastecimento de água salobra e a pressão da dívida sobre o acesso à eletricidade.

summary.en: Protests continue in Portugal over the housing crisis and rent reform. A tent camp in Lisbon and Porto was cleared by police, more than 50 people were detained, and a strike was called across the Iberian Peninsula. In contrast, economic and tourism news is positive, the stock market is moving sideways, and no severe crisis is apparent. The score is therefore slightly below the usual level.

GDELT tone markedly negative compared with the world average
